summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读引言、方法总览和实验表格，预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。重点看 Figure 1 对三种范式的对比，以及层级去噪调度和 SHAP 注意力模式的设计动机，不必一开始陷入实现细节。若关心视频 diffusion 推理机制，可重点关注“为什么粗层高噪声有助于保留多个规划假设”这一点；若关心工程部署，则看 SHAP 如何限制注意力连通域。后续值得追问的是：层次 latent 如何预训练得到、层级数和树结构如何选择、该机制能否扩展到开放域长视频和音视频联合建模，以及 coarse plan 的修订是否会破坏已输出帧的因果一致性。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing video generation models face a tension between multi-step visual reasoning and low-latency streaming: streaming autoregressive diffusion is efficient but commits too early and struggles with global revision, while bidirectional diffusion supports global consistency but requires dense denoising over fixed sequences, making it expensive and poorly suited to streaming deployment.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to multimodal generative modeling and video-as-world-model research. It identifies a practical trade-off: reasoning requires maintaining and revising high-level hypotheses, while streaming deployment demands local causal, low-latency incremental output. HDR inserts an explicit hierarchical intermediate planning space between these two regimes. This connects to broader ideas such as plan-then-generate and coarse-to-fine reasoning in language and multimodal models, and may inform video diffusion LMs, embodied world models, and long-horizon consistency modeling. That said, the evidence is currently limited to controlled reasoning tasks rather than large-scale open-domain pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: HDR integrates a tree-structured latent hierarchy into a streaming autoregressive diffusion process and performs coarse-to-fine reasoning before streaming output. There are two core designs. First, a hierarchy-matched denoising schedule: coarser layers are kept at higher noise levels so they can preserve multiple global plans, while finer layers receive stronger denoising to instantiate those plans into concrete visual states. Second, SHAP (Sparse Hierarchical Attention Pattern): each token communicates only with fixed local context and parent-level context, avoiding dense full-sequence or full-hierarchy attention while preserving multi-scale information flow. Conceptually, this adds an explicit planning tree inside causal streaming diffusion, allowing high-level decisions to be revised before they are fully committed to frame-level details.
summary_en.experiments: The paper introduces a level-stratified multi-step video reasoning benchmark with OOD settings across six tasks: maze navigation, Tower of Hanoi, one-line drawing, sliding puzzle, Sokoban, and water pouring. HDR improves overall task success score from 34.22 to 60.29, a 76.2% relative gain, and raises average progress score from 76.00 to 89.56. During streaming it achieves 0.70 s per latent, reported as 54.2× faster than bidirectional diffusion. In data-efficiency ablations, with only 2% training data HDR retains 82.9% of its full-data success score, compared with 52.0% for bidirectional diffusion. Real-world robot maze experiments suggest transfer to physical interaction. These results are from controlled reasoning environments rather than large-scale open-domain video or general multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction, method overview, and result tables; estimated reading time 20–30 minutes. Focus on Figure 1 for the contrast between paradigms, and on the motivation behind the hierarchy-matched denoising schedule and SHAP attention pattern. Readers interested in diffusion-based reasoning should pay attention to why higher noise at coarse layers helps preserve multiple plans; readers interested in deployment should look at how SHAP constrains attention connectivity. Open questions worth tracking: how the hierarchical latents are pretrained, how tree depth and structure are chosen, whether the mechanism scales to open-domain long video and audio-visual modeling, and how revision at coarse levels interacts with causal consistency of already streamed frames.

recommendation.zh: 读架构和 attention pattern 即可；“层级 latent 做规划”方向对 latent reasoning 有用，但评测若靠视频观感会很脏。
recommendation.en: Read the architecture and attention pattern; hierarchical latents for planning are relevant to latent reasoning, but video-quality-heavy evaluation can be noisy.

paper.title: VGIF-Score: Interpretable and Diagnostic Evaluation of Spatio-Temporal Instruction Following in Video Generation
paper.abstract: Recent video generation models (VGMs) have made substantial progress in visual fidelity, yet their ability to follow long, compositional instructions remains insufficiently evaluated. Existing evaluation protocols often rely on prompts that are short and semantically shallow, with limited atomic constraints and weak spatio-temporal dependencies. They also frequently depend on costly human evaluation or handcrafted vision pipelines, while providing little diagnostic insight into which instruction

summary.core_problem: 现有视频生成模型的指令遵循评测多用短浅prompt、缺乏原子时空约束，依赖人工或手工视觉pipeline，无法诊断具体约束的成败原因。
summary.importance: 提出自动化、可解释的视频生成时空指令遵循评测框架VGIF-Score，属于评测方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: 框架包含两个分支：1）客观完成分支：将prompt解析为时空有向无环图（ST-DAG），做依赖感知QA和短路诊断，定位失败的具体约束；2）主观满意度分支：用指令条件的AutoRubric评估电影感等主观质量维度。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体被测模型与量化结果，仅声明框架可实现细粒度诊断、无需人工标注。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing video generation instruction-following evaluations use short, shallow prompts with limited atomic spatio-temporal constraints, rely on costly human evaluation or handcrafted vision pipelines, and provide no diagnostic insight into specific failure modes.
summary_en.importance: Proposes VGIF-Score, an automated, interpretable evaluation framework for spatio-temporal instruction following in video generation, representing an evaluation method innovation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has two components: 1) An objective completion branch that parses prompts into Spatio-Temporal Directed Acyclic Graphs (ST-DAG) for dependency-aware QA with short-circuit diagnostics to localize failed constraints; 2) A subjective satisfaction branch that uses instruction-conditioned AutoRubric to assess subjective dimensions like cinematic quality.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose specific tested models or quantitative results, only claiming the framework enables fine-grained diagnostics without manual annotation.

recommendation.zh: 结构化DAG拆解指令+短路诊断的评测思路可迁移至LLM组合指令评测，作为文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: The structured DAG prompt decomposition + short-circuit diagnostic design is transferable to LLM compositional instruction evaluation; keep as reference.

paper.title: VideoRAE: Taming Video Foundation Models for Generative Modeling via Representation Autoencoders
paper.abstract: Video generative models commonly rely on latent spaces learned by 3D Variational Autoencoders (3D-VAEs). However, conventional 3D-VAEs are mainly optimized for pixel-level reconstruction, which can limit the semantic and spatio-temporal structure captured by their latents. Meanwhile, Video Foundation Models (VFMs) such as V-JEPA 2 and VideoMAEv2 show strong video understanding capabilities, yet whether their frozen representations can be transformed into compact, reconstruction-capable, and gene

summary.core_problem: 传统3D-VAE学习的视频latent侧重像素级重建，语义与时空结构表征能力有限；冻结的视频基础模型表征能否转化为紧凑、可重建、适合生成的视频latent尚不明确
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次探索将冻结视频基础模型的表征转化为生成友好的视频latent，同时支持连续扩散与离散自回归两种生成范式，为视频表示学习提供新思路
summary.technical_approach: 提出VideoRAE，从冻结的视频基础编码器提取多尺度层级特征，通过轻量1D自注意力投影器压缩；采用多码本高维量化，同时支持扩散模型的连续latent和自回归模型的离散token；解码端使用局部-全局表征对齐策略保障重建质量
summary.experiments: 基于冻结的V-JEPA 2、VideoMAEv2等视频基础模型构建，支持扩散Transformer和自回归两种生成范式；摘要未完整披露实验数据集、基线与量化结果

summary_en.core_problem: Video latents learned by conventional 3D-VAEs prioritize pixel-level reconstruction with limited semantic and spatiotemporal structure; it remains unclear whether frozen video foundation model representations can be converted into compact, reconstructible, generation-friendly video latents
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first exploration of converting frozen video foundation model representations into generation-friendly video latents, supporting both continuous diffusion and discrete autoregressive generation paradigms, offering a new direction for video representation learning
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes VideoRAE, which extracts multi-scale hierarchical features from a frozen video foundation encoder and compresses them via a lightweight 1D self-attention projector; uses multi-codebook high-dimensional quantization to support both continuous latents for diffusion transformers and discrete tokens for autoregressive models; adopts a local-global representation alignment strategy at the decoder to ensure reconstruction quality
summary_en.experiments: Built on frozen video foundation models including V-JEPA 2 and VideoMAEv2, supporting both diffusion transformer and autoregressive generation paradigms; full experimental datasets, baselines, and quantitative results are not disclosed in the truncated abstract

recommendation.zh: 用冻结理解型视频基础模型构建生成式latent的思路有参考价值，对视觉tokenizer设计有微弱启发，看摘要和方法概览即可。
recommendation.en: The idea of building generative latents from frozen understanding-oriented video foundation models is worth noting; skim the method section for minor visual tokenizer design inspiration.

paper.title: Cycle-World: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Long-term Video World Models via Reverse-Prediction Cycle Consistency
paper.abstract: Autoregressive diffusion models have enabled high-quality video generation, yet their sequential nature inherently suffers from error accumulation. In long-horizon video synthesis, minor prediction deviations compound over time, inevitably leading to unconstrained generative drift, structural collapse, and severe visual degradation. To address this, we propose Cycle-World, a novel framework designed for stable and temporally consistent long-video generation. Our approach tackles error drift by e

summary.core_problem: 解决自回归视频扩散模型在长视频生成中误差逐步累积、导致结构漂移和画质退化的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成方法创新。它把长时序生成的稳定性问题形式化为可逆性约束问题，对 AR 生成和世界模型的误差传播有一定参考价值，但主要仍是视频生成范畴。
summary.technical_approach: Cycle-World 引入反向预测模型，在训练阶段通过 reverse-prediction cycle consistency 约束正向生成器，使生成序列能够被反向模型重建；推理阶段复用冻结的反向模型，对正向生成过程施加一致性约束，从而压制时间漂移。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出模型规模、训练数据、具体 baseline 或数值结果。实验主张面向长时视频合成，改善自回归 diffusion video model 的漂移、结构崩塌和视觉退化。
summary.authors_note: 作者中包括 Dacheng Tao，他在计算机视觉、生成模型和机器学习方向有长期代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses error accumulation in autoregressive diffusion-based long-video generation, where small prediction errors compound into temporal drift and visual collapse.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a method-level advance for video generation. It is relevant to researchers thinking about sequential generative drift and world-model stability, but it is not directly about language-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Cycle-World adds a reverse-prediction model and enforces cycle consistency between forward generation and backward prediction. During training, the reverse model injects a reversibility constraint into the forward generator; during inference, the frozen reverse model is reused to constrain generation and reduce drift.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training data, baselines, or quantitative gains. The claimed evaluation setting is long-horizon video synthesis, with improvements in temporal consistency and reduced structural degradation.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Dacheng Tao, a well-known researcher in computer vision, generative modeling, and machine learning.

recommendation.zh: 只看可逆性约束怎样压住长时漂移；它对 AR 误差传播有类比价值，但不必按 LLM 方法读。
recommendation.en: Skim the reversibility constraint for long-horizon drift control; it has analogies to AR error propagation, but it is not an LLM method paper.

paper.title: Is Energy Guidance All You Need? Training-Free Norm Injection for Driving World Models
paper.abstract: Driving world models built on large video-diffusion backbones generate realistic scenes but are hard to control: enforcing a traffic norm typically means retraining the backbone or conditioning it on hand-built layouts. We ask whether controllability requires training at all. Our experiment shows that a rectified-flow driving world model, which jointly generates future video and a planned ego trajectory, can have its planned trajectory steered entirely at sampling time by differentiable energy f

summary.core_problem: 现有基于大视频扩散骨干的驾驶世界模型可控性差，施加交通规范通常需要重训练骨干或依赖手工布局条件
summary.importance: 方法创新+实证分析，首次验证整流流驾驶世界模型可通过采样时的能量引导实现轨迹控制，无需重训练扩散骨干
summary.technical_approach: 在联合生成未来视频和自车轨迹的整流流世界模型中，采样时注入编码驾驶规范的可微能量函数，直接引导规划轨迹；基于Open-Sora 2.0 MM-DiT骨干实现
summary.experiments: 基于Open-Sora 2.0 MM-DiT骨干构建驾驶世界模型，验证可通过能量引导实现反事实目标下的刹车控制，但生成视频尚未跟随引导轨迹，跨流耦合是端到端可控的关键瓶颈

summary_en.core_problem: Existing driving world models built on large video diffusion backbones have poor controllability—enforcing traffic norms typically requires retraining the backbone or conditioning on hand-built layouts
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation and empirical analysis, first verifying that rectified-flow driving world models can achieve trajectory control via sampling-time energy guidance without retraining the diffusion backbone
summary_en.technical_approach: In a rectified-flow world model that jointly generates future video and ego trajectory, differentiable energy functions encoding driving norms are injected at sampling time to directly steer the planned trajectory; implemented on the Open-Sora 2.0 MM-DiT backbone
summary_en.experiments: Built on Open-Sora 2.0 MM-DiT backbone, verifies that energy guidance can achieve braking control under counterfactual targets, but generated videos do not yet follow the steered trajectory, with cross-stream coupling identified as the key bottleneck for end-to-end controllability

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型训练-free能量引导的思路对文本扩散LM可控生成有微弱参考，仅看摘要结论即可
recommendation.en: The training-free energy guidance idea offers marginal reference for controllable diffusion LM generation; only the abstract conclusion is needed

paper.title: Video Generation Models are General-Purpose Vision Learners
paper.abstract: Driven by next-token prediction, NLP shifted from task-specific models into powerful generalist foundation models. What, then, is the equivalent catalyst needed to achieve a general-purpose model in computer vision? In this paper, we contend that large-scale text-to-video generation serves as a strong pre-training paradigm for computer vision, providing the necessary spatiotemporal priors, vision-language alignment, and scalability required for general visual intelligence. We introduce GenCeptio

summary.core_problem: 计算机视觉缺少类似 NLP 中 next-token 预训练那样统一而可扩展的通用学习范式；这篇工作在问，大规模文本到视频生成是否可以充当这种视觉预训练催化剂。
summary.importance: 这是范式层面的多模态预训练主张。重要性不在某个下游任务，而在于它把视频生成 backbone 重新解释为通用视觉表征学习器，试图把生成式预训练和感知任务统一起来。对做统一多模态基座的人，价值在于它提供了“生成模型先学世界，再蒸馏成前馈感知器”的路线。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 GenCeption：先利用预训练的视频扩散生成骨干获得时空先验、视觉语言对齐和可扩展表示，再从该生成 backbone 派生一个前馈感知模型，用文本指令驱动完成多种视觉任务。核心不是简单拿 diffusion features 做线性 probing，而是把生成模型作为通用视觉 learner，再转成可执行感知器。
summary.experiments: 作者在深度估计、法线估计、相机位姿、表情指代分割、3D 关键点等多任务上评测，摘要声称达到或超过专用模型，如 DepthAnything3、SAM3 等。论文来自 Google DeepMind，作者名单包含 Kaiming He、Andrew Zisserman、Joao Carreira、Misha Andriluka 等。摘要未给出训练数据规模和参数量，但从设定看应依赖大规模 text-to-video 生成预训练。
summary.authors_note: Google DeepMind 工作。作者包含 Kaiming He、Andrew Zisserman、Joao Carreira、Misha Andriluka、Eduard Gabriel Bazavan 等，团队长期做视觉预训练、视频理解与生成建模。

summary_en.core_problem: Computer vision still lacks an equivalent of next-token pretraining in NLP: a unified and scalable learning paradigm. This paper asks whether large-scale text-to-video generation can play that role.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is paradigm-level rather than task-level. The key claim is that a video generative backbone can serve as a general-purpose visual learner, unifying generative pretraining and perception. For researchers working on unified multimodal foundation models, the interesting part is the route of learning the world through generation and then deriving a feed-forward perception model.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces GenCeption: a feed-forward perception model derived from a pretrained video diffusion generator. The generative backbone is expected to encode spatiotemporal priors, vision-language alignment, and scalable representations, while text instructions steer downstream perception tasks. This is more than feature extraction from a diffusion model; it reframes the generator itself as the pretraining substrate.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports strong results across depth estimation, surface normals, camera pose estimation, expression-referring segmentation, and 3D keypoint prediction, often matching or surpassing specialized models such as DepthAnything3 and SAM3. The paper comes from Google DeepMind and includes Kaiming He, Andrew Zisserman, Joao Carreira, and Misha Andriluka. Exact model sizes and training data scale are not given in the abstract, but the setup clearly relies on large-scale text-to-video generative pretraining.
summary_en.authors_note: A Google DeepMind paper with authors including Kaiming He, Andrew Zisserman, Joao Carreira, Misha Andriluka, and Eduard Gabriel Bazavan, all well known for work in visual pretraining, video understanding, and generative modeling.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变你对“生成模型只负责生成、感知模型另训”的先验；先看方法图和任务表，若 transfer 真干净，值得内部复现一条生成→感知路线。
recommendation.en: This can change the prior that generators are only for generation and perception needs separate pretraining; read the method figure and transfer tables first, and replicate internally if the transfer setup is clean.

paper.title: OPSD-V: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Post-Training Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generators
paper.abstract: We propose OPSD-V, an on-policy self-distillation paradigm for post-training few-step autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models. Existing few-step AR video generators can produce long videos with low latency, but still suffer from error accumulation and weakened motion dynamics during long autoregressive rollout. OPSD-V reduces long-horizon degradation while preserving the original few-step inference path. The key idea is to introduce real long-video data as temporal context during training and

summary.core_problem: 解决少步自回归视频扩散模型在长视频滚动生成时误差累积、运动动态变弱的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是视频生成后训练方法：把训练过程对齐到推理时的自回归轨迹，并用更干净的教师缓存提供逐去噪状态监督。它对研究长程生成中的 exposure bias 和 cache drift 有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OPSD-V，即 on-policy self-distillation。学生模型按真实推理路径生成每个视频块，并条件化在自己先前生成的 KV cache 上；教师在相同学生访问到的去噪状态上评估，但使用更干净的 AR-consistent temporal cache，其中旧历史可由真实长视频上下文替换，从而给出 dense denoising-level corrective targets。推理路径不变。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明方法用于 few-step AR video diffusion models，并引入真实长视频作为训练时 temporal context；声称减少长程退化并保持低延迟推理路径。未给出模型规模、数据规模、具体视频长度、基线和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses error accumulation and weakened motion dynamics in few-step autoregressive video diffusion models during long-horizon rollout.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a post-training method for video generation: align training with inference-time autoregressive trajectories and use a cleaner teacher cache for dense correction. It is relevant as a signal on exposure bias and cache drift in long-horizon generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: OPSD-V performs on-policy self-distillation. The student follows the exact inference rollout, generating each chunk conditioned on its own previously generated KV cache. The teacher is evaluated at the same student-visited denoising states, but uses a cleaner AR-consistent temporal cache where older history may be replaced by real-video context, producing dense denoising-level targets without changing inference.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract positions the method for few-step AR video diffusion models and uses real long-video data as temporal context. It claims reduced long-horizon degradation while preserving low-latency inference, but does not report model size, dataset size, rollout length, baselines, or numeric gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看训练-推理轨迹对齐这一点；它是视频生成论文，但 cache drift 设定可类比长程 AR LM。
recommendation.en: Skim only the train-inference trajectory alignment; it is a video paper, but the cache-drift setup maps cleanly to long-horizon AR LMs.

paper.title: Infinite Worlds with Versatile Interactions
paper.abstract: We present LingBot-World 2.0 (also known as LingBot-World-Infinity), an advanced iteration of LingBot-World featuring four distinct upgrades. (1) Our model achieves an unbounded interaction horizon while maintaining consistent output quality, benefiting from a carefully crafted causal pretraining paradigm. (2) Through distilling a real-time variant from the base model, our system guarantees rapid response time, sufficient to drive 720p video streams at 60 fps. (3) Compared to the previous versio

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的问题是：交互式世界模型在长时间自回归生成中容易漂移，同时高分辨率、低延迟、多动作交互很难兼顾。
summary.importance: 这篇论文和文本 LLM 预训练不是直接同一条线，但对多模态基座和世界模型预训练有参考意义。关键点有三个。第一，长时程 causal video generation 的稳定性问题类似语言模型长上下文和自回归误差累积，只是视觉域的错误更快显性化。第二，数据管线强调把异构视频转成带全局语义、局部状态、动作控制信号的训练样本，这对交互式视频预训练的数据组织方式有启发。第三，它把生成模型、实时蒸馏和 agentic harness 组合起来，说明世界模型不只是帧预测器，还需要外部控制、状态读取和事件调度机制才能形成可持续交互。
summary.technical_approach: 系统由四部分组成。第一是 causal world model 预训练，用因果方式逐帧或逐段生成，并针对长时间反馈误差设计训练范式，以提升生成稳定性。第二是数据引擎：原始视频来自自采第一视角视频、游戏和 Unreal Engine 合成数据、大规模网络视频；经过统一 metadata 规范、技术过滤、VLM profiling，再生成 video-level global captions 和 chunk-wise local captions。局部 caption 用于描述短时间状态变化、交互结果和控制敏感转移，全局 caption 提供场景语义上下文。第三是实时蒸馏：用较强的基础模型作为 teacher，蒸馏出可驱动 720p、60 fps 交互视频流的 student。第四是 agentic harness：pilot agent 根据当前画面选择角色动作，director agent 持续注入内容、道具、事件和环境变化，避免生成过程变成单调的被动漫游。
summary.experiments: 论文主张系统可以进行超过一小时的连续生成，视觉质量没有明显衰减，并支持 720p、60 fps 的实时交互。交互范围不只包括移动，还包括攻击、射箭、施法、射击，以及雨雪等文本驱动环境变化。对比表显示，已有开放或闭源世界模型通常稳定生成时间为分钟级，语义交互较少，动态程度有限；LingBot-World 2.0 的目标是小时级或无界交互，并保持开源和实时。可见的实验更偏系统验证和演示压力测试，量化指标细节需要重点核查，包括长时程质量如何度量、是否有自动指标、人工评测协议，以及蒸馏后相对 teacher 的质量损失。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 分钟。优先看 introduction 中对长时程漂移和实时性的定义，再看 data pipeline，因为这部分最接近预训练研究：数据来源、过滤、VLM profiling、全局/局部 caption、动作信号如何对齐。若时间有限，蒸馏和 agentic harness 部分可以快速扫过，重点确认它们是系统工程贡献还是训练范式贡献。实验部分要带着两个问题读：一小时稳定生成是如何评估的；720p 60 fps 是单卡、多卡还是特定部署配置下实现的。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two bottlenecks in interactive world models: drift during long-horizon causal video generation, and the difficulty of maintaining high-resolution, low-latency, action-conditioned interaction.
summary_en.importance: The work is not directly about text LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to multimodal foundation models and world-model pretraining. The long-horizon stability issue is the visual analogue of autoregressive error accumulation, where small prediction errors are fed back into the model and become visible as texture smear, geometry distortion, or scene drift. The data pipeline is also informative: heterogeneous videos are converted into training examples with global semantics, local state descriptions, and control-sensitive transitions. This is a useful design pattern for interactive video pretraining. The agentic harness adds another lesson: a generative world model needs state inspection, action selection, and event scheduling to behave like an open-ended environment rather than a passive frame predictor.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system combines a causal video-generation backbone, a structured data engine, a real-time distilled student, and an agentic interaction layer. The data engine normalizes videos from self-collected egocentric footage, synthetic game and Unreal Engine environments, and web-scale video sources. It applies technical filtering and VLM-based profiling, then produces video-level global captions and chunk-level local captions. The local annotations describe state changes, interaction outcomes, and control-sensitive transitions; the global captions provide scene-level semantic context. The base model is trained with a causal pretraining paradigm intended to reduce feedback-induced drift. A smaller real-time variant is then distilled from the base model to support interactive 720p video at 60 fps. On top of the generator, a pilot agent chooses actions from the current scene, while a director agent injects new content, props, events, and environmental changes.
summary_en.experiments: The reported system-level result is an uninterrupted session exceeding one hour, with no visible quality decay, and real-time rendering at 720p and 60 fps. The action space includes navigation as well as attacks, archery, spell-casting, shooting, and text-driven weather or environment changes. The comparison table positions prior systems as mostly minute-scale, with limited semantic interaction and varying dynamic richness, while LingBot-World 2.0 targets hour-scale or unbounded interaction with open-source release and real-time operation. The visible evidence is mainly a stress test and qualitative/system comparison. The most important details to verify are the long-horizon evaluation protocol, any automatic or human quality metrics, the hardware used for 720p 60 fps serving, and the quality gap between the distilled model and the teacher.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Start with the introduction to understand how the paper defines drift, interactivity, and real-time constraints. Then read the data pipeline carefully, since it is the part most relevant to pretraining: source mixture, filtering, VLM profiling, global and local captions, and action-signal alignment. The distillation and agentic harness sections can be read more selectively unless the deployment setup is of interest. In the experiments, focus on two checks: how the one-hour stability claim is measured, and what compute configuration is required for 720p 60 fps interaction.

recommendation.zh: 读 causal pretraining 和实时蒸馏部分；若评测干净，它会影响交互式世界模型的数据闭环设计。
recommendation.en: Skim the causal pretraining and distillation parts; if the eval is clean, it matters for interactive world-model data loops.

paper.title: OpenCoF: Learning to Reason Through Video Generation
paper.abstract: Reasoning has become a core capability for large models, especially when reliable decisions require understanding logical consequences. Recent video generation models offer a reasoning path distinct from previous Chain-of-Thought (CoT): reasoning can unfold through temporally connected frames, known as Chain-of-Frame (CoF) reasoning. However, existing video generators are primarily trained on general video corpora, still lacking diverse supervision and dedicated designs for CoF reasoning. To add

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想解决的问题是：视频生成模型是否能通过“逐帧展开”的方式承担一部分视觉推理，而不只是生成看起来合理的视频。现有视频生成模型主要从通用视频语料学习，缺少面向因果、空间、物理、逻辑连续性的监督；已有 CoF 相关工作也更多停留在评测，或者只覆盖迷宫、认知题等窄任务。OpenCoF 试图补上训练数据和模型机制两部分空缺。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的启发主要在两个层面。第一，它把视频生成从感知质量问题推进到“生成过程能否承载中间推理状态”的问题，这和 AR 语言模型里的 CoT 类似，但载体从 token 序列变成时间连续的视觉帧。第二，它提供了一个小规模但结构化的 reasoning-centric 视频数据配方，可以用来观察数据监督、条件图像、文本 prompt、视觉 latent token 之间如何共同影响视频模型的推理行为。它不是通用 LLM 预训练论文，但对跨模态统一建模、视频 tokenizer/latent 表示、生成式世界模型的训练信号设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两步。第一步是数据驱动的 fine-tuning：作者构建 OpenCoF-17K，共 17,312 个样本，覆盖 11 类任务。每个样本由初始条件图像、文本 prompt 和目标 reasoning video 组成，统一为 480p、15 fps、81 帧，以降低不同数据源带来的优化噪声。数据来自四条路径：基于实例的渲染、专家引导渲染、程序化场景合成、已有视频重用。作者用这批数据微调开源视频生成模型 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B，得到 Wan-CoF，用来验证仅靠多样的时间监督是否能诱发 CoF 行为。第二步是模型机制探索：在 DiT 视频生成器中加入两类 reasoning token。Visual Reasoning Tokens 插入视觉 latent 序列，偏向捕获局部视觉线索和低层状态；Textual Reasoning Tokens 加到文本条件序列，偏向提供高层语义先验。两者的区别在于干预位置不同：前者直接改变生成 latent 的信息组织，后者通过条件通道影响 denoising。作者还用注意力分析观察这些 token 在模型深度、去噪步、空间维度和时间维度上的作用。
summary.experiments: 实验主线是把 Wan-CoF 及其 reasoning-token 变体放到四个外部视频推理 benchmark 上评估，并与基座 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B 对比。提供的正文片段明确说明，单纯使用 OpenCoF-17K 微调已经在四个外部 benchmark 上取得明显提升；加入 Visual Reasoning Tokens 或 Textual Reasoning Tokens 后还能继续提升，并且两类 token 在不同任务维度上表现出不同优势。可确认的规模信息包括：基座模型为 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B，数据集为 17,312 条视频，统一 480p、15 fps、81 帧。当前可见内容没有给出具体 benchmark 名称、逐项分数、提升幅度和消融表数值，因此不应把性能结论解读为已经证明了通用视频推理能力，只能说明这套数据和 token 机制在作者选定的外部评测上带来了稳定正向信号。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看三部分：第一，OpenCoF-17K 的数据构成表和 11 个任务族，判断它覆盖的是物理推理、空间变换、符号逻辑，还是偏合成任务；第二，Wan-CoF 与基座模型在四个外部 benchmark 上的结果表，重点看是否存在只对相近分布任务有效的情况；第三，Visual/Textual Reasoning Tokens 的消融和注意力可视化，关注 token 插入位置为什么会影响不同推理维度。若关心预训练，可重点追问两个问题：这些 reasoning videos 是否能扩展到更大规模、更多自然视频分布；以及 CoF 监督是否能和语言 CoT、动作 token、世界模型 latent 统一起来。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether video generators can perform part of visual reasoning by unfolding consequences through frames, rather than merely producing visually plausible clips. Existing video generators are trained mostly on generic video corpora and receive little supervision for causal, spatial, physical, and logical continuity. Prior Chain-of-Frame work has also been evaluation-heavy or tied to narrow domains such as maze solving. OpenCoF addresses both the data gap and the lack of model-side mechanisms for reasoning-oriented video generation.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is not the downstream video benchmark itself, but the formulation. The work treats video generation as a carrier of intermediate reasoning state, analogous to how Chain-of-Thought uses text tokens, but with temporally connected visual frames. It also gives a concrete recipe for reasoning-centric video supervision: paired initial images, text prompts, and target reasoning videos. This is relevant to native multimodal pretraining, video latent modeling, world-model-like generation, and the design of training signals that go beyond perceptual realism.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two stages. First, the authors build OpenCoF-17K, a dataset of 17,312 videos across 11 task families. Each example contains an initial conditioning image, a textual prompt, and a target reasoning video. Videos are normalized to 480p, 15 fps, and 81 frames to reduce optimization mismatch across sources. The curation pipeline combines instance-based rendering, expert-guided rendering, procedural scene synthesis, and repurposed existing videos. Wan2.2-I2V-A14B is then fine-tuned on this dataset to produce Wan-CoF, testing whether diverse temporal supervision alone can elicit Chain-of-Frame behavior. Second, the paper studies two reasoning-token designs for DiT-based video generation. Visual Reasoning Tokens are inserted into the visual latent sequence and are meant to capture lower-level visual cues. Textual Reasoning Tokens are appended to the text-conditioning sequence and provide higher-level semantic priors. The two designs intervene at different places: one directly reshapes latent visual generation, while the other modulates denoising through the conditioning path. Attention analysis is used to inspect their effects across layers, denoising steps, space, and time.
summary_en.experiments: The main evaluation compares Wan-CoF and its reasoning-token variants against the base Wan2.2-I2V-A14B on four external video-reasoning benchmarks. From the provided full-text excerpt, the confirmed result is that fine-tuning on OpenCoF-17K improves the base model across these external benchmarks, and both Visual and Textual Reasoning Tokens further improve performance with different strengths across task dimensions. Confirmed scale details are: 17,312 training videos, 11 task families, 480p resolution, 15 fps, 81 frames, and a Wan2.2-I2V-A14B base model. The visible text does not include exact benchmark names, per-task scores, or ablation numbers, so the result should be read as evidence that the data and token mechanisms provide positive training signals, not as a definitive demonstration of general video reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on three parts: the OpenCoF-17K task taxonomy and dataset statistics; the table comparing Wan-CoF with the base model on four external benchmarks; and the ablations for Visual versus Textual Reasoning Tokens, especially the attention visualizations. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main questions are whether this supervision can scale beyond curated or synthetic tasks, whether the learned CoF behavior transfers to natural video distributions, and how frame-based reasoning could be combined with textual CoT, action tokens, or latent world-model training.

recommendation.zh: 可扫数据构造和 CoF 消融；它改变不了语言预训练，但提示视觉 reasoning 监督可能不该只靠文本 CoT。
recommendation.en: Skim the data construction and CoF ablations; it will not change LM pretraining directly, but it challenges text-only supervision for visual reasoning.

paper.title: MoWorld: A Flash World Model
paper.abstract: The future of World Models depends not only on scaling model capability, but also on scaling practicality and inference efficiency. High-frame-rate inference enables responsive perception, planning, and control in real-world autonomous systems. To this end, we present MoWorld, a cost-effective yet high-performance Flash World Model with an end-to-end framework spanning data generation, pre-training, distillation, and efficient inference, enabling up to 50 FPS real-time interaction with cinematic

summary.core_problem: 面向真实交互系统，构建能以较低成本实现高帧率推理的视觉世界模型。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在多模态生成和世界模型工程链路：把数据生成、预训练、蒸馏和高效推理放在同一套框架里优化，目标不是单纯提高视频质量，而是让世界模型具备接近实时交互能力。
summary.technical_approach: MoWorld 使用可扩展的 3D-native 数据引擎，而不是主要依赖大规模自然视频语料；该数据引擎从 3D 视觉和生成建模流水线中构造几何一致的训练数据。系统还包含预训练、蒸馏和推理优化，以在普通硬件上提升交互帧率。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称可达到最高 50 FPS 的实时交互，并保持电影级视觉质量，且不依赖高端 GPU。给出的信息未包含模型参数量、训练数据规模、具体 baseline、消融结果或量化提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets practical visual world models that can run at high frame rates for real-time interaction.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly an engineering-oriented multimodal generation pipeline: data generation, pre-training, distillation, and efficient inference are optimized jointly for deployable world modeling rather than only visual fidelity.
summary_en.technical_approach: MoWorld relies on a scalable 3D-native data engine instead of primarily using large-scale video corpora. The engine produces geometrically consistent training data from a 3D vision and generative modeling pipeline, followed by pre-training, distillation, and inference optimization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims up to 50 FPS real-time interaction with cinematic visual quality without high-end GPUs. It does not provide model size, data scale, detailed baselines, ablations, or numerical gains in the supplied text.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据引擎和蒸馏链路即可；它像世界模型工程报告，对语言预训练没有直接方法增益。
recommendation.en: Skim only the data engine and distillation pipeline; this is closer to a world-model engineering report than a direct signal for LM pretraining.

paper.title: Prompt-Adapter Context Routing for Parameter-Efficient Multi-Shot Long Video Extrapolation
paper.abstract: We present PACR-Video, a parameter-efficient framework for multi-shot long video extrapolation that preserves recurring entities, scene structure, visual style, and causal progression without full generator fine-tuning. PACR-Video keeps a text-to-video diffusion transformer frozen and augments it with low-rank temporal adapters conditioned by learned shot-role prompt tokens. To maintain long-horizon coherence, it builds a recursive prompt bank that stores compact entity, location, action, and st

summary.core_problem: 解决多镜头长视频外推中实体、场景结构、风格和事件因果关系随时间漂移的问题，同时避免完整微调视频生成器。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成方法改进。它把长程视频一致性问题拆成“历史提示压缩、镜头依赖路由、轻量适配器组合”，对长上下文生成的记忆组织有一定参考价值，但离 LLM 基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PACR-Video：冻结 text-to-video diffusion transformer，只加入低秩时序 adapter；用学习到的 shot-role prompt tokens 条件化 adapter；递归 prompt bank 保存前序镜头中的实体、地点、动作和风格提示；根据预测的叙事依赖通过 adapter gates 路由上下文。训练目标包含下一镜头重建、跨镜头身份对比和 prompt 稀疏正则，并用 adapter composition schedule 平衡早期一致性和后期事件推进。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 6 个多镜头和长视频 benchmark 上优于 text-to-video、tuning-based、memory-based 等基线，但未给出具体模型规模、训练数据规模、提升幅度或显著性信息。实验可信度需要看任务设置是否避免了 prompt leakage 和人工标注依赖。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets long multi-shot video extrapolation, where recurring entities, scene layout, style, and causal event progression tend to drift over time without expensive full generator fine-tuning.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal generation method contribution. Its main relevance is the decomposition of long-horizon coherence into compact prompt memory, dependency-aware routing, and lightweight adapter composition, which is mildly informative for long-context generative systems but not central to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: PACR-Video freezes a text-to-video diffusion transformer and adds low-rank temporal adapters conditioned on learned shot-role prompt tokens. It maintains a recursive prompt bank storing compact entity, location, action, and style prompts from previous shots, then routes them through gated adapters based on predicted narrative dependencies. The objective combines next-shot reconstruction, cross-shot identity contrast, and prompt sparsity regularization, with a schedule that trades off early visual consistency against later event progression and viewpoint changes.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports improvements over text-to-video, tuning-based, and memory-based baselines on six multi-shot and long-video benchmarks, but does not provide model size, training data scale, numeric gains, or statistical details. The key question is whether the setup controls prompt leakage and dependency annotation bias.

recommendation.zh: 作为长程生成的记忆路由案例看即可；预训练研究员扫方法图和 loss 设计，不必细读实验表。
recommendation.en: Useful as a memory-routing case study for long-horizon generation; skim the method diagram and losses, not the benchmark tables.

paper.title: RotateAttention: RoPE-Aware Rotation and Range Rectification for INT4 Quantized Attention in Video Generation
paper.abstract: In \textbf{DiT-based video generation models equipped with 3D Rotary Position Embeddings (3D RoPE)}, the attention mechanism remains a primary computational bottleneck due to its quadratic complexity with respect to sequence length. While quantized \textbf{FlashAttention} offers a promising path toward hardware acceleration, existing low-bit quantization methods overlook two critical challenges in this setting: \textbf{1)} applying online rotation matrices -- a widely used technique for mitigati

summary.core_problem: 在使用 3D RoPE 的 DiT 视频生成模型中，将注意力模块做 INT4 量化加速，同时避免 RoPE 与低比特旋转/量化策略冲突。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率和低比特注意力优化。虽然目标是视频生成 DiT，不是 LLM，但 RoPE-aware attention quantization、outlier 处理和 FlashAttention 量化路径对长序列 LLM 推理有可迁移的工程信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RotateAttention，一个 mixed-precision INT4 FlashAttention 方案。核心观察是 Q/K outlier 分布受 3D RoPE 维度划分显著影响；方法针对 RoPE 调整在线旋转矩阵使用方式，并对非负注意力矩阵 P 的量化范围做 rectification，减少对称量化浪费动态范围的问题。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体视频模型规模、视频长度、硬件平台、速度提升或质量指标变化。实验应围绕 DiT-based video generation with 3D RoPE，对比常规低比特量化和量化 FlashAttention 的效率与生成质量。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology 及独立研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets INT4 quantized attention for DiT-based video generation models using 3D RoPE, where RoPE interacts poorly with common rotation-based outlier mitigation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency method for low-bit attention. Although the target is video DiT rather than LLMs, the RoPE-aware treatment of Q/K outliers and quantized FlashAttention has transferable engineering value for long-sequence models.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes RotateAttention, a mixed-precision INT4 FlashAttention method. The key observation is that Q/K outlier distributions are strongly affected by the dimensional partitioning of 3D RoPE. The method adapts online rotations to RoPE and rectifies the quantization range for the non-negative attention matrix P to avoid wasting half of the symmetric INT4 range.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, video lengths, hardware setup, speedups, or quality deltas. The evaluation is expected to compare RotateAttention with existing low-bit and quantized FlashAttention baselines on DiT video generation models with 3D RoPE.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed affiliations are The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and Independent Researcher.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和方法图就够；RoPE 与 INT4 attention 的冲突是真问题，但视频 DiT 结论需谨慎迁移到 LLM。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and method figure; the RoPE–INT4 attention conflict is real, but results from video DiTs should be transferred to LLMs cautiously.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Flex-Forcing: Towards a Unified Autoregressive and Bidirectional Video Diffusion Model
paper.abstract: Recent progress in large-scale generative models has substantially advanced video generation, yet existing methods remain constrained by a rigid inference paradigm. Bidirectional diffusion models excel at global coherence and visual fidelity but suffer from slow inference, while autoregressive models offer efficient and streaming generation at the cost of long-range consistency and exposure bias. We introduce Flex-Forcing, a unified training and inference framework that enables a video diffusion

summary.core_problem: 视频生成的两大主流范式优势互补但无法在单模型内兼容：双向扩散模型全局一致性好、视觉质量高，但推理开销大、难以支持长视频或流式场景；自回归模型推理快、天然支持长序列流式生成，但存在误差累积、长程一致性差的问题；缺乏统一的训练推理框架，让单模型能在两种范式及中间态灵活切换，适配不同的算力与延迟需求。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发包括：自回归与双向扩散两类生成范式并非互斥，可通过统一的分块机制与训练目标在单模型内兼容，这一范式统一的思路可迁移到其他多模态或序列建模的预训练任务（如文本-视频统一生成、具身序列多范式建模）；该设计消除了为不同部署约束单独训练模型的需求，为生成式基座模型的灵活部署提供了预训练层面的解决方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Flex-Forcing统一框架，核心设计沿两个正交维度展开：1）双轴灵活分块：在「时间帧轴」和「去噪步轴」上定义可变粒度的分块规则，自回归与双向推理是分块的两个极端情况，训练时让模型暴露在混合因果/非因果的条件上下文中，学习跨范式兼容的表征；2）噪声对齐机制：解决因果上下文（过去token去噪更充分）与非因果上下文（未来token噪声更高）的噪声水平不一致问题，强制两类注意力上下文的表征保持一致；3）训练推理目标对齐，测试时可自由切换三种模式：纯双向（高质量）、纯自回归（高效流式/长视频）、半自回归混合（质量效率折中）。
summary.experiments: 在短视频与长视频基准上的测试结果显示：1）相比Self-Forcing等因果基线，质量-效率的帕累托前沿明显更优；2）纯双向模式下的生成性能与原生双向扩散模型相当；3）额外支持任意顺序、任意步长的自回归视频编辑，可在保留全局时序一致性的前提下完成局部时间域编辑。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3节的双轴灵活分块定义、噪声对齐机制，以及实验部分的帕累托前沿对比结果；可跳过基础视频扩散模型的底层实现细节。预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Two dominant video generation paradigms have complementary strengths but cannot coexist in a single model: bidirectional diffusion models deliver strong global coherence and high visual quality but suffer from high inference overhead, making them unsuitable for long-video or streaming scenarios; autoregressive models support fast, streaming long-sequence generation but face error accumulation and poor long-range consistency. No unified training-inference framework exists to enable a single model to flexibly switch between both paradigms and intermediate regimes for varying compute and latency requirements.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, this work demonstrates that autoregressive and bidirectional diffusion paradigms are not mutually exclusive, and can be unified in a single model via structured chunking mechanisms and consistent training objectives. This paradigm-unification principle is transferable to pretraining for other multimodal or sequential tasks (e.g., unified text-video generation, embodied sequence modeling). It also eliminates the need to train separate models for distinct deployment constraints, providing a pretraining-level solution for flexible generative foundation model serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: Flex-Forcing is a unified framework built around two core designs: 1) Dual-axis flexible chunking: variable-granularity chunking rules are defined over two orthogonal axes (the temporal frame axis and the denoising step axis), with autoregressive and bidirectional inference treated as two extreme cases of this formulation. During training, the model is exposed to mixed causal and non-causal conditioning contexts to learn cross-paradigm compatible representations. 2) Noise alignment mechanism: resolves the noise-level discrepancy between causal contexts (past tokens are more denoised) and non-causal contexts (future tokens are noisier) by enforcing representation consistency across the two attention settings. 3) Training and inference objectives are fully aligned, enabling test-time switching between three modes: pure bidirectional (high quality), pure autoregressive (efficient streaming/long-video), and semi-autoregressive hybrid (quality-efficiency trade-off).
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on both short-form and long-form video benchmarks: 1) It achieves a markedly improved Pareto frontier of generation quality vs. inference efficiency compared to causal baselines including Self-Forcing; 2) Its pure bidirectional mode matches the generation performance of native bidirectional diffusion models; 3) It additionally supports any-order, any-step autoregressive video editing, enabling localized temporal edits while preserving global temporal coherence.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the dual-axis flexible chunking definition and noise alignment mechanism, plus the Pareto frontier comparison in experiments. Skip low-level implementation details of base video diffusion models. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 跨维度分块统一AR与双向扩散的思路可直接迁移到文本建模范式（如AR+MDLM混合生成），重点看§3的分块机制设计
recommendation.en: The cross-dimensional chunking design unifying AR and bidirectional diffusion can directly transfer to text modeling paradigms (e.g., hybrid AR+MDLM generation); focus on Section 3 for chunking mechanism details.

paper.title: ProxyUp: Training-Free Proxy-Conditioned Video Generation for Controllable Dynamics
paper.abstract: Precise control over complex dynamics remains challenging for modern video generative models, as text prompts alone often cannot specify physically plausible, fine-grained motion and interactions. We introduce $\textit{proxy-conditioned video generation}$, where a coarse proxy video from physics-based simulation or real-world recording serves as a dynamics carrier to control foreground object motion. Given a proxy video and a text prompt, the goal is to synthesize a new video that preserves the

summary.core_problem: 文本提示难以精确控制视频生成中的复杂运动，论文希望用粗糙代理视频提供可控的动态轨迹。
summary.importance: 这是视频生成控制方法，贡献在于训练自由的 proxy-conditioned 生成流程；对统一多模态预训练的直接贡献不大，但对“外部动态载体如何进入生成模型”有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: ProxyUp 不重新训练视频生成模型，而是先将代理视频反演到中间 latent 表示，再做 region-wise latent noising：保留与运动相关的区域 latent，同时对需要按文本重生成的区域注入噪声，从而在保留 proxy 动态的同时生成新内容。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明代理视频可来自物理仿真或真实录制，并用于控制前景物体运动；未给出具体基座视频模型、数据规模、baseline、指标或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the difficulty of controlling complex motion in video generation using text alone, by introducing coarse proxy videos as carriers of dynamics.
summary_en.importance: This is a controllable video generation method. Its main contribution is a training-free proxy-conditioned generation pipeline; it is only indirectly relevant to unified multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ProxyUp avoids paired proxy-target training. It inverts a proxy video into an intermediate latent representation and applies region-wise latent noising, preserving motion-critical proxy latents while adding noise to regions that should be regenerated according to the text prompt.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that proxy videos can come from physics simulation or real recordings and are used to control foreground object motion. It does not provide the underlying video model, data scale, baselines, metrics, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看 latent noising 设计即可；它是生成控制技巧，不是统一建模或预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Skim the latent-noising design only; this is a generation-control trick, not a unified modeling or pretraining recipe.

paper.title: WorldDirector: Building Controllable World Simulators with Persistent Dynamic Memory
paper.abstract: We present WorldDirector, a highly controllable video world model framework designed for persistent dynamic object memory and unrestricted viewpoint exploration. Unlike existing world models that entangle physical dynamics with pixel rendering and rely on continuous visual observation to sustain motion, our framework explicitly decouples semantic motion orchestration from visual generation. By leveraging an LLM to coordinate 3D trajectories with camera movements and subsequently employing these

summary.core_problem: 解决视频世界模型在长事件生成中难以保持动态物体身份、离屏后再出现不稳定、视角探索受限的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成系统创新。它把语义级运动编排从像素生成中拆出来，用 LLM 组织 3D 轨迹和相机运动，再把轨迹作为视频生成控制信号；对世界模型和长程视频生成有方法参考，但不是 LLM 基座训练工作。
summary.technical_approach: WorldDirector 显式解耦 physical dynamics 与 pixel rendering：先由 LLM 协调动态实体的 3D 轨迹和相机运动，形成可执行的语义运动计划；再将这些轨迹输入视频生成模块，作为强控制条件。这样避免依赖持续视觉观测来维持运动状态，并尝试让离屏对象重新入镜时保持身份一致。
summary.experiments: 摘要称方法支持复杂长事件合成、不受限视角探索、动态对象持久记忆和外观身份稳定；未提供模型规模、训练数据、baseline 名称或定量指标。项目页存在，但摘要没有足够实验细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets long-horizon video world models that fail to preserve dynamic object identity, lose objects after they leave the view, and restrict camera exploration.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal generation system design. It separates semantic motion orchestration from pixel rendering by using an LLM to coordinate 3D trajectories and camera motion, then feeds those trajectories as controls to video generation. This is relevant to world-model design but not directly to LLM base pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: WorldDirector explicitly decouples physical dynamics from visual rendering. An LLM first produces coordinated 3D trajectories for dynamic entities and camera movement; these trajectories then condition a video generator. The design avoids relying on continuous visual observation to maintain state and aims to preserve entity identity after long out-of-view intervals.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims support for complex extended events, unrestricted viewpoint exploration, persistent dynamic object memory, and stable appearance identity. It does not report model size, training-data scale, named baselines, or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 读系统图和轨迹控制部分就够；它对“LLM 做世界模型状态层”有参考，但证据强度取决于项目页实验细节。
recommendation.en: Skim the system diagram and trajectory-control design; the useful signal is the LLM-as-state-layer idea, while the evidence depends on details beyond the abstract.

paper.title: NeoMap: Training-free Novel-View Synthesis from Single Images and Videos
paper.abstract: We study the challenging problem of novel view video synthesis from single images or monocular videos. Existing methods, which operate under the assumption that pre-trained video models lack native novel view synthesis capability and enforce view alignment via camera conditioning, task-specific fine-tuning, or stepwise hard denoising guidance, often suffer from artifacts and compromised global scene consistency. In this paper, we introduce NeoMap, a novel training-free framework designed to loca

summary.core_problem: 在不训练或微调的情况下，从单张图像或单目视频生成视角一致的新视角视频。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成中的 training-free 推理方法，核心价值在于检验通用预训练视频模型是否已经隐含三维视角变化能力；对统一多模态预训练有弱相关参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: NeoMap 不增加相机条件、不做任务微调，而是在预训练视频模型的自然视频流形中搜索满足新视角约束的解；核心机制是对初始噪声进行收敛的流形交替投影迭代，以定位更符合视角一致性的生成轨迹。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在单图像和单目视频 novel-view video synthesis 上做了广泛实验，并显示比依赖相机条件、微调或硬去噪引导的方法有更好的保真度和全局场景一致性；摘要未给出模型名称、数据规模或具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles training-free novel-view video synthesis from a single image or monocular video.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an inference-time method for multimodal generation, mainly testing whether general pretrained video models already contain usable 3D view-change capability. This is only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: NeoMap avoids camera conditioning and task-specific fine-tuning. It searches the natural-video manifold of a pretrained video model by optimizing the initial noise through convergent alternating projection iterations, aiming to locate a view-consistent generation trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports broad experiments on single-image and monocular-video novel-view synthesis, with better fidelity and global consistency than camera-conditioned, fine-tuned, or hard-denoising-guided baselines. It does not specify model scale, datasets, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和消融即可；有用的是“调噪声找流形解”这个 prior，别把它当视频预训练结论。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure and ablations; the useful prior is noise-space manifold search, not a clean conclusion about video pretraining.

paper.title: HandsOnWorld: Unconstrained Egocentric Video Generation with Camera-Disentangled Hand Control
paper.abstract: We present HandsOnWorld, a framework for hand-controlled egocentric video generation that forgoes multi-view and marker-based motion capture, learning instead from unconstrained monocular video. Such generality is bottlenecked by the scarcity of scalable 3D hand annotations: large egocentric corpora lack finger-level labels, whereas precise hand datasets are confined to narrow, instrumented settings, limiting prior hand-controlled generators to restricted scene distributions. We instead annotate

summary.core_problem: 解决第一视角视频生成中，手部动作控制依赖多视角或动捕数据、难以扩展到真实开放场景的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成系统和数据管线创新。它把 in-the-wild 单目第一视角视频转成可控手部轨迹数据，缓解手控视频生成的数据瓶颈；对统一多模态预训练的启发主要在于控制信号标注和视频动作 token 化，而不是语言模型本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 HandsOnWorld 框架，先用单目重建在开放第一视角视频上自动标注 3D 手部轨迹，再用动作语义、图像质量和 3D 几何一致性进行过滤，构建 EgoVid-Pro。模型侧提出 Plücker Hand Map，将手部控制从强 ego-motion 摄像机运动中解耦，作为视频生成的几何控制表示。
summary.experiments: 构建 EgoVid-Pro，包含 103K clips、约 12M frames，覆盖多种日常第一视角场景。摘要未给出生成模型规模、训练 token/frame 数、baseline 名称或具体指标；核心实验应比较无约束场景中手部可控性、视频质量和动作一致性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets egocentric video generation with controllable hands, without relying on multi-view capture or marker-based motion-capture setups.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a video generation system and data pipeline. It turns in-the-wild monocular egocentric videos into scalable hand-control supervision, which is only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining through control annotation and action representation design.
summary_en.technical_approach: HandsOnWorld reconstructs 3D hands from unconstrained monocular egocentric videos, then filters trajectories by action semantics, image quality, and 3D geometry to build EgoVid-Pro. The Plücker Hand Map is introduced to separate hand control from large camera ego-motion and provide a geometry-aware conditioning signal for generation.
summary_en.experiments: EgoVid-Pro contains 103K clips and roughly 12M frames from diverse everyday egocentric scenes. The abstract does not specify model size, training budget, baselines, or metric deltas; the main evaluation likely measures hand controllability, visual quality, and action consistency.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据过滤和 Plücker Hand Map；它对视频控制表示有参考价值，但不改变 LM 预训练判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the filtering pipeline and the Plücker Hand Map; useful for video control representation, not for changing LM pretraining priors.

paper.title: Towards Memory-Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation via Instance-Specific Parametric Absorption
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) streaming models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for long video generation. However, the linearly growing Key-Value (KV) cache poses a significant bottleneck, leading to memory overload and degraded inference throughput. A common compression method is to drop redundant KV tokens, which often breaks long-range dependencies, resulting in temporal flickering and identity loss. In this paper, we propose Instance-Specific Parametric Absorption (ISPA), a novel framework that sh

summary.core_problem: 解决自回归长视频生成中 KV cache 随时间线性增长，导致显存爆炸和吞吐下降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于推理效率与缓存压缩。虽然场景是视频生成，不是文本 LLM，但“不要丢 KV，而是把历史吸收到参数里”的思路，对长上下文推理和实例级缓存压缩有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ISPA（Instance-Specific Parametric Absorption）。方法在短暂 warmup 后，监控全局注意力与局部注意力的输出差异，在切换点求解一个闭式最小二乘问题，得到 instance-specific 的权重调制项，把历史上下文“吸收”进部分层参数中；随后将部分层从 full attention 切到 local attention，以减少 KV cache 负担。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明其目标是 AR streaming video generation，主要对比常见的 KV token 丢弃式压缩方法，关注显存、吞吐以及时序闪烁和身份保持。未在摘要中给出模型参数量、数据规模和具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the linear KV-cache growth in autoregressive long-video generation, which causes memory blow-up and poor inference throughput.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper. The setting is video generation rather than text LLMs, but the idea of absorbing history into parameters instead of dropping KV tokens is still mildly relevant for long-context inference research.
summary_en.technical_approach: ISPA (Instance-Specific Parametric Absorption) performs a brief warmup, measures the discrepancy between global and local attention, and at a transition point solves a closed-form least-squares problem to obtain an instance-specific weight modulation. This lets some layers switch from full attention to local attention while compensating for lost global context through temporary parameter adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates evaluation on autoregressive streaming video generation, mainly against token-dropping KV compression baselines, with metrics around memory, throughput, temporal flicker, and identity preservation. Model size, data scale, and exact gains are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 不是文本 LLM，但思路有点意思：把 cache 压缩从删 token 改成实例级参数吸收。先看闭式解那一节；若代价太高，对 LLM 未必成立。
recommendation.en: Not a text-LLM paper, but the angle is interesting: turn cache compression from token dropping into instance-specific parameter absorption. Read the closed-form adaptation section first; the overhead may kill it for LLMs.

paper.title: Bridging Video Understanding and Generation in a Unified Framework
paper.abstract: Recently, unified image generation and understanding have been extensively explored. However, extending such unified modeling paradigms to the video domain remains largely underexplored. A central challenge is that video understanding favors compact, discriminative semantic representations, whereas video generation requires dense signals that preserve visual details and temporal coherence. Videos naturally capture both spatial semantics and temporal dynamics, making them a more suitable modality

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个统一建模里的老问题在视频域的具体版本：视频理解需要紧凑、判别性的语义表征，视频生成需要高保真、时序连续的密集信号，这两类目标往往把模型推向不同表示空间。纯 AR 视频建模通常受限于视频 token 数量过大、时间冗余高、像素级离散化信噪比低；而把 MLLM 接到 diffusion decoder 后面虽然能做生成，但理解和生成仍是松耦合的两套系统。作者想做的是一个真正共享表示、同时支持视频理解和视频生成的统一框架。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的启发主要有两点。第一，它延续了近两年多模态统一建模的一条重要路线：不要在像素 token 上硬做统一，而是先找到一个更接近语义层、同时又能被生成器消费的共享视觉词表，再让 AR 和 diffusion 各做自己擅长的部分。第二，它把“生成作为理解的辅助监督”明确写进训练目标，而不是只把生成模块当作下游附属头。这对 native multimodal pretrain 很有参考价值，尤其是视频这种高冗余模态：如果共享 token 设计得对，生成损失不只是为了出视频，也能反过来约束理解表征。论文的价值更多在范式和系统设计，而不是某一个单点技巧。
summary.technical_approach: Vega 的核心设计是 shared vocabulary + hybrid AR-diffusion。文本和视觉都被映射到统一的离散 token 空间，但视频生成不是直接在像素级 token 上做长序列 AR，而是在语义视觉 token 上做自回归，预测关键帧级别的高层语义状态；随后再由 diffusion decoder 把这些语义表示渲染成连续视频。这样分工的原因很明确：AR 更适合建模离散、高层、带因果结构的状态转移，diffusion 更适合补足局部纹理、运动连续性和像素细节。如果把两者都压到同一层级，要么 AR 序列过长、训练困难，要么 diffusion 缺少足够稳定的语义锚点。为了让语义 token 真正成为理解和生成之间的桥，作者强调两点。其一，语义 token 比传统 VQ 像素 token 更紧凑，能显著减少视频 token 数量，缓解时间冗余。其二，这些 token 与文本 token 处在更可对齐的语义层级，因此更适合统一建模。针对生成侧，作者采用 video-centric formulation，把多种任务都写成视频生成问题，连图像编辑也被视为两帧视频的特例。考虑到纯语义 token 会丢失细节，文中加入 noise-controlled visual conditioning，用受控噪声的视觉条件来保留外观细节并增强时序一致性。针对理解侧，作者引入 dual-flow selection 机制，灵感来自 slowfast。它把视觉 token 压缩成两条流：detail flow 用更高压缩率关注快速变化的局部细节，pivot flow 用较低压缩率保留慢变化、结构性更强的关键时刻信息。这样做不是简单降采样，而是按时间尺度分工，减少 token 数量的同时尽量保留对理解有用的动态信息。另一个值得注意的点是 generative visual loss 被当作理解训练的辅助监督，这意味着理解分支不只靠判别式目标学习，还被要求维持一种可生成、可还原的视觉语义结构。与很多“统一”工作相比，Vega 不是把一个冻结的理解模型接到生成器上，而是试图让共享 token、AR 语义建模、diffusion 渲染、理解压缩机制在同一训练框架里协同工作。
summary.experiments: 从全文可见的结果描述看，实验重点是验证三件事。第一，统一框架是否能同时覆盖视频生成和视频理解，而不是一边明显拖后腿。作者声称 Vega 在多种视频生成与理解任务上都取得了有竞争力的表现，并特别强调 image editing 可以自然纳入同一视频中心建模框架。第二，语义空间 AR 相比像素级离散 AR 是否更适合视频。文中论证依据主要是 token 数量显著下降、时间冗余更低，以及 diffusion decoder 能把高层语义预测补全成更高保真、更时序一致的视频。第三，生成监督是否真的帮助理解。作者明确指出 generative visual loss 为视频理解提供了额外学习信号，实验上应有相应消融来显示加入该辅助损失后理解性能提升。另一个关键消融应围绕 dual-flow selection：比较单流压缩、均匀采样、不同压缩率设置，验证 pivot/detail 两条流在保留多时间尺度动态信息上的作用。由于给出的全文片段没有完整表格和具体数值，这里无法可靠复述参数规模、训练数据量和精确提升幅度；但从论文结构判断，最值得看的不是单一 benchmark 分数，而是几组消融：语义 token vs 像素 token、AR-only vs hybrid、是否加入 noise-controlled conditioning、是否加入 generative visual loss、以及 dual-flow 的设计收益。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合带着统一建模问题去泛读。先看引言和方法总览，抓住作者到底统一了什么：不是把所有模态都塞进一个 AR 解码器，而是把语义层的状态转移交给 AR，把像素层渲染交给 diffusion。然后重点看方法部分关于 shared vocabulary、semantic vision token、dual-flow selection、noise-controlled visual conditioning 的定义和信息流。阅读时要不断问两个问题：为什么视频不能直接照搬图像 unified modeling；为什么这里选择“语义 AR + 像素 diffusion”，而不是纯 AR 或纯 diffusion。实验部分优先看消融，而不是主表排名。尤其关注生成损失是否真的改善理解、dual-flow 是否比简单 token 压缩更有效、以及 image editing 作为两帧视频这一建模统一是否带来额外好处。如果只是判断是否值得后续跟进，30 分钟左右足够；如果要评估它对多模态预训练的借鉴意义，建议细看方法图、token 流程图和消融表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a central obstacle in unified video modeling: video understanding prefers compact, discriminative semantic representations, while video generation needs dense signals that preserve appearance details and temporal coherence. Existing approaches usually pick one side. Fully autoregressive video modeling struggles with long token sequences, low-SNR pixel tokenization, and heavy temporal redundancy. Hybrid systems that attach a diffusion decoder to an MLLM improve generation, but understanding and generation still remain loosely coupled modules rather than a genuinely shared model.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model pretraining, the main contribution is architectural and representational. The paper extends the recent unified multimodal trend from images to videos, but avoids the naive route of forcing everything into pixel-level autoregression. Instead, it argues for a shared semantic token space that can support both understanding and generation, while letting AR and diffusion operate at different levels of abstraction. A second useful idea is to treat generation as auxiliary supervision for understanding, not just as a downstream head. That is especially relevant for high-redundancy modalities such as video, where a well-designed shared representation may let generative losses regularize semantic learning rather than merely improve rendering.
summary_en.technical_approach: Vega is built around a shared vocabulary and a hybrid AR-diffusion design. Text and visual inputs are mapped into a unified discrete token space, but the model does not autoregress over dense pixel tokens. Instead, the AR component predicts semantic visual representations at the keyframe level, modeling high-level scene dynamics and state transitions. A diffusion decoder then acts as a renderer, turning those semantic embeddings into continuous, high-fidelity video. This division of labor is the core design choice: AR is used where discrete semantic transitions matter, while diffusion is used where local detail, realism, and temporal smoothness matter. The paper argues that this is better suited to video than pure AR, which suffers from excessive token counts and poor visual quality, and better integrated than prior hybrid systems that rely on frozen understanding backbones. On the generation side, Vega adopts a video-centric formulation in which multiple tasks are cast as video generation; image editing is treated as a special case of a two-frame video. To compensate for the detail loss of semantic tokens, the model uses noise-controlled visual conditioning, which preserves fine-grained appearance information and improves temporal consistency during rendering. On the understanding side, the paper introduces a dual-flow token selection mechanism inspired by the slowfast idea. A detail flow uses stronger spatial compression to capture rapidly changing local content, while a pivot flow uses lower compression to retain slower, structurally important temporal anchors. This is not just token dropping; it is a hierarchical temporal allocation strategy meant to preserve useful dynamics under a tight token budget. Another notable component is the generative visual loss used as auxiliary supervision for understanding. That choice suggests the model is trained to maintain a representation that is not only discriminative but also generatively reconstructible, which is a meaningful design direction for native multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.experiments: From the available full-text content, the experimental story appears to focus on three claims. First, the unified framework can support both video generation and video understanding without reducing one side to a weak add-on. The paper states that Vega performs competitively across multiple generation and understanding tasks, and highlights that image editing fits naturally into the same video-centric formulation. Second, semantic-space autoregression is argued to be more suitable for video than pixel-token autoregression, mainly because it reduces token count, mitigates temporal redundancy, and leaves high-fidelity rendering to the diffusion decoder. Third, the paper claims that generative supervision improves understanding: the auxiliary generative visual loss provides additional learning signal for video understanding, implying an ablation where removing that loss hurts understanding performance. A second important ablation likely concerns the dual-flow selection mechanism, comparing it against simpler token compression or single-flow baselines to show that pivot/detail separation better preserves multi-timescale temporal information. The provided text does not include the full result tables, so it is not possible to reliably report exact model sizes, dataset scales, or numerical gains. For reading purposes, the most informative results are likely the ablations: semantic tokens versus pixel tokens, AR-only versus hybrid AR-diffusion, with and without noise-controlled conditioning, with and without generative visual loss, and dual-flow versus simpler token selection schemes.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is best read as a unified-modeling paper rather than a pure video-generation paper. Start with the introduction and method overview to pin down what is actually unified: not a single monolithic AR decoder, but a shared semantic token space with AR for latent dynamics and diffusion for rendering. Then focus on the sections describing the shared vocabulary, semantic vision tokens, dual-flow selection, and noise-controlled visual conditioning. Two questions are worth keeping in mind while reading: why does video need a different unification strategy from images, and why is the chosen split ‘semantic AR plus pixel diffusion’ preferable to pure AR or pure diffusion? In the experiments, prioritize ablations over headline benchmark tables. The most useful evidence is whether generative loss really helps understanding, whether dual-flow beats simpler token compression, and whether the video-centric formulation gives a clean path to tasks such as image editing. Around 30 minutes should be enough for a first-pass assessment; a deeper read should center on the architecture diagrams and ablation tables.

recommendation.zh: 值得读架构部分：AR 管语义 token、diffusion 管渲染，这个分工比单一路径统一视频更干净。
recommendation.en: Read the architecture section: assigning semantic tokens to AR and rendering to diffusion is a cleaner split than forcing video into one modeling path.

paper.title: World Narrative Model for Highly Controllable Video Generation: A Paradigm Shift from Pixel Sampling to Physical World Orchestration
paper.abstract: The fundamental obstacle to industrial grade video generation is the lack of controllability: existing models treat video as a pixel distribution sampling problem, bypassing the explicit, instance level $4D$ $(3D + T)$ physical world. Consequently, content creators cannot specify geometry, motion, camera parameters, or lighting in a deterministic, quantitative way, leading to the infamous ''gacha'' loop that makes professional content creation prohibitively inefficient and expensive. To address

summary.core_problem: 现有视频生成模型将任务视为像素分布采样，跳过显式4D物理世界建模，导致几何、运动、相机、光照等维度可控性不足，专业创作效率极低。
summary.importance: 范式创新尝试，提出将视频生成从端到端像素采样解耦为结构化物理叙事编排+像素渲染两阶段的World Narrative Model范式。
summary.technical_approach: 通过协作Agent将文本、参考视频、草图等稀疏多模态输入转换为可编辑的4D世界表示（含场景几何、物体布局、角色骨骼等），再进行像素级渲染，替代黑盒端到端采样。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据及量化对比结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing video generation models treat the task as pixel distribution sampling and skip explicit 4D physical world modeling, resulting in insufficient controllability over geometry, motion, camera, and lighting for professional content creation.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm innovation attempt: proposes the World Narrative Model that decouples video generation into structured physical narrative orchestration and pixel rendering, replacing end-to-end black-box sampling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses collaborative agents to translate sparse multimodal inputs (text, reference videos, sketches) into an editable 4D world representation (scene geometry, object layouts, character skeletons, etc.), followed by pixel-level rendering.
summary_en.experiments: No specific model scale, training data, or quantitative comparison results are provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 视频生成可控性的思路可参考，但缺少实验验证，作为多模态统一建模的备选范式备查即可。
recommendation.en: The controllability idea for video generation is worth noting, but lacks experimental validation; keep as a reference for alternative multimodal modeling paradigms.

paper.title: ViPSim: Collaborating Visual and Parameter Spaces for Consistent Long-Horizon Embodied World Models
paper.abstract: Embodied World Models (EWMs) have emerged as a scalable and risk-free paradigm for advancing embodied intelligence, enabling the safety-critical evaluation of Vision-Language-Action systems. However, their reliability as evaluation benchmarks and foundational simulators is often hindered by the representation gap between low-dimensional actions and high-dimensional video synthesis. This gap results in a lack of geometric correspondence, manifesting as accumulated trajectory drift and inconsisten

summary.core_problem: 解决 embodied world model 在长时序 rollout 中，低维动作参数与高维视频生成之间缺少几何对应，导致轨迹漂移和机器人-物体交互不一致的问题。
summary.importance: 这是面向具身智能的视频世界模型工作。它对 LLM 预训练不是直接相关，但对 VLA、动作条件视频生成、长时序模拟器可靠性有参考意义，尤其是把显式几何先验和参数空间约束结合起来。
summary.technical_approach: ViPSim 将建模空间拆成 Visual Space 和 Parameter Space。Visual Space 注入端执行器姿态投影、相机视角、深度几何和机器人形态 mask 等密集结构先验；Parameter Space 维护低维动作和状态参数，用于约束长时序生成过程。核心思路是让视频生成不只依赖像素预测，而要被机器人运动参数持续校正。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据、baseline 或量化结果。预期实验关注长时序视频生成一致性、轨迹漂移、机器人-物体交互保真度，以及作为 VLA 系统评估模拟器的可用性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles drift and inconsistent robot-object interaction in long-horizon embodied world models caused by weak correspondence between low-dimensional actions and high-dimensional video synthesis.
summary_en.importance: This is not core LLM pretraining work, but it is relevant to VLA and multimodal world-model research. The useful idea is to constrain action-conditioned video generation with explicit geometry and parameter-space state.
summary_en.technical_approach: ViPSim couples a Visual Space with a Parameter Space. The Visual Space provides dense structural grounding through projected end-effector pose, camera perspective, depth-informed geometry, and robot morphology masks. The Parameter Space maintains low-dimensional action and state variables that regularize long-horizon generation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model size, training data, baselines, or numerical gains. The intended evaluation appears to focus on long-horizon consistency, trajectory drift, robot-object interaction fidelity, and usefulness as a simulator for VLA evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 只需看结构约束怎么接入视频世界模型；它提示 VLA 模拟器不能只靠像素扩散硬滚。
recommendation.en: Skim the geometry-conditioning design; it is a reminder that VLA simulators cannot rely on pixel-only rollouts.

paper.title: Walking in the Implicit: Interactive World Exploration via Neural Scene Representation
paper.abstract: Interactive video generation systems for camera-controlled world exploration roll out growing sequences of latent video frames, entangling state transition with high-frequency observation synthesis. We propose Walking in the Implicit, a scene-centric paradigm that changes the rollout variable from frame latents to a fixed-length, renderable implicit state, termed Neural Implicit Scene (NIS). This factorizes interactive generation into stochastic transition of a compact scene state and determinis

summary.core_problem: 解决交互式视频生成中逐帧 rollout 容易把状态转移和高频观测合成混在一起的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成和世界模型范式上的改造：把 rollout 变量从视频帧 latent 改为可渲染的固定长度隐式场景状态。它对“如何用紧凑 latent 表示可交互世界”有参考价值，但不是 LLM 基座训练的直接论文。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Walking in the Implicit / NeuWorld。模型先用 transformer VAE 从稀疏带位姿帧学习局部锚定的 Neural Implicit Scene，再用 diffusion transformer 根据未来相机轨迹和几何感知的历史检索来演化 NIS。渲染阶段根据采样到的 NIS 和相机位姿确定性生成观测。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明模型从公开数据从头训练，但提供信息被截断，未给出具体数据规模、baseline 列表、指标或定量提升。核心实验应关注长程交互 rollout 的稳定性、相机可控性和场景一致性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the entanglement of state transition and high-frequency observation synthesis in interactive video generation with camera-controlled rollouts.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a generative world-modeling paradigm: replacing frame-latent rollout with a fixed-length renderable implicit scene state. This is relevant to compact latent world representations, but it is not directly a language-model pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: Walking in the Implicit / NeuWorld learns a locally anchored Neural Implicit Scene with a transformer VAE from sparse posed frames, then evolves that NIS with a diffusion transformer conditioned on future camera trajectories and geometry-aware retrieved history. Rendering is deterministic given the sampled scene state and camera pose.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that NeuWorld is trained from scratch on public data, but the provided text is truncated and does not include data size, baselines, metrics, or quantitative gains. The key experiments are likely about long-horizon rollout stability, camera control, and scene consistency.

recommendation.zh: 只看 NIS factorization；它对 latent world model 有借鉴，和 LLM pretrain 的连接还停在类比层。
recommendation.en: Read only the NIS factorization; it is useful for latent world-model design, but the link to LLM pretraining remains mostly analogical.

paper.title: TempAct: Advancing Temporal Plausibility in Autoregressive Video Generation via Planner-Executor RL
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models enable low-latency streaming generation by synthesizing videos chunk by chunk with cached visual context, but this chunk-wise formulation makes temporal instruction following ambiguous. A single global prompt does not specify which sub-event should be realized in each chunk, while naively switching to step-wise prompts often leads to delayed reactions, blended step semantics, and error propagation across prompt transitions. These failures are difficult

summary.core_problem: 解决自回归视频 diffusion 模型按 chunk 流式生成时，难以正确执行时间顺序、子事件切换和 step-wise prompt 的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成训练方法创新。它把 temporal planning 和 chunk-conditioned execution 放进 RL 框架，对研究长时序生成、AR+diffusion 结合、以及生成模型中 RL 信号如何约束高层结构有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TempAct，一个 planner-executor reinforcement learning 框架。planner 负责把全局视频指令分解成时间上合理的子事件或步骤，executor 负责在每个生成 chunk 中按步骤执行；训练信号直接针对动作顺序、prompt transition correctness 和 temporal plausibility，而不是只做 SFT、低层 denoising distillation 或 teacher 分布匹配。
summary.experiments: 摘要描述其用于 autoregressive video diffusion models，目标是提升低延迟流式生成中的时间合理性；未给出具体模型规模、训练数据、奖励设计细节、baseline 数量和数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses temporal instruction-following failures in autoregressive video diffusion models that generate videos chunk by chunk, especially around sub-event ordering and step-wise prompt transitions.
summary_en.importance: This is a training-method contribution for multimodal generation. It is relevant to long-horizon generation, AR-plus-diffusion systems, and the use of RL signals to enforce high-level temporal structure rather than only low-level reconstruction.
summary_en.technical_approach: TempAct introduces a planner-executor reinforcement learning framework. The planner decomposes a global video instruction into temporally plausible sub-events, while the executor performs step-conditioned chunk generation. The optimization directly targets action ordering, prompt-transition correctness, and temporal plausibility instead of relying only on SFT, denoising distillation, or teacher-distribution matching.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract applies the method to autoregressive video diffusion models for low-latency streaming generation. The provided information does not include model scale, training data, reward details, baselines, or numerical improvements.

recommendation.zh: 看 RL 目标和 planner-executor 拆分即可；若奖励设计干净，它比普通视频生成论文更接近可迁移的训练信号问题。
recommendation.en: Read the RL objective and planner-executor split; if the rewards are clean, this is more transferable than a typical video-generation paper.

paper.title: PhysisForcing: Physics Reinforced World Simulator for Robotic Manipulation
paper.abstract: Video generation models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied world simulation. However, both general-domain video generators and robot-specific data fine-tuned models can still produce physically implausible manipulations, including discontinuous motion trajectories and inconsistent robot-object interactions, which limits their reliability as world simulators. Through extensive experiments, we find that such physical instability mainly arises from two factors: deformation of moving

summary.core_problem: 解决机器人操作视频生成中的物理不一致问题，尤其是物体形变、接触关系错误和运动轨迹不连续。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是面向具身世界模拟的视频生成训练方法。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对用生成式视频模型构建 VLA/world model 的训练信号设计有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PhysisForcing 训练框架，把监督集中到更能反映物理一致性的区域。方法包括像素级轨迹对齐损失，用参考点轨迹监督 DiT 特征；还引入语义级约束来改善交互实体之间的时空相关性，重点处理接触阶段的物理失真。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到进行了大量实验，发现物理不稳定主要来自运动物体形变和交互实体的错误时空相关性。具体模型规模、训练数据量、baseline 名称和提升幅度在给定信息中未完整披露。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets physical inconsistency in robotic manipulation video generation, including object deformation, discontinuous trajectories, and implausible contact dynamics.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training framework for video-based embodied world simulation. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but the supervision design is mildly relevant for researchers thinking about generative world models for VLA training.
summary_en.technical_approach: PhysisForcing focuses learning on physics-informative regions. It uses a pixel-level trajectory alignment loss to supervise DiT features with reference point trajectories, together with semantic-level constraints intended to improve spatiotemporal correlations among interacting entities during contact.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments and diagnoses two main failure modes: deformation of moving objects and implausible spatiotemporal correlations during interaction. Model scale, dataset size, baselines, and exact gains are not available from the provided excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 只需看物理监督信号如何接到 DiT 特征；对 LLM 预训练不是主线，但可作为 VLA world model 数据生成的弱参考。
recommendation.en: Skim only how the physics losses are attached to DiT features; this is not core LLM pretraining, but it is a weak signal for VLA world-model data generation.
