paper.title: Disco-LoRA: Disentangled Composition of Content, Style, and Motion for Multi-concept Video Customization
paper.abstract: Video customization based on Text-to-Video (T2V) models aims to learn specific features from reference data to generate controllable videos. While significant strides have been made in image stylization and video motion customization, simultaneously controlling multiple concepts, such as content, style, and motion, remains a major challenge. In this work, we systematically define the task of multi-concept video customization, which requires the joint control of content, style, and motion. To fac

summary.core_problem: 文本到视频个性化生成中，模型很难同时、可控地组合参考数据里的内容、风格和运动概念。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成方法和任务定义。它系统定义 multi-concept video customization，并构建相应 benchmark；但主要是 T2V 个性化应用层方法，对 LLM 基座预训练的直接信息量有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Disco-LoRA，把内容、风格、运动三类概念拆开学习再重组。方法先把目标拆成 Content-Style 和 Content-Motion 两个子任务，每个子任务使用 Iterative Dual-LoRA Disentanglement Framework 来分离概念；随后利用 layer-wise weight trends 指导不同概念 LoRA 的组合。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明论文构建了 multi-concept video customization benchmark，并在该任务上验证 Disco-LoRA 的多概念控制能力。未给出基础 T2V 模型、训练样本规模、对比方法、定量指标或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: In text-to-video customization, it is difficult to jointly and controllably combine content, style, and motion concepts from reference data.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal generation method and task-definition paper. It defines multi-concept video customization and builds a benchmark, but it mainly operates at the T2V personalization layer and has limited direct value for LLM foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Disco-LoRA separates and recombines content, style, and motion. The method decomposes the problem into Content-Style and Content-Motion subtasks, applies an Iterative Dual-LoRA Disentanglement Framework to separate concepts, and uses layer-wise weight trends to guide LoRA composition.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the authors build a benchmark for multi-concept video customization and evaluate Disco-LoRA on controlled concept composition. It does not provide the base T2V model, training data scale, baselines, metrics, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 了解任务定义即可；LoRA 解耦组合对视频生成工程有用，但对统一预训练范式的信号偏弱。
recommendation.en: Know the task definition; the LoRA disentanglement is useful for video-generation engineering, but weak as evidence for unified pretraining design.

paper.title: PhysEditWorld: A Large-Scale Dataset Toward Physics-Editable World Models
paper.abstract: Recent game world models can synthesize visually plausible, action-conditioned rollouts. However, their interaction behaviors often remain limited to exploratory or wandering trajectories, and physical dynamics are typically learned as implicit correlations from data rather than as controllable variables. This limitation hinders their applicability to authored game environments, where physical rules are deliberately designed and require explicit manipulation. We introduce PhysEditWorld, a multim

summary.core_problem: 构建一个可控制物理参数的游戏世界模型数据集，使模型能学习同一动作轨迹在不同重力条件下产生的可归因变化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态世界模型数据资产。它不是 LLM 预训练论文，但受控 replay-and-render 数据构造方式对 embodied/world-model 预训练的数据设计有参考意义，尤其是把物理变量从相关性中显式拆出来。
summary.technical_approach: PhysEditWorld 基于 UE5 replay-and-rendering pipeline：记录归一化 action trace，然后在相同初始状态、角色控制器、动作序列和相机策略下，用不同 gravity configuration 重放并渲染，从而形成成对、可控、可归因的物理变化数据。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示数据集包含 12 个 cinematic UE5 scenes，并围绕 gravity 作为首个版本的核心物理参数；具体样本规模、训练模型、baseline 和指标在给定信息中不完整。论文重点更偏数据构建，而不是提出新的生成模型结构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a dataset for physics-editable game world models, enabling models to observe attributable changes under different gravity settings for the same action trajectory.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a multimodal world-model dataset contribution. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but the controlled replay-and-render design is relevant to data construction for embodied and generative world models, especially for disentangling physical variables from raw correlations.
summary_en.technical_approach: PhysEditWorld uses a UE5 replay-and-rendering pipeline. It records normalized action traces and replays the same initial state, character controller, action sequence, and camera policy under multiple gravity configurations, producing controlled paired data for physical variation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the dataset contains 12 cinematic UE5 scenes and focuses on gravity in the initial release. The provided information does not fully specify dataset size, trained model scale, baselines, or quantitative gains. The main contribution is the data-generation protocol.

recommendation.zh: 可看数据构造思路，不必读模型细节；受控重放比随机视频采集更像 world-model 预训练该要的数据。
recommendation.en: Worth noting for the data protocol, not the model details; controlled replay is closer to useful world-model pretraining data than random video scraping.

paper.title: RayPE: Ray-Space Positional Encoding for 3D-Aware Video Generation
paper.abstract: Modern video diffusion transformers position their tokens through RoPE on the (u,v,t) axes -- a description of the camera's sampling grid that says nothing about the 3D structure of the scene. We observe that the geometric relation between two camera rays is captured by the Plucker reciprocal product, which is bilinear in the two rays -- the same algebraic form as the dot product in Transformer attention. Building on this analogy, we propose RayPE, a positional-encoding extension that injects pe

summary.core_problem: 如何为 3D 感知视频生成模型提供包含场景 3D 几何结构的位置编码？
summary.importance: 指出传统基于 (u,v,t) 坐标的 RoPE 缺乏 3D 结构信息，提出了一种基于射线空间（Ray-Space）和 Plucker 坐标的新型位置编码 RayPE。
summary.technical_approach: 利用 Plucker 互反积（reciprocal product）的双线性特性（与 Transformer 注意力中的点积形式一致），将每个 token 的 6D Plucker 坐标加性地注入到自注意力的 Query 和 Key 中。通过特定的 Q/K 翻转排列，使对称恒等配置与互反积完全一致。
summary.experiments: 注意力分数被分解为内容项、几何项以及两个交叉项，实验证明这些项都是必要的。该编码在异构相机轨迹的视频数据上表现稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: How to provide positional encoding that incorporates 3D geometric structure of the scene for 3D-aware video generation models?
summary_en.importance: Points out that traditional RoPE based on (u,v,t) coordinates lacks 3D structure information, and proposes RayPE, a novel positional encoding based on ray-space and Plucker coordinates.
summary_en.technical_approach: Leverages the bilinear nature of the Plucker reciprocal product (which shares the same algebraic form as the dot product in Transformer attention) to additively inject per-token 6D Plucker coordinates into the Queries and Keys of self-attention. Uses a specific Q/K flip arrangement so the symmetric identity configuration coincides exactly with the reciprocal product.
summary_en.experiments: The attention score decomposes into a content term, a geometry term, and two cross-terms, all found empirically necessary. The encoding is stable across video data with heterogeneous camera trajectories.

recommendation.zh: 视频生成领域的 3D 位置编码创新，利用 Plucker 坐标与 Attention 点积的数学同构性，设计很优雅，可作为多模态架构设计的参考。
recommendation.en: 3D positional encoding innovation for video generation. Elegantly leverages the mathematical isomorphism between Plucker coordinates and Attention dot product. Good reference for multimodal architecture design.

paper.title: VPA-Guard: Defending and Benchmarking Image-to-Video Generation Against Visual Prompt Attacks
paper.abstract: Recent advancements in Image-to-Video (I2V) generation have transformed input images from simple appearance references into interactive control interfaces where visual cues such as arrows, sketches, and emojis orchestrate complex video dynamics with unprecedented controllability. However, these seemingly innocuous static cues can be interpreted by models as executable temporal instructions, unfolding into harmful actions in the generated videos. Despite the severity of this threat, existing safe

summary.core_problem: 评估 image-to-video 生成模型是否会把输入图像中的箭头、草图、emoji 等视觉符号误解释为可执行的时间动作指令，从而生成有害视频。
summary.importance: 贡献是视频生成安全 benchmark。现有安全评测多关注文本 jailbreak 或图像内容本身，这篇把攻击面扩展到“视觉提示符作为动态控制指令”的场景，对多模态生成安全有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VVA-Bench，对视觉中心的 prompt attack 进行分类，并在多种 I2V 模型上测量攻击成功率；题目还提到 VPA-Guard，表明论文可能同时包含防御组件，但摘要中可确认的核心资产是 benchmark。
summary.experiments: 在 VVA-Bench 上评测多个当前 I2V 模型。摘要报告部分模型高度脆弱，攻击成功率可达到 100.0%，其中提到 Wan 系列模型。完整模型列表、防御效果和人工/自动安全判定细节需看正文。
summary.authors_note: Jiajun Wu is a known researcher in visual reasoning and scene understanding.

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether image-to-video models interpret visual symbols such as arrows, sketches, and emojis as executable temporal instructions that can induce harmful generated videos.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a safety benchmark for video generation. Existing safety evaluations mostly focus on text jailbreaks or harmful image content, while this work targets visual prompts as dynamic control signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce VVA-Bench, categorize vision-centric prompt attacks, and measure attack success rates across modern I2V models. The title also mentions VPA-Guard, suggesting a defense component, but the benchmark is the clearly identifiable core contribution from the abstract.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is evaluated on multiple I2V models. The abstract reports severe susceptibility, with attack success rates reaching 100.0% on a Wan-family model. Full model coverage, defense results, and safety judging details require the main paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Jiajun Wu is known for work on visual reasoning and scene understanding.

recommendation.zh: 只看攻击分类和 ASR 表即可；它提醒视觉控制符会变成隐式指令，但不改变生成式预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Read only the attack taxonomy and ASR table; it is a useful warning about visual cues as implicit instructions, not a change to generative pretraining recipes.

paper.title: Trimming the Long-Tail of Visual World Modeling Evaluation
paper.abstract: Physical interactions follow a long-tailed distribution: a set of common and regular interactions dominates human experience and visual data, while a broad spectrum of rare and irregular interactions remains underrepresented. Although recent visual world models, including image and video generation models, achieve impressive realism on existing benchmarks, they primarily focus on simulating common physical interactions. This raises a central question: Do current visual world models internalize a

summary.core_problem: 评估视觉世界模型是否真的学到可泛化的物理交互规律，而不只是复现训练数据中常见的工具和动作组合。
summary.importance: 这是一个面向视觉世界模型的评测贡献。它把评测重心从常规、频繁出现的物理交互，推向长尾、非常规甚至不可能的交互场景，对视频生成和世界模型的物理一致性评估有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Tailor-Bench，将物理交互拆成三类场景：Regular 覆盖常见工具-任务组合，Unconventional 用属性兼容但不常见的替代工具测试 affordance 泛化，Impossible 引入违反属性约束的交互来测试模型是否能识别物理不可行性。核心是通过长尾场景切开“视觉真实感”和“物理原则泛化”之间的差异。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整模型列表、样本规模和数值结果。实验应主要围绕现有图像/视频生成式世界模型在 Tailor-Bench 三类场景上的表现，重点比较常规场景与非常规、不可行场景之间的性能落差。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Heng Ji 和 Yunzhu Li，分别在信息抽取、多模态理解和物理交互/机器人学习方向有较高辨识度；摘要未提供明确机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether visual world models learn generalizable physical interaction principles, rather than merely reproducing frequent tool-action patterns from visual data.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark contribution for visual world models. It shifts evaluation from common physical interactions toward long-tail, unconventional, and impossible interactions, which is useful for diagnosing physical consistency in video generation and world modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Tailor-Bench organizes evaluation into three scenario modes: Regular scenarios with common tool-task pairs, Unconventional scenarios that replace tools with attribute-compatible substitutes, and Impossible scenarios that introduce attribute-violating interactions. The key design is to separate visual plausibility from physical-principle generalization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the full model set, dataset scale, or numerical results. The experiments appear to evaluate current image and video world models across the three Tailor-Bench modes, with emphasis on the gap between regular and long-tail physical interactions.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Heng Ji and Yunzhu Li, known for work in information extraction, multimodal understanding, and physical interaction / robotics learning; the abstract does not specify institutional affiliations.

recommendation.zh: 作为世界模型评测备查即可；真正该看的是场景构造规则，别把它当预训练物理能力的直接证据。
recommendation.en: Use it as a world-model evaluation reference; read the scenario construction, but do not treat the scores as direct evidence of pretrained physical understanding.

paper.title: Sol Video Inference Engine: Agent-Native Full-Stack Acceleration Framework for Efficient Video Generation
paper.abstract: Modern video diffusion models achieve higher generation quality through scaling, but this also increases inference cost. Although many acceleration methods have been proposed, a central challenge is that the most effective acceleration strategy is highly instance-specific: a recipe that works well for one combination of model, hardware, and inference configuration often does not transfer to another. Different models vary in architecture, numerical sensitivity, and attention concentration pattern

summary.core_problem: 视频扩散模型随规模扩大推理成本快速上升，且最优加速策略因模型结构、硬件、推理配置的差异高度实例化，手动工程调优成本极高。
summary.importance: 提出面向视频生成的无训练全栈加速框架Sol Video Inference Engine，通过自动适配实例级最优加速组合降低视频生成推理成本。
summary.technical_approach: 框架是agent原生的无训练加速系统，集成缓存、稀疏注意力、token剪枝、量化五类通用加速技术，针对特定模型、硬件、分辨率配置自动搜索最优加速配方。
summary.experiments: 摘要内容截断，未给出具体模型、速度提升、质量损失等量化实验结果，仅说明框架覆盖的加速技术维度和自动调优设计思路。

summary_en.core_problem: Modern video diffusion models incur prohibitive inference cost with scaling, while optimal acceleration strategies are highly instance-specific across model architectures, hardware, and inference configurations, making manual tuning extremely costly.
summary_en.importance: Proposes Sol Video Inference Engine, a training-free, full-stack acceleration framework for video generation that automatically selects instance-optimal acceleration configurations to reduce inference cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: The agent-native, training-free framework integrates five broadly applicable acceleration techniques: caching, sparse attention, token pruning, and quantization, and automatically searches for the optimal acceleration recipe for a given model, hardware, and resolution configuration.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated, no quantitative results on model scale, speedup, or quality degradation are provided, only the covered acceleration techniques and auto-tuning design are described.

recommendation.zh: 视频扩散模型的全栈推理加速框架，自动调优算子组合的工程思路可参考，与LLM预训练无直接关联，备查即可。
recommendation.en: Full-stack inference acceleration for video diffusion models; the operator auto-tuning idea is a useful engineering reference, no direct link to LLM pretraining, catalog only.

paper.title: Autonomous Video Generation with Counterfactual Controllability for Self-Evolving World Models
paper.abstract: Existing literature claims that video generation essentially is world modelling. On the one hand, the claim is productive because it pushes generative AI beyond static images and toward temporally extended physical scenes. On the other hand, this claim dangerously relies on the belief that scaling visual prediction alone will automatically yield physical agents. We prefer a more accurate statement: video generation models learn a partial, implicit spatiotemporal world model, but not a fully grou

summary.core_problem: 重新定义视频生成作为世界模型时应满足的关键能力：不仅要预测逼真视频，还要支持可干预、可控制的反事实生成。
summary.importance: 贡献更像方法立场或框架性问题定义，而不是明确的预训练 recipe。它对基座研究有一定启发：视觉预测损失可能只学到隐式时空相关性，不能保证模型知道哪些变量可控、哪些约束来自智能体身体、哪些未来在干预后仍然有效。
summary.technical_approach: 论文主张用 counterfactual controllability 作为自演化世界模型的判据。摘要未说明完整算法，但核心方向是让视频生成模型从被动预测转向可干预生成，使模型能区分可控变量、身体约束和干预后的有效未来。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据、baseline、评测指标或量化结果。若正文没有干净的反事实控制评测，这篇更应作为问题设定阅读，而不是经验结论阅读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that video generation as world modeling should be judged not only by realistic prediction, but by counterfactual controllability under interventions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution appears to be a framing or method proposal rather than a concrete pretraining recipe. Its relevance to foundation-model research is the warning that visual prediction losses may learn implicit spatiotemporal correlations without learning controllable variables, embodiment-specific constraints, or valid futures after intervention.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes counterfactual controllability as a criterion for self-evolving world models. The abstract does not specify a full algorithm, but the central direction is to move video generation from passive prediction toward intervention-aware generation that separates controllable factors, body constraints, and feasible counterfactual futures.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract provides no model scale, training data, baselines, metrics, or quantitative results. If the full paper lacks a clean controllability evaluation, it should be read mainly as a problem-framing piece rather than as empirical evidence.

recommendation.zh: 概念判断比实验更有用；若正文有干净反事实评测可细看，否则当作 world-model prior 修正。
recommendation.en: The framing is more useful than the likely experiments; read closely only if it offers a clean counterfactual-control evaluation.

paper.title: Towards Error-Free Long Video Generation
paper.abstract: Recent advances in video generation have made minute-level synthesis possible; however, generating long videos remains challenging due to error accumulation, attribute drift, and the limited availability of long video data. In this paper, we introduce an infinite-length video generation framework that focusing on addressing these issues and produces high-quality, dynamic, and identity-consistent single-shot long videos. We first finetune a diffusion model as a video extension model on large-scal

summary.core_problem: 长视频生成中存在的误差累积（颜色/曝光偏差、过度锐化）和属性漂移（长期一致性丧失）问题，以及长视频训练数据的匮乏。
summary.importance: 提出了一种结合 Diffusion 与 Autoregressive (AR) 优势的无限长视频生成框架，通过频率解耦的 Rectified Flow 采样缓解误差累积，为长视频生成提供了一种新的统一建模思路。
summary.technical_approach: 1) 混合注意力机制：在 clip 内部使用双向注意力（保留 Diffusion 的局部连续性），在 clip 之间使用单向因果注意力（引入 AR 的长程依赖）。2) 两阶段训练：先在短视频上微调 Diffusion 模型实现条件扩展，再在长视频上微调以学习跨 clip 的 KV cache。3) 截断 Rectified Flow (T-RFlow)：分析发现误差累积多发生在低频和高频阶段，因此在采样时截断低频（减少颜色偏差）和高频（缓解过度锐化）成分。4) KV Cache 选择：利用 LLM 离线计算 prompt 与历史 clip 的相关性，仅保留最相关 clip 的 KV，平衡长程依赖与显存消耗。
summary.experiments: 在 VBench 长视频设置下取得了显著的得分提升，能够生成高质量、动态且身份一致的单镜头长视频（如 Figure 1 所示）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Method 部分关于 T-RFlow 的频率解耦分析，以及混合注意力机制的具体实现。建议阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Error accumulation (color/exposure bias, over-sharpening) and attribute drift (loss of long-term consistency) in long video generation, along with the scarcity of long video training data.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an infinite-length video generation framework combining the strengths of Diffusion and Autoregressive (AR) models, mitigating error accumulation via frequency-decoupled Rectified Flow sampling, offering a novel unified modeling approach for long video generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Hybrid Attention: Bidirectional attention within clips (preserving Diffusion's local continuity) and unidirectional causal attention across clips (introducing AR's long-range dependency). 2) Two-stage Training: Fine-tuning a Diffusion model on short videos for conditional extension, then on long videos to learn cross-clip KV cache. 3) Truncated Rectified Flow (T-RFlow): Analyzes error accumulation in low/high-frequency phases and truncates them during sampling to reduce color bias and over-sharpening. 4) KV Cache Selection: Uses an LLM to offline compute prompt-clip relevance, retaining only the most relevant KV caches to balance long-range dependency and memory efficiency.
summary_en.experiments: Achieved significant score improvements on VBench long-video settings, capable of generating high-quality, dynamic, and identity-consistent single-shot long videos (as shown in Figure 1).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Method section for the frequency decoupling analysis of T-RFlow and the specific implementation of the hybrid attention mechanism. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做 AR+diffusion 统一建模应看注意力拆分设计；结论先按弱信号，重点查长程消融。
recommendation.en: For AR-diffusion hybrid modeling, inspect the intra-clip bidirectional and inter-clip causal attention split; trust hinges on long-range ablations.

paper.title: LooseControlVideo: Directorial Video Control using Spatial Blocking
paper.abstract: Precise 3D spatial orchestration in text-to-video generation remains a significant challenge, particularly for multi-object scenes where semantic layout and temporal dynamics are often entangled. While existing depth-conditioned models achieve good structural fidelity, they necessitate dense, frame-accurate guidance that is labor-intensive to author for dynamic events involving deformable objects. We present LooseControlVideo, a framework that enables intuitive and expressive control by using sp

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到视频生成中多物体 3D 空间布局和运动轨迹难以精确控制的问题，尤其是 dense depth guidance 难以手工制作的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成控制方法。它不是统一多模态预训练论文，但对视频生成模型如何接收结构化控制信号有参考价值，尤其是从稠密控制转向稀疏 3D blocking 的设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LooseControlVideo，用稀疏、带方向的 3D boxes 作为导演式 blocking proxy，描述物体位置、尺度、朝向和轨迹。方法微调 Wan 2.2 视频生成 backbone，并引入 DNOCS 编码来表示 3D 尺寸、方向和深度排序遮挡，使模型在稀疏布局约束下补全真实遮挡、动态和交互。
summary.experiments: 摘要称方法支持多物体空间编排和局部 refinement，例如调整跳跃轨迹或添加交互。实验细节、训练集规模、对比方法和定量指标未在摘要中给出。
summary.authors_note: Niloy J. Mitra 和 Kalyan Sunkavalli 是图形学、视觉生成和可控生成方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets precise 3D spatial control in text-to-video generation, especially for multi-object scenes where dense frame-level depth guidance is hard to author.
summary_en.importance: This is a video generation control paper rather than a unified multimodal pretraining work. Its useful signal is the move from dense conditioning to sparse, structured 3D blocking as a controllable interface for generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: LooseControlVideo uses sparse oriented 3D boxes as a directorial blocking proxy for object layout, scale, orientation, and trajectory. It fine-tunes a Wan 2.2 video backbone on a dataset annotated with DNOCS, an encoding for 3D size, orientation, and depth-ordered occlusion, letting the generator synthesize realistic occlusions, dynamics, and interactions under sparse constraints.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports support for multi-object orchestration and localized refinements such as changing jump trajectories or adding interactions. It does not expose dataset size, model scale, baselines, or quantitative gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Niloy J. Mitra and Kalyan Sunkavalli are established researchers in graphics, visual generation, and controllable generation.

recommendation.zh: 稀疏 3D blocking 是有用的控制接口想法；预训练研究员看方法图即可，不必追逐视频 demo。
recommendation.en: Sparse 3D blocking is a useful control-interface idea; for pretraining work, inspect the method figure and ignore the demo-driven parts.

paper.title: Physics-IQ Verified
paper.abstract: Video generative models ( VGMs) have become a new frontier that can be used not just for video generation but for a multitude of downstream tasks, including world modeling. To advance these tasks, a good video model must understand the physical reality of the world. Evaluating this understanding is an emerging field and has led to the Physics-IQ benchmark, which quantifies this explicitly by comparing model-generated videos to real-world videos of physical experiments. In this work, we present a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作不是提出新的视频生成模型，而是审计一个已经被广泛采用的物理理解评测基准 Physics-IQ。它要解决的问题是：当前 benchmark 的分数到底有多大程度在测“模型是否理解物理”，又有多大程度被提示词歧义、参考视频伪激活、以及数据集级聚合方式这些评测噪声左右。如果 benchmark 本身有系统误差，那么后续模型比较、训练方向甚至所谓 world model 进展都会被带偏。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接相关性不算高，因为核心对象是视频生成模型评测，而不是 LLM 预训练方法本身。但它对“生成式世界模型如何被可靠评估”有方法论价值，尤其适合关注统一视频生成/世界模型的人。重要之处在于它提醒了一件常被忽略的事：当 benchmark 试图测更高层能力，比如物理一致性、因果结构或世界建模时，评测协议里的小偏差会被放大，甚至改变模型排名。对做多模态基座的人，这比单纯再加几个分数更有意义，因为它关系到训练目标是否真的朝着想要的能力优化。
summary.technical_approach:
作者做了三类修正。第一是 prompt 质量修正。原始 Physics-IQ 中一部分文本描述存在歧义，而且没有充分考虑不同模型的提示习惯。作者为不清晰样本重写更具区分性的描述，并引入 template 化 prompting，使输入更符合模型类型与使用规范。这样做的目的不是“帮模型作弊”，而是减少由于提示不当导致的无关误差，让分数更接近模型能力上限。

第二是 metric aggregation 修正。原始 Physics-IQ 主要定义数据集级总分，不同样本对总分影响不均，也不利于定位失败模式。作者提出 sample-level 的 Physics-IQ Verified 分数，把四个指标在样本层面统一计算与归一化，再做更公平的聚合。这个改动的价值在于可解释性和统计稳健性：你可以知道模型到底在哪些实验、哪类物理现象、哪种指标上失败，而不是只看一个混合总分。

第三是 ground-truth artifact 清理。作者发现不少参考视频里存在与目标物理现象无关的“spurious metric activations”，例如背景变化、偶然运动或采集噪声会触发 IoU/MSE 类指标，导致模型即使没抓住真正物理过程，也可能得到误导性的分数。于是他们对参考视频做清理，尽量让指标只响应目标物理效应。相比重新设计全套指标，这是一种更务实的 benchmark 修复路径：先把测量对象定义得更干净，再谈模型优劣。
summary.experiments:
实验上最关键的不是某个模型赢了，而是 benchmark 修正后模型排序会明显变化。作者在六个 image-to-video 模型上同时跑原始版和 Verified 版评测，发现不同模型对这些修正的敏感性不同，因此总体排名发生了较大变化。这说明原始 benchmark 的噪声不是均匀噪声，而是会系统性偏向某些模型。

数据层面的修正幅度也不小。文中给出：57.6% 的样本存在被修正的 measurement errors，影响到 29.8% 的视频；34.8% 的 prompt 被认定为高度歧义并得到纠正。基准本身包含 66 个物理实验、3 个视角、2 次重复，共 396 个视频，每个视频 8 秒，其中前 3 秒作为条件输入，后 5 秒用于生成与比较。评测仍沿用四个核心指标：Spatial IoU、Spatiotemporal IoU、Weighted Spatial IoU 和 MSE，但作者重新审视了这些指标在样本层面的聚合与参考信号质量。对读者来说，最值得注意的是：这些修正并非边角料，而是足以改变 benchmark 结论。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和作者列出的三类问题，确认它到底在修什么。然后直接看 benchmark 设计与原始 Physics-IQ score 的定义，理解原版为何会在 dataset-level aggregation 上掩盖样本差异。接着重点看 prompt ambiguity 的案例图、artifact 清理示例，以及原始版和 Verified 版下模型排名变化的结果表。若只想抓住结论，读完问题定义、三项修正和 ranking change 的实验即可，20 分钟左右足够。若你关心世界模型评测设计，再细看 sample-level score 的公式与 physical variation ceiling 的处理方式。
summary.authors_note: Google DeepMind 团队；从文中提供的 benchmark 仓库与写作风格可确认机构背景，但当前材料未给出完整作者名单。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper does not introduce a new video generative model. It audits Physics-IQ, a benchmark that has quickly become a standard way to evaluate whether video generation models capture physical reality rather than merely producing plausible motion. The core question is whether the benchmark score actually measures physical understanding, or whether it is substantially distorted by prompt ambiguity, artifacts in the reference videos, and a dataset-level aggregation scheme that hides sample-specific failures.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to LLM pretraining is indirect, since the work is centered on evaluation for video generative models rather than language-model training. Still, it matters for anyone interested in world models, multimodal pretraining, or unified generative modeling. The main contribution is methodological: when a benchmark aims to measure higher-level capabilities such as physical consistency or causal understanding, small protocol flaws can become large sources of error and even change model rankings. That is a useful warning for foundation-model research more broadly, because optimization follows evaluation. If the benchmark is misaligned, model development will be misaligned too.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper makes three concrete corrections. First, it improves prompt quality. The authors identify ambiguous prompts in the original benchmark and rewrite them to be more distinctive, while also introducing a templated prompting scheme that better matches model-specific prompting practices. The point is not to make the task easier in an artificial way, but to reduce variance caused by poor prompting so the score better reflects model capability.

Second, it changes metric aggregation. The original Physics-IQ score is defined at the dataset level, which means samples can contribute unevenly and failure modes are hard to localize. The paper introduces a sample-level Physics-IQ Verified score so that each sample and each metric can be analyzed more directly and aggregated more fairly. This improves interpretability and statistical hygiene.

Third, it cleans artifacts in the ground-truth videos. The authors show that many reference videos contain spurious activations unrelated to the target physical phenomenon, such as incidental motion or visual noise that can trigger IoU- or MSE-based metrics. They therefore clean the references so the metrics respond more selectively to the intended physical effect. This is a pragmatic benchmark-repair strategy: clean the measurement target before redesigning the entire metric stack.
summary_en.experiments:
The most important result is not that one model scores higher than another, but that model rankings change materially once the benchmark is corrected. The authors evaluate six image-to-video models under both the original and the verified protocols and find that models respond differently to the benchmark fixes, leading to substantial ranking shifts. That means the noise in the original benchmark is not harmless random noise; it can systematically favor some models over others.

The scale of the benchmark issues is also nontrivial. The paper reports that the refinement removes measurement errors in 57.6% of all samples, affects 29.8% of videos, and corrects more than 34.8% of prompts judged to be highly ambiguous. The benchmark itself contains 66 physical experiments, each recorded from 3 viewpoints and repeated twice, for a total of 396 videos. Each 8-second video is split into a 3-second conditioning segment and a 5-second continuation to be predicted. The evaluation still uses the original four metrics—Spatial IoU, Spatiotemporal IoU, Weighted Spatial IoU, and MSE—but revisits how they should be aggregated and what reference signal they should operate on. The practical takeaway is that these are not cosmetic fixes; they are large enough to alter benchmark conclusions.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and the three failure modes the paper identifies. Then read the section that defines the original Physics-IQ score to understand why dataset-level aggregation can obscure sample-level behavior. After that, focus on the prompt-ambiguity examples, the artifact-cleaning examples, and the table showing ranking changes between the original and verified protocols. If you only need the main message, those parts are enough and should take around 20 minutes. If you care about benchmark design for world models, spend extra time on the sample-level score definition and the treatment of the physical-variation ceiling.
summary_en.authors_note: Google DeepMind team; the repository and paper context make the institution clear, but the full author list is not available in the provided material.

recommendation.zh: 做视频 world model 评测的人应扫一遍；重点看哪些样本被改掉，原 Physics-IQ 分数可能混入 prompt/GT 噪声。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming if you evaluate video world models; focus on the revised samples, since original Physics-IQ scores may include prompt and ground-truth noise.

paper.title: Bridging Creative Intent and Visual Quality: Creator-Driven Recurrent Video Generation with Agentic Feedback Loops
paper.abstract: Generative AI has made content creation increasingly accessible, but many AI-generated videos lack narrative coherence and creative direction, issues that become more substantial at longer durations. Unlike coding, where AI generation benefits from reliable feedback and techniques such as recurrent self-improvement, video generation requires subjective feedback about plot, scenes, and narrative, which naturally motivates approaches that incorporate human creative direction. We introduce CHIEF, a

summary.core_problem: 解决长视频生成中叙事连贯性和创作者意图难以保持的问题，用人类创作者驱动的迭代反馈循环改进生成视频。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成系统与 agentic workflow。它把代码生成中的 recurrent self-improvement 思路迁移到视频生成，但反馈信号从可验证测试变成主观审美和叙事评价；对基座预训练的直接价值有限，更像生成系统层设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CHIEF，一个 human-in-the-loop 视频共创框架。创作者在每轮迭代中给出方向和修改，专门的 refiner agent 吸收修订；persona-conditioned multimodal LLM 观看生成视频，并从观众视角生成主观 critique，形成视频生成-观看-反馈-修订的闭环。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体视频生成 backbone、训练规模、评测集、baseline 或定量提升。已知重点在框架设计和迭代反馈流程，而非新的生成模型预训练方法。
summary.authors_note: 论文标注有 Cohere 背景；摘要中的重点是创作者驱动的视频生成工作流，而不是通用模型训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses weak narrative coherence and poor preservation of creator intent in longer AI-generated videos through a human-driven iterative feedback loop.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal generation system and agentic workflow. It adapts recurrent self-improvement ideas from code generation to video generation, but the feedback signal is subjective narrative and aesthetic critique rather than executable tests. Its direct value for base-model pretraining is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: CHIEF is a human-in-the-loop video co-creation framework. The creator drives each iteration with direction and revisions, a specialized refiner agent incorporates those edits, and persona-conditioned multimodal LLMs watch generated videos and produce audience-perspective subjective critiques.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the video generation backbone, training scale, evaluation set, baselines, or quantitative gains. The emphasis appears to be on workflow design and iterative feedback rather than a new generative-model pretraining method.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper is marked as coming from Cohere. The focus is creator-driven video generation workflow design, not general foundation-model training.

recommendation.zh: Cohere 做视频反馈 loop 值得知道，但信号太主观；只看框架图和失败案例即可。
recommendation.en: A Cohere video-feedback loop worth knowing, but the supervision is highly subjective; the framework diagram and failure cases should be enough.

paper.title: UniTemp: Unlocking Video Generation in Any Temporal Order via Bidirectional Distillation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models have emerged as a promising approach for long video generation, achieving strong performance in streaming settings. However, existing methods are restricted to forward temporal generation, whereas practical video creation often requires flexible generation order, e.g., conditioning on future context to extend backward, or on both past and future context for inbetween generation. We bridge this gap by training an autoregressive model that supports generation

summary.core_problem: 解决自回归视频扩散模型只能按正向时间顺序生成的问题，使模型可以向前、向后或在两端条件之间生成视频片段。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成方法创新。它把视频生成中的时间顺序从固定 forward rollout 放宽到任意顺序，对长视频编辑、补帧、反向扩展更实用；对 LLM 预训练研究员的价值主要在于“生成顺序”和“因果 latent 表示”之间的张力。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 bidirectional distillation，并针对常用 Causal 3D VAE 的单向条件问题引入 blockwise anchor latents。Causal 3D VAE 的 latent 编码依赖过去上下文，直接反向生成会在 block 边界缺少必要条件，导致不连续；anchor latents 用辅助 latent 在边界补回缺失的过去信息，从而支持 backward 与 inbetween generation。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整模型规模、训练数据和定量结果。实验目标应覆盖 forward extension、backward extension 和中间补全等多种时间顺序的视频生成设置，并对比普通 forward-only 自回归视频扩散模型。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the restriction that autoregressive video diffusion models typically generate only in forward temporal order, while practical editing often needs backward extension or inbetween generation.
summary_en.importance: This is a method contribution in video generation. Its relevance to LLM pretraining is indirect: it exposes a useful tension between generation order and causal latent representations, a theme that also appears in non-left-to-right language modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses bidirectional distillation and introduces blockwise anchor latents to compensate for the missing past context caused by Causal 3D VAEs. Since these VAEs encode latents with a strict dependence on previous frames, naive backward generation creates block-boundary discontinuities; anchor latents restore the needed boundary context.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model size, data scale, or full quantitative numbers. The evaluation is expected to cover forward extension, backward extension, and inbetween video generation against forward-only autoregressive video diffusion baselines.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和 causal VAE 失效分析即可；对文本预训练不是主线，但“生成顺序受 tokenizer 约束”这个坑值得记住。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure and the causal-VAE failure analysis; it is not central to text pretraining, but the generation-order/tokenizer constraint is a useful warning.

paper.title: SierpinskiCam: Camera-Controlled Video Retaking with Sierpinski Triangle Pattern Cues
paper.abstract: Generating novel renderings of a scene along user-defined camera trajectories from a single monocular video, dubbed video retaking, is a compelling but difficult problem in content creation and visual effects. Existing geometry-guided approaches reconstruct a 4D representation from the source video and render it along the target trajectory to condition video diffusion models. However, this guidance degrades as the target camera departs from the source trajectory, leaving newly revealed regions s

summary.core_problem: 解决单目视频在用户指定新相机轨迹下重拍时，目标视角偏离源轨迹后几何引导稀疏、遮挡区域缺失的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是视频生成和神经渲染结合的工程方法。对 LLM 预训练没有直接作用，但其中“把参考视频 token 拼到目标 token 序列，并用负 RoPE 索引隔离两路流”的设计，对统一序列建模里的条件注入有一点参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SierpinskiCam：在几何重建引导之外，加入带有丰富可跟踪特征的 Sierpinski dome texture cues，以增强大视角变化下的新区域约束；同时提出 reference video conditioning，把源视频 token 追加到目标 token 序列，并用 negative RoPE indices 区分参考流和目标流，不改模型结构，也不做单视频适配。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出参数规模、训练数据规模、具体基线或数值提升。实验应比较传统 4D 几何引导视频扩散方法，在大相机偏移、外观一致性和新显露区域质量上的表现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses video retaking from a monocular source video when the requested camera path moves far away from the observed trajectory and geometry-based guidance becomes sparse or missing.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an engineering method for video generation and neural rendering. It is not a pretraining paper, but the token-level reference-video conditioning with negative RoPE indices is mildly relevant to sequence-based conditioning design.
summary_en.technical_approach: SierpinskiCam augments geometry guidance with Sierpinski dome texture cues that provide trackable features under large viewpoint changes. It also appends source-video tokens to the target-token sequence and separates the two streams using negative RoPE indices, avoiding architectural changes and per-video adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, training data size, named baselines, or numerical improvements. The evaluation likely compares against geometry-guided video diffusion methods under large camera deviations, focusing on appearance grounding and newly revealed regions.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reference-token conditioning 和 negative RoPE 的设计即可；其余主要是视频重拍工程，对基座训练信号很弱。
recommendation.en: Skim only the reference-token conditioning and negative-RoPE design; the rest is video-retaking engineering with little signal for foundation pretraining.

paper.title: Training-free sparse attention based on cumulative energy filtering
paper.abstract: Sparse attention accelerates Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for video generation by computing only the important tokens while skipping the rest. The token selection strategy is key to balancing sparsity and accuracy. We formulate the token filtering process as a dual-goal optimization problem: maximizing sparsity and minimizing accuracy degradation. Existing algorithms cannot fulfill both objectives simultaneously. For example, Top-p only considers the accuracy constraint, while Top-k maintains a

summary.core_problem: 解决视频生成 Diffusion Transformer 推理中稠密 attention 成本高、现有稀疏 token 选择难以同时保证精度和计算节省的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练无关的推理加速方法，面向 DiT 视频生成的 sparse attention；和 LLM 预训练不是同一主线，但对长序列 attention 稀疏化和 FlashAttention 集成有工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将 token filtering 表述为同时最大化稀疏率、最小化精度损失的双目标问题；论文主张固定 recall rate 足以约束精度，而固定阈值会浪费计算，因此提出动态阈值策略，并和 FlashAttention 深度集成，避免额外 mask 计算开销。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体视频生成模型、分辨率、token 数、速度提升或质量指标；作者声称在相同精度水平下提高稀疏率，并通过 FlashAttention 集成消除额外 masking overhead。

summary_en.core_problem: Reduces the cost of dense attention in video-generation Diffusion Transformers, where existing sparse token-selection rules struggle to preserve quality while saving compute.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free inference acceleration method for DiT video generation. It is not central to LLM pretraining, but the sparse-attention criterion and FlashAttention integration are useful engineering signals for long-sequence systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formulates token filtering as a dual-objective problem: maximize sparsity while minimizing accuracy degradation. It argues that a fixed recall rate is enough to preserve accuracy, whereas a fixed threshold is compute-inefficient, then introduces dynamic thresholding integrated tightly with FlashAttention to avoid extra masking overhead.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report the exact video model, resolution, token count, speedup, or quality metrics. It claims higher sparsity at the same accuracy level and no additional masking overhead due to FlashAttention integration.

recommendation.zh: 只看动态阈值和 FA 集成细节即可；结论若成立，可作为长序列 attention 裁剪的弱工程信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the dynamic-thresholding and FlashAttention integration details; if the claim holds, it is a weak but useful signal for long-sequence attention pruning.

paper.title: Qwen-RobotWorld Technical Report: Unifying Embodied World Modeling through Language-Conditioned Video Generation
paper.abstract: We introduce Qwen-RobotWorld, a language-conditioned video world model for embodied intelligence. With natural language as a unified action interface, it predicts physically grounded future visual trajectories from current observations across robotic manipulation, autonomous driving, indoor navigation, and human-to-robot transfer. This unified formulation provides three promising application directions: synthetic data generation for policy training augmentation, scalable virtual environments for

summary.core_problem: 构建一个以自然语言为统一动作接口的具身智能视频世界模型，用于预测物理上合理的未来视觉轨迹。
summary.importance: 提出了一种统一的具身世界建模范式，通过语言条件下的视频生成，实现了跨机器人操作、自动驾驶、室内导航和人机迁移的统一建模，为策略训练增强、策略评估和下游控制提供了新途径。
summary.technical_approach: 1) 双流 MMDiT 架构：结合冻结的 Qwen2.5-VL 语义和视频 VAE 潜变量，通过层级联合注意力进行动作编码；2) 构建了包含 8.6M 视频-文本对（200M+ 帧）的具身世界知识（EWK）语料库，涵盖 20+ 种具身形态和 500+ 动作类别。
summary.experiments: 在机器人操作、自动驾驶等多个具身场景下进行了验证，但摘要未提供具体的定量结果。
summary.authors_note: 来自阿里 Qwen 团队的技术报告，展示了其在具身智能和多模态世界模型方向的最新进展。

summary_en.core_problem: Building a language-conditioned video world model for embodied intelligence to predict physically grounded future visual trajectories using natural language as a unified action interface.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a unified embodied world modeling paradigm through language-conditioned video generation, achieving unified modeling across robotic manipulation, autonomous driving, indoor navigation, and human-to-robot transfer, providing new avenues for policy training augmentation, policy evaluation, and downstream control.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Double-Stream MMDiT architecture: couples frozen Qwen2.5-VL semantics with video-VAE latents through layer-wise joint attention for action encoding; 2) Constructed the Embodied World Knowledge (EWK) corpus with 8.6M video-text pairs (200M+ frames) covering 20+ embodiments and 500+ action categories.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across multiple embodied scenarios such as robotic manipulation and autonomous driving, but the abstract does not provide specific quantitative results.
summary_en.authors_note: A technical report from the Alibaba Qwen team, showcasing their latest progress in embodied intelligence and multimodal world models.

recommendation.zh: 阿里 Qwen 团队的具身世界模型技术报告，关注其如何将语言作为统一接口来建模跨领域的视频生成，对多模态统一预训练有启发。
recommendation.en: Technical report on embodied world models from the Alibaba Qwen team. Worth noting how they use language as a unified interface for cross-domain video generation modeling, offering insights for multimodal unified pretraining.

paper.title: DreamX-World 1.0: A General-Purpose Interactive World Model
paper.abstract: DreamX-World 1.0 is a general-purpose interactive text/image-to-video world model for controllable long-horizon generation. It supports camera navigation, revisits to previously observed regions, and promptable events across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized domains. Our data engine combines camera-accurate Unreal Engine rendering, action-rich gameplay recordings, and real-world videos with recovered camera geometry. For camera control, we introduce E-PRoPE, a lightweight variant of proje

summary.core_problem: 构建一个支持可控长视野（long-horizon）生成的通用交互式视频世界模型，解决自回归生成中累积的风格和颜色漂移问题。
summary.importance: 提出了 DreamX-World 1.0，这是一个支持相机导航、区域重访和事件提示的交互式世界模型。其核心贡献在于将双向视频生成器转换为少步自回归世界模型的训练 recipe，以及处理长序列生成的稳定性。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 数据引擎：结合 UE 渲染、游戏录像和真实视频（恢复相机几何）。2. 相机控制：提出 E-PRoPE，一种轻量级投影位置编码变体。3. 训练范式：使用因果强制（causal forcing）、DMD 风格蒸馏和 long-rollout 训练，将双向视频生成器转为自回归模型。4. 稳定性：通过在自生成的长视野上下文中训练，让模型暴露于自身生成的历史中，减少自回归块之间的风格/颜色漂移。
summary.experiments: 支持逼真、游戏和风格化领域的长视频生成，实现了相机控制和事件交互。
summary.authors_note: DreamX Team

summary_en.core_problem: Building a general-purpose interactive video world model for controllable long-horizon generation, addressing style and color drift accumulated in autoregressive generation.
summary_en.importance: Introduces DreamX-World 1.0, an interactive world model supporting camera navigation, region revisits, and promptable events. The core contribution lies in the training recipe that converts a bidirectional video generator into a few-step autoregressive world model and stabilizes long-sequence generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Data Engine: Combines UE rendering, gameplay recordings, and real-world videos with recovered camera geometry. 2. Camera Control: Proposes E-PRoPE, a lightweight variant of projective positional encoding. 3. Training Paradigm: Converts a bidirectional video generator into an autoregressive model using causal forcing, DMD-style distillation, and long-rollout training. 4. Stability: Trains on self-generated long-horizon contexts to expose the model to its own generated history, reducing style/color drift across autoregressive chunks.
summary_en.experiments: Supports long video generation across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized domains, achieving camera control and event interaction.
summary_en.authors_note: DreamX Team

recommendation.zh: 关注其将双向生成器转为自回归模型的 long-rollout 训练技巧，对缓解长序列自回归生成的 error accumulation 有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Pay attention to its long-rollout training trick that converts a bidirectional generator to an AR model; useful for mitigating error accumulation in long-sequence AR generation.

paper.title: GeoStream: Toward Precise Camera Controlled Streaming Video Generation
paper.abstract: Accurate interactive camera control is essential for video-based world models, but most existing approaches learn camera motion implicitly, leading to inaccurate control under out-of-distribution trajectories. Explicit geometric conditioning improves controllability, but existing methods are non-autoregressive and rely on a static 3D cache built from an initial frame, which becomes ineffective once the viewpoint moves beyond the original frustum. We propose GeoStream, a framework that enables pr

summary.core_problem: 交互式视频世界模型需要精确相机控制，但隐式学习相机运动的方法在分布外轨迹上控制不准，静态 3D cache 又会在视角移出初始视锥后失效。
summary.importance: 贡献是视频生成和世界模型方向的系统方法：在 autoregressive streaming video generation 中引入在线自刷新几何条件，用于 metric-scale camera control。
summary.technical_approach: GeoStream 维护一个 self-refreshing 3D cache：从最近生成帧估计深度，反投影到 3D，再重投影到目标视角，生成 point reprojection 作为后续合成的几何条件。训练时也用 student 自己生成帧渲染条件，以缩小训练和推理时的条件分布差异。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供训练数据、模型大小、视频长度、baseline 或量化提升。可确认评估重点是 autoregressive streaming video generation 中的精确相机控制，尤其是分布外 camera trajectories。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets controllable streaming video generation, where implicit camera-motion learning fails on out-of-distribution trajectories and a static 3D cache becomes invalid once the view leaves the initial frustum.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a systems-style method for video generation and world models: online refreshed geometric conditioning for metric-scale camera control in autoregressive streaming generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: GeoStream maintains a self-refreshing 3D cache. It estimates depth from the latest generated frame, unprojects it to 3D, reprojects it into the target camera, and uses point reprojections as geometric conditioning for subsequent frames. Training conditions are also rendered from the student's own generated frames to reduce train-test mismatch.
summary_en.experiments: The supplied abstract does not specify training data, model size, sequence length, baselines, or numerical gains. The evaluation focus is precise camera control in autoregressive streaming video generation, especially under out-of-distribution trajectories.

recommendation.zh: 作为视频世界模型工程信号看即可；自刷新 3D cache 思路干净，但离 LLM 预训练方法还有距离。
recommendation.en: Useful as an engineering signal for video world models; the self-refreshing 3D cache is clean, but it is far from LLM pretraining methodology.

paper.title: VideoWeave: Unlocking Geometric Consistency in Video Generation via Joint Geometry-Video Modeling
paper.abstract: Large-scale video diffusion models often fail to preserve 3D structure over time, causing geometric drift and implausible motion under viewpoint changes. Existing methods usually enforce geometric consistency by using explicit geometry reconstructions, such as depth maps, point clouds, or reconstructed 3D structures, to define conditions, supervision, or reward signals, making the generator sensitive to errors from upstream geometry pipelines. We propose VideoWeave, a latent-space post-training

summary.core_problem: 缓解大规模视频扩散模型在视角变化和运动生成中出现的 3D 结构漂移与几何不一致问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是视频生成后训练与几何约束建模方法，并构建 GeoVid-80K 数据集。它不直接服务 LLM 预训练，但对统一视频生成、隐式几何表征和生成模型 post-training 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VideoWeave，在 latent space 中把几何模型的隐式特征适配为 geometry latents，并与 video latents 放入共享 denoising space 联合建模。相比显式深度图、点云或 3D 重建监督，它试图用更柔性的几何特征约束生成分布，降低上游几何重建误差的影响。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到构建 GeoVid-80K，包含 8 万视频数据；未给出 backbone、训练规模、baseline、指标和提升幅度。实验预计围绕几何一致性、视频质量和视角变化鲁棒性展开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce 3D structural drift and geometric inconsistency in large-scale video diffusion models, especially under viewpoint changes and complex motion.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a video-generation post-training method with geometry-aware modeling, plus the GeoVid-80K dataset. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to unified video generation, implicit geometric representations, and generative post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: VideoWeave adapts implicit features from geometry models into geometry latents and jointly models them with video latents in a shared denoising space. Instead of relying on explicit depth maps, point clouds, or reconstructed 3D structures, it uses softer geometry features to constrain the generative distribution and reduce sensitivity to upstream reconstruction errors.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports GeoVid-80K, an 80K-video dataset. It does not specify the backbone, training scale, baselines, metrics, or numerical gains. The evaluation likely focuses on geometric consistency, video quality, and robustness to viewpoint changes.

recommendation.zh: 值得知道它把隐式几何特征并入 denoising latent；若做视频原生预训练，看方法图和数据构造即可。
recommendation.en: Worth noting for injecting implicit geometry into denoising latents; if you work on native video pretraining, skim the method diagram and data construction.

paper.title: CausalMotion: Structured Physical Reasoning as Keyframe and Trajectory Guidance for Training-Free Video Generation
paper.abstract: Recent advances in diffusion-based video generation have significantly improved visual quality and short-term temporal coherence. However, existing methods still struggle to produce videos with physically consistent and causally plausible dynamics, especially in scenarios involving long-horizon interactions. This limitation arises from the fact that video diffusion models primarily learn physical consistency implicitly, while vision-language models can directly model physical laws. Based on this

summary.core_problem: 视频扩散模型在长时交互场景中容易生成物理不一致、因果关系不合理的运动，论文试图在不重新训练模型的前提下改善这一点。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成的推理-生成解耦方法。它不是预训练方法，但把 VLM 的显式物理推理转成视频生成约束，对理解“语言/视觉推理模块如何控制生成模型”有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CausalMotion，一个 training-free 框架。核心做法是用视觉语言模型把文本提示拆成因果一致的关键帧序列和以物体为中心的运动轨迹，再把这些结构化中间表示对齐到预训练视频扩散模型中，作为软约束引导采样。方法重点不在更新视频模型参数，而在把推理结果作为外部控制信号注入生成过程。
summary.experiments: 摘要只说明在视频生成任务上进行了实验，并声称相比现有方法能改善物理一致性和长时因果动态；未提供具体模型规模、训练数据、baseline 名称或量化提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 题注标注为 Cohere 相关工作；Yaohui Wang 是视频生成与多模态生成方向的活跃研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses physically inconsistent and causally implausible motion in long-horizon video generation, especially when pretrained video diffusion models rely on implicit physical regularities.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a reasoning-guided control method for multimodal generation. It is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant as an example of using VLM-style structured reasoning to steer a generative model without retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: CausalMotion is a training-free framework that decouples reasoning from generation. A vision-language model decomposes a prompt into causally consistent keyframes and object-centric trajectories, and these intermediate representations are aligned with a pretrained video diffusion model as soft constraints during generation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on video generation and claims improved physical consistency and causal dynamics over existing methods. It does not specify model sizes, training data, baseline names, or exact improvement numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The listing marks the work as associated with Cohere. Yaohui Wang is an active researcher in video and multimodal generation.

recommendation.zh: 可只看方法图和约束注入方式；对 pretrain 没有直接动作，但能补一个“推理模块控制生成模型”的案例。
recommendation.en: Skim only the method diagram and constraint injection; no direct pretraining action, but a useful case of reasoning modules steering generation.

paper.title: Memento: Reconstruct to Remember for Consistent Long Video Generation
paper.abstract: Long-form video generation requires recurring subjects to remain consistent across various shots, viewpoints, motions, and scene transitions. Existing temporal decomposition methods improve scalability by generating videos shot by shot. However, they mainly focus on optimizing plausible next-shot continuations without verifying whether the historical memory preserves identity-critical subject evidence. Consequently, as generation proceeds, recurring subjects may be diluted, overwritten, or forgo

summary.core_problem: 长视频生成中，同一主体在跨镜头、跨视角、跨动作和场景切换后容易被遗忘或身份漂移。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是长视频生成中的记忆机制与训练目标设计。它和 LLM 预训练没有直接关系，但“记忆是否可重建主体”这个约束对长上下文生成和多模态记忆设计有一点类比价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Memento，将主体保持显式建模为 identity grounding 问题。方法联合训练自回归 next-shot generation 与 memory-based subject reconstruction：如果 memory bank 真正保留了主体关键信息，就应能仅依赖历史记忆和全局故事 caption 重建目标外观。该设计用重建任务约束记忆内容，避免只优化下一镜头的局部连贯性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练视频数据规模、基线名称或量化指标；主要描述目标是改善长视频中 recurring subject 的一致性，并与按镜头分解生成的方法形成对比。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-form video generation often loses or alters recurring subjects across shots, viewpoints, motions, and scene transitions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a memory-training objective for long video generation. It is not directly tied to LLM pretraining, but the reconstruction-based memory constraint is mildly relevant to long-context generative memory design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Memento formulates subject preservation as identity grounding. It jointly trains autoregressive next-shot generation and memory-based subject reconstruction, requiring the memory bank to reconstruct the target subject from historical memory and global story captions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model scale, training data size, baseline list, or quantitative gains. The claimed focus is improved consistency for recurring subjects compared with temporal decomposition methods that only optimize plausible next-shot continuation.

recommendation.zh: 不必读全篇；记住“记忆应支持反向重建”这个约束即可，长视频指标和人评若不干净价值会很有限。
recommendation.en: No need to read end to end; keep the reconstruction-from-memory constraint in mind, while treating the result as weak unless the long-video evaluation is clean.

paper.title: TetherCache: Stabilizing Autoregressive Long-Form Video Generation with Gated Recall and Trusted Alignment
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models provide a natural formulation for streaming and variable-length video generation by conditioning newly generated frames on previously generated content. However, extending these models to minute-level generation remains challenging: the limited KV-cache budget prevents the model from retaining the full history, while repeatedly conditioning on self-generated frames induces a context distribution shift that accumulates over time, leading to visual artifacts,

summary.core_problem: 解决自回归视频扩散模型在长视频生成中因 KV-cache 预算有限和自生成上下文分布漂移导致的质量退化、伪影和时间漂移。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练无关的长程生成缓存管理方法。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但把长上下文生成中的 cache 选择、attention relevance、历史漂移控制放到视频扩散场景里，对研究长程自回归生成有旁证价值。
summary.technical_approach: TetherCache 将缓存划分为 sink、memory 和 recent 三个区域。GRAB 机制用门控分数结合基于注意力的相关性与时间多样性，选择长程记忆帧；另有 trusted alignment 机制，用更可信的历史锚点约束当前生成，减少反复条件化自生成帧带来的漂移。方法是 plug-and-play、training-free，不需要重新训练视频生成模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要称面向分钟级长视频生成，比较长时生成质量、视觉伪影、时间漂移和 cache 预算下的稳定性；未给出具体 backbone、参数量、视频数据集、baseline 名称或量化提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses quality degradation, artifacts, and temporal drift in autoregressive video diffusion models caused by limited KV-cache budgets and distribution shift from self-generated context.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free cache-management method for long-form generation. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but its treatment of cache selection, attention relevance, and drift control is useful as evidence for long-horizon autoregressive generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: TetherCache partitions the cache into sink, memory, and recent regions. GRAB selects long-range memory frames with a gated score combining attention-based relevance and temporal diversity. A trusted-alignment component uses reliable historical anchors to reduce drift from repeatedly conditioning on generated frames. The method is plug-and-play and does not require model retraining.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims evaluation on minute-level video generation, focusing on quality, artifacts, temporal drift, and stability under cache constraints. It does not provide the backbone model, parameter scale, datasets, baseline names, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 可看作视频版长上下文 cache ablation；只扫缓存分区和 GRAB 打分，别把结论外推到文本 LM。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a video-side long-context cache ablation; skim the cache partitioning and GRAB score, but do not over-transfer the claims to text LMs.

paper.title: Helping Figures Tell their Story! Paper-Grounded Video Generation Explaining Complex Scientific Figures
paper.abstract: Scientific figures compress complex pipelines into a single canvas, yet understanding them requires paper-grounded, step-by-step narration aligned with visual highlights a capability missing from current video generation systems and benchmarks. To address this, we introduce paper-grounded figure-to-video generation: generating narrated, region-grounded walkthrough videos from a figure and its paper. We propose MINARD (Multimodal Interpretation of Narrated Architecture via Region Decomposition),

summary.core_problem: 让模型基于论文正文和科学图表，生成带旁白、按区域高亮的解释视频。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成任务定义、方法管线和评测资源。它把科学图表理解、文档 grounding、区域级视觉指代和视频化讲解放在同一任务里，对 VLM/多模态生成评测有一定参考，但不是基座预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MINARD 管线：先从论文和图表生成忠实于论文内容的分步旁白，再把旁白片段顺序对齐到图中区域，形成可视化 walkthrough。论文还发布 FigTalk benchmark，并设计顺序 grounding 和组件级 grounding 指标，用于衡量解释是否对应正确图表区域。
summary.experiments: 在 FigTalk 上比较 MINARD 与已有方法。摘要称 MINARD 在自动指标和人工评估中生成更接近人类、对论文更忠实的旁白，并在 narration-conditioned figure spatial grounding 上优于现有方法；未在摘要中给出模型参数量、训练数据规模或具体提升数字。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Maryland, College Park；Jordan Boyd-Graber 长期从事 NLP、问答、信息检索和人机评测相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to generate narrated, region-grounded explanatory videos for scientific figures using both the figure and the paper text.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a new multimodal generation task, a pipeline, and an evaluation asset. It combines scientific figure understanding, document grounding, visual region reference, and video-style explanation. It is relevant to VLM evaluation and multimodal generation, but it is not a foundation-model pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose MINARD, a pipeline that first generates paper-faithful step-by-step narrations and then sequentially grounds each narration segment to figure regions. They also release FigTalk with sequential and component-level grounding metrics to test whether the generated explanation points to the right parts of the figure.
summary_en.experiments: On FigTalk, MINARD is compared against existing approaches. The abstract reports more humanlike and paper-faithful narrations and better narration-conditioned figure spatial grounding under both automatic and human evaluation, but does not provide parameter scale, training data size, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Maryland, College Park. Jordan Boyd-Graber is known for work in NLP, question answering, information retrieval, and human-centered evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务定义和 grounding 指标即可；它对科学 VLM eval 有用，但不改变多模态预训练的建模选择。
recommendation.en: Skim the task definition and grounding metrics; useful for scientific VLM eval, but it does not change multimodal pretraining design choices.

paper.title: OmniDirector: General Multi-Shot Camera Cloning without Cross-Paired Data
paper.abstract: Cloning camera motion from reference videos is an important task in video generation, as videos provide intuitive and precise control. Existing methods either directly use parametric representations that fail to handle multi-shot generation or synthesize cross-paired data, which suffer from data scarcity, resulting in poor performance in complicated camera motion cloning. To address these issues, we introduce a general camera motion representation that encodes cameras as grid motion videos. This

summary.core_problem: 在缺少cross-paired训练数据的情况下，实现多镜头(multi-shot)视频生成中的相机运动克隆与可控导演式控制。
summary.importance: 属于视频生成控制与表示学习；对“可控生成/控制信号表示”有启发，但对LLM基座预训练的直接方法论贡献有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出将相机参数“可视化”为grid motion video的通用相机运动表示，支持多镜头轨迹组合；在此之上训练统一框架OmniDirector（面向多模态diffusion transformer的角色/动作/相机协同控制）；并用层级prompt扩展agent融合多种控制信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要仅提到使用million-scale camera grid-video pairs训练；未给出具体模型规模、基线、定量指标与提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: General multi-shot camera motion cloning for video generation without cross-paired training data.
summary_en.importance: Primarily about controllable video generation and control-signal representations; only indirect relevance to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Represents camera parameters as a visualized grid-motion video to enable multi-shot trajectory composition; trains a unified OmniDirector framework for multimodal diffusion transformers to coordinate character/action/camera control; adds a hierarchical prompt-expansion agent to integrate control signals.
summary_en.experiments: Mentions training on million-scale camera grid–video pairs, but lacks model size, baselines, metrics, and quantitative gains in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只建议看“camera grid 表示”这一点：把控制变量token化/可视化的思路可迁移到统一建模，其余更像视频生成工程。
recommendation.en: Skim only the “camera grid” representation idea (control-variable tokenization); the rest reads like video-gen engineering.

paper.title: Next Forcing: Causal World Modeling with Multi-Chunk Prediction
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video generation has emerged as a powerful paradigm for World Action Models (WAMs). However, existing approaches suffer from slow training convergence and limited converged accuracy, particularly at high frame rates, as the training supervision is confined to the current chunk without explicit signals about future dynamics; they also suffer from slow inference due to iterative video denoising. In this paper, we present Next Forcing, a multi-chunk prediction (MCP) framework for cau

summary.core_problem: Next Forcing 解决的是自回归视频世界模型中 teacher-forced next-chunk denoising 的短视监督问题：模型只预测当前 chunk，容易依赖相邻帧外观相似性，而不是学习更长程的动态规律；在高帧率视频中，这个问题更明显。
summary.importance: 这篇对预训练目标设计有直接启发。它把 LLM 中 multi-token prediction 的思想迁移到连续视频 latent 和 flow/diffusion 生成过程，用多未来 chunk 监督强化模型对时间动力学的学习。贡献不只是视频领域的指标提升，更重要的是提出了一种可复用的训练信号设计：当相邻 token、frame 或 chunk 的局部预测太容易时，应增加更远未来的辅助预测目标，让梯度更直接地约束表示层中的动态信息。这个思路对高帧率视频预训练、世界模型、动作条件生成，以及统一多模态 LM 的长程建模都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 基础设定是因果视频世界模型，用 flow matching 在视频 latent 空间做 chunk 级生成。常规 teacher forcing 用真实历史 chunk 作为条件，只要求模型去噪当前 chunk。作者指出这会形成 appearance shortcut：相邻 chunk 视觉差异很小，模型可以通过近似复制历史外观来降低 loss，而不需要充分建模物体运动、交互状态和未来动力学。Next Forcing 的核心是 multi-chunk prediction，给主模型添加轻量辅助 MCP 模块，同时预测多个未来 chunk，例如 next 1、next 2、next 3。辅助模块之间形成因果链，使更远未来的预测依赖较近未来的中间预测，而不是各自孤立地从同一上下文回归目标。为了让多步监督真正作用到主干表示，MCP 模块融合主模型多个中间层特征，而不是只接最后一层。作者还给 MCP 模块使用更高的 timestep shift，使辅助预测面对更强噪声或更困难的去噪状态，从而迫使它们更多依赖主模型学到的动态表示。推理时，这些 MCP 模块可以保留，用于并行预测后续 chunk，从训练辅助头变成推理加速组件。和 teacher forcing、self forcing、diffusion forcing 的区别在于，Next Forcing 不主要改变上下文构造或噪声调度，而是改变模型被要求预测的目标范围。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖机器人世界模型、物理理解和通用视频预训练。RoboTwin 上，Next Forcing 达到 Clean/Random 94.1%/93.5%。在 50 fps 设置下，训练收敛速度提升 2.3 倍，并且最终精度更高。推理阶段保留 MCP 模块后，可获得约 2 倍生成加速。PhyWorld 上报告了明显提升，说明多未来 chunk 监督对物理规律理解有帮助。作者还在 350 万条内部视频 clip 的通用视频预训练上验证，FVD 降低超过 50%，这说明改进不只来自机器人数据或特定任务结构。消融重点包括 timestep shift、多层特征融合和因果 MCP chain：这些组件共同决定多 chunk 预测能否从离散语言 token 场景有效迁移到连续视频 latent 场景。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读到半精读，预计 35–45 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 myopic supervision 和 appearance shortcut 的定义，再看方法部分的 MCP 结构图和训练目标。实验部分重点看 Figure 1 的 50 fps 收敛曲线，以及 Section 5 的消融实验，尤其是 timestep shift、多层 feature fusion、causal MCP chain 三个设计的单独贡献。若关注 LLM 预训练，可把它当作 multi-token prediction 在非文本生成中的一次具体改造来读：难点不在“多预测几个未来步”这个表面形式，而在连续 latent、迭代去噪和长程动态之间如何传递有效梯度。

summary_en.core_problem: Next Forcing addresses the myopic supervision problem in autoregressive video world models. Standard teacher-forced next-chunk denoising only supervises the current chunk, so the model can exploit visual similarity between adjacent chunks instead of learning longer-range dynamics. This shortcut becomes especially harmful at high frame rates.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to pretraining objective design. It adapts the intuition behind multi-token prediction in language models to continuous video latents and flow/diffusion-style generation. The broader lesson is that when local prediction is too easy, auxiliary prediction of farther future states can provide a stronger training signal for dynamics. This is useful for high-frame-rate video pretraining, action-conditioned world models, and unified multimodal models where temporal structure is not well captured by a purely local loss.
summary_en.technical_approach: The base model is a causal video world model trained with flow matching over video chunks. In the standard setup, the model denoises the current chunk conditioned on clean past chunks. Next Forcing augments this setup with lightweight multi-chunk prediction modules that predict multiple future chunks, such as next 1, next 2, and next 3. These modules form a causal prediction chain, so farther-horizon prediction is not just an independent auxiliary head attached to the same representation. To make the auxiliary losses affect the main model more directly, the MCP modules fuse intermediate features from multiple main-model layers rather than using only the final layer. The paper also applies a larger timestep shift to the MCP modules, making their denoising task harder and increasing their reliance on the main model’s learned temporal representation. At inference time, the auxiliary modules can be kept to predict future chunks in parallel with the current generation process, turning the training auxiliary path into an acceleration mechanism. The method differs from teacher forcing, self forcing, and diffusion forcing because it changes what the model is asked to predict, rather than only changing the context or the noise schedule.
summary_en.experiments: On RoboTwin, Next Forcing reports 94.1% on the Clean split and 93.5% on the Random split. At 50 fps, it reaches 2.3x faster convergence and a higher converged accuracy than standard next-chunk training. Keeping the MCP modules during inference gives about 2x generation acceleration. The method also improves performance on PhyWorld, indicating better physical-dynamics modeling. On general video pretraining with 3.5M in-house video clips, it reduces FVD by more than 50%, suggesting that the benefit is not limited to robot-specific data. The most informative ablations are on timestep shift, multi-layer feature fusion, and the causal MCP chain, which are the components that make multi-chunk prediction work for continuous video latents.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim to semi-close read in about 35–45 minutes. Start with the discussion of myopic supervision and appearance shortcuts in the introduction. Then read the MCP architecture and objective carefully. In the experiments, prioritize the 50 fps convergence curve in Figure 1 and the ablations in Section 5. For LLM pretraining researchers, the useful angle is not the video application alone, but how a multi-token-prediction-style objective is modified for continuous latents, iterative denoising, and long-horizon temporal dynamics.

recommendation.zh: 只看训练目标设计即可；视频结果未给足细节，但多步未来监督可作为 AR 预训练的弱类比。
recommendation.en: Read the objective, not the video metrics; the multi-horizon supervision is a useful weak analogue for AR pretraining.

paper.title: Flow-DPPO: Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization for Flow Matching Models
paper.abstract: Recent work has demonstrated that online reinforcement learning (RL) can substantially improve the quality and alignment of flow matching models for image and video generation. Methods such as Flow-GRPO and CPS cast the denoising process as a Markov Decision Process and apply PPO-style ratio clipping to enforce a trust region. However, we argue that ratio clipping is structurally ill-suited for flow models: the probability ratio between new and old policies is a noisy, single-sample estimate of

summary.core_problem: 改进 flow matching 图像和视频生成模型的在线 RL 优化，避免 PPO ratio clipping 在连续去噪轨迹中产生不稳定或错误的 trust region 约束。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型后训练方法改进。它不直接推进文本 LLM 预训练，但对“把生成过程视为 MDP 并用 RL 调生成模型”的接口有参考价值，尤其是 trust region 约束如何利用模型分布结构来做得更干净。
summary.technical_approach: Flow-DPPO 将 Flow-GRPO、CPS 一类方法中的 PPO ratio clipping 替换为 divergence proximal constraint。核心观察是 flow model 每一步 policy 可写成 Gaussian，因此新旧 policy 的 KL divergence 可以精确且低成本计算。方法进一步使用 asymmetric divergence mask：在超出约束的方向阻断梯度，在允许区域内保留优化信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体图像/视频模型规模、数据集、奖励模型、baseline 数量或提升幅度。可确认的 baseline 包括 Flow-GRPO 和 CPS，目标是提升 flow matching 生成模型的质量与对齐。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper improves online RL for flow-matching image and video generators by replacing noisy PPO ratio clipping with a better-specified trust-region constraint.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method for generative flow models. It is not directly about text LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to the broader interface between generative modeling and RL-based alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Flow-DPPO replaces PPO-style ratio clipping used by methods such as Flow-GRPO and CPS with a divergence proximal constraint. The key observation is that each per-step policy in a flow model is Gaussian, so the KL divergence between old and new policies can be computed exactly and cheaply. An asymmetric divergence mask blocks gradients only when the update violates the desired trust region.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, reward models, or quantitative gains. It positions Flow-GRPO and CPS as the main baselines and targets quality/alignment improvements for image and video flow-matching models.

recommendation.zh: 只看 KL 约束替代 ratio clipping 的推导；对文本预训练不直接有用，但可借鉴到生成模型 RL 接口。
recommendation.en: Read only the KL-vs-ratio-clipping argument; it is not directly useful for text pretraining, but the RL interface design is transferable.

paper.title: MilliVid: Hierarchical Latents for Long-Range Consistency in Video Generation
paper.abstract: Video generative models have become increasingly powerful, but long-range consistency remains challenging to achieve because even a few dozen frames require impractically long transformer sequence lengths. We show that this issue can be mitigated by generating video using coarse-to-fine rollout within a multi-scale token space. Our approach is simple: first, we pre-train an autoencoder that compresses each frame into a hierarchy of tokens, with levels ranging from the typical latent resolution t

summary.core_problem: 视频生成模型难以实现长距离一致性，长帧序列会导致Transformer计算开销过高的问题
summary.importance: 提出层级潜在token+粗到细生成的范式，为长序列生成的效率与一致性平衡提供了新的架构思路，属于视频生成领域的高创新性工作
summary.technical_approach: 提出MilliVid框架：1）预训练自编码器将每帧压缩为多尺度层级token，粗级别捕获场景布局与核心语义，细级别补充高频外观与纹理；2）训练视频扩散模型在该token空间中按粗到细的rollout生成，每步控制上下文的细节级别
summary.experiments: 通过层级token大幅压缩长视频的有效序列长度，显著提升了生成视频的几何一致性与物体永久性，支持更长视频的稳定生成
summary.authors_note: MIT CSAIL团队，Phillip Isola、Vincent Sitzmann为生成模型与3D视觉领域的知名学者

summary_en.core_problem: Video generative models struggle with long-range consistency, and long frame sequences lead to prohibitively high Transformer computational overhead
summary_en.importance: Proposes a hierarchical latent token + coarse-to-fine generation paradigm, providing a new architectural idea for balancing efficiency and consistency in long-sequence generation, a highly innovative work in video generation domain
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes MilliVid framework: 1) Pre-train an autoencoder to compress each frame into multi-scale hierarchical tokens, with coarse levels capturing scene layout and core semantics, and fine levels adding high-frequency appearance and texture; 2) Train a video diffusion model to generate tokens in this space via coarse-to-fine rollout, controlling the detail level of context at each step
summary_en.experiments: Significantly compresses effective sequence length of long videos via hierarchical tokens, notably improves geometric consistency and object permanence of generated videos, enabling stable generation of longer videos
summary_en.authors_note: MIT CSAIL team; Phillip Isola and Vincent Sitzmann are well-known scholars in generative models and 3D vision

recommendation.zh: 层级多尺度token的设计对统一多模态tokenizer、长上下文建模有明确参考，重点看自编码器结构与生成rollout逻辑
recommendation.en: Hierarchical multi-scale token design has clear reference for unified multimodal tokenizer and long-context modeling; focus on the autoencoder architecture and generation rollout logic.

paper.title: ViMax: Agentic Video Generation
paper.abstract: Long-form video generation requires systematic narrative planning and visual consistency that current short-clip methods cannot provide. Existing methods generate isolated sequences without narrative structure and lack mechanisms for maintaining character and environmental consistency across scenes. We present ViMax, an agentic video generation framework that addresses video creation through coordinated multi-agent collaboration where specialized components negotiate narrative decisions, visual

summary.core_problem: 现有长视频生成方法缺乏叙事结构设计，无法跨场景维持角色与环境一致性。
summary.importance: 范式创新，首次将多智能体协作框架引入长视频生成，解决长时序叙事与一致性难题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ViMax多智能体长视频生成框架，包含分层叙事引擎实现全局故事连贯性、依赖感知视觉一致性机制跟踪跨时序状态、VLM引导的智能体持续监控优化叙事与视觉质量。
summary.experiments: 未公开具体量化对比指标，验证了框架可生成长时长连贯叙事内容，维持故事与视觉一致性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港大学、新加坡国立大学等机构，研究方向为多模态生成与智能体系统。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long-form video generation methods lack narrative structure design and cannot maintain character and environmental consistency across scenes.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm innovation, first introduces a multi-agent collaboration framework into long-form video generation to solve long-sequence narrative and consistency challenges.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ViMax multi-agent long-form video generation framework, including a hierarchical narrative engine for global story coherence, a dependency-aware visual consistency mechanism to track cross-temporal states, and VLM-guided agents to continuously monitor and optimize narrative and visual quality.
summary_en.experiments: No specific quantitative comparison metrics released; verifies the framework can generate long-form coherent narrative content, maintaining story and visual consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from The University of Hong Kong, National University of Singapore and other institutions, with research directions in multimodal generation and agent systems.

recommendation.zh: 多智能体长视频生成的概念性框架，暂无严格量化实验，仅作为多模态生成领域的新方向参考，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Conceptual framework for multi-agent long-form video generation, lacking rigorous quantitative experiments; only serves as a reference for new directions in multimodal generation, no in-depth reading required.

paper.title: BioVid: Autoregressive Video Generation with Biological Behavior Semantic Comprehension
paper.abstract: Existing video generation frameworks treat sequence duration as an externally prescribed parameter -- fixed frame counts or text prompts -- producing clips whose temporal boundaries are decoupled from the statistical structure of real behavioral data. This assumption is fundamentally misaligned with biological behavior, where action duration varies naturally across individuals and instances and is encoded in the data itself. We present BioVid, a data-driven autoregressive video generation framew

summary.core_problem: 现有视频生成框架通常将序列持续时间作为外部规定的参数（固定帧数或文本提示），导致生成视频的时间边界与真实行为数据的统计结构脱节。
summary.importance: 提出 BioVid，一个数据驱动的自回归视频生成框架，能够直接从训练数据中学习生物行为的时间结构及其自然长度分布。
summary.technical_approach: 第一阶段：使用有限标量量化 GAN (FSQ-R3GAN) tokenizer 将视频帧编码为紧凑的离散表示，结合 R3GAN 的稳定相对论训练目标和 FSQ 的码本利用率保证，实现高保真空间重建且无码本崩溃。第二阶段：使用因果 Transformer 进行自回归生成。
summary.experiments: 在生物行为视频数据上进行了实验。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing video generation frameworks treat sequence duration as an external parameter, decoupling temporal boundaries from the statistical structure of real behavioral data.
summary_en.importance: Introduces BioVid, a data-driven autoregressive video generation framework that learns the temporal structure and natural length distributions of biological behaviors directly from data.
summary_en.technical_approach: Stage 1: An FSQ-R3GAN tokenizer encodes video frames into discrete representations, combining R3GAN's objective with FSQ for high-fidelity reconstruction without codebook collapse. Stage 2: A causal Transformer performs autoregressive generation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on biological behavior video data.

recommendation.zh: 自回归视频生成工作，强调学习自然行为的长度分布，其 FSQ-R3GAN tokenizer 设计对多模态离散化有一定参考意义，但整体偏向特定领域的视频生成。
