recommendation.en: Autoregressive video generation focusing on natural behavior length distributions; the FSQ-R3GAN tokenizer design is somewhat relevant to multimodal discretization, but overall application-specific.

paper.title: Prisma-World: Camera-Controllable Multi-Agent Video World Model
paper.abstract: Video world models have made rapid progress in generating controllable visual experiences, but most of them still simulate the world from a single observer. Extending such models to multiple agents raises a central challenge: if each agent's future state is generated independently, overlapping views may instantiate different versions of the same scene, leading to inconsistent objects, layouts, and appearances across agents. Conventional camera conditioning controls individual trajectories, but i

summary.core_problem: 如何生成多智能体视角下几何一致、相机可控的视频？
summary.importance: 提出了一种多智能体视频世界模型，解决了多视角生成中场景几何不一致的问题，对具身智能和多视角视频生成有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将多智能体生成构建为联合几何感知的去噪过程。在一个全注意力序列中处理所有智能体的视频，使用多智能体 RoPE 区分智能体身份并保持时间坐标同步，注入相对相机姿态作为几何条件。
summary.experiments: 在多智能体视频生成任务上进行了实验，验证了跨视角一致性和相机控制能力。

summary_en.core_problem: How to generate geometry-consistent and camera-controllable videos from multi-agent perspectives?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a multi-agent video world model that addresses the issue of scene geometry inconsistency in multi-view generation, offering reference value for embodied AI and multi-view video generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formulates multi-agent generation as a joint geometry-aware denoising process. Processes all agent videos within a full-attention sequence, uses multi-agent RoPE to distinguish identities while preserving temporal coordinates, and injects relative camera poses as geometric conditions.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted experiments on multi-agent video generation tasks, validating cross-view consistency and camera control capabilities.

recommendation.zh: 多视角视频生成工作，对纯 LLM 预训练启发有限，可作为多模态世界模型构建的参考。
recommendation.en: Multi-view video generation work; limited inspiration for pure LLM pretraining, but serves as a reference for multimodal world model construction.

paper.title: CineDance: Towards Next-Generation Multi-Shot Long-Form Cinematic Audio-Video Generation
paper.abstract: The fidelity and structural diversity of training datasets fundamentally determine the capabilities of video generation models. While commercial systems showremarkableabilitytogeneratecinematicnarratives, the progress of open-source models remains limited by the scarcity of high-quality training data. To bridge this gap, we introduce CineDance-1M, a large-scale, open research Text-to-Audio-Video (T2AV) dataset designed specifically for multi-shot, long-form joint audio-video generation. Averagin

summary.core_problem: 开源长时序多镜头音视频联合生成模型受限于高质量结构化训练数据不足，性能落后于商业系统
summary.importance: 数据与基准贡献，发布了百万级多镜头长时序音视频数据集及配套评测基准，填补开源领域空白
summary.technical_approach: 构建三阶段数据处理流水线：多源采集清洗、电影理论驱动的叙事结构解析、层级化双模态标注，同时提出六维度人类对齐的评测指标体系
summary.experiments: 发布CineDance-1M数据集，含100万个样本，平均时长92.8秒、24.2个连续镜头，配套CineBench评测基准覆盖多维度生成质量评估
summary.authors_note: 团队包括Dacheng Tao等多模态生成领域研究者

summary_en.core_problem: Open-source long-form multi-shot audio-video generation models lag behind commercial systems due to the lack of high-quality structured training data
summary_en.importance: Data and benchmark contribution, releasing a 1M-scale multi-shot long-form audio-video dataset and supporting evaluation benchmark to fill the gap in open-source domain
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds a three-stage data processing pipeline: diverse sourcing and cleansing, film-theory-inspired narrative parsing, hierarchical dual-modal captioning; also proposes a six-dimensional human-aligned evaluation metric system
summary_en.experiments: Releases CineDance-1M dataset with 1M samples, averaging 92.8 seconds and 24.2 continuous shots per video, along with CineBench benchmark covering multi-dimensional generation quality evaluation
summary_en.authors_note: The team includes researchers in multimodal generation such as Dacheng Tao

recommendation.zh: 多模态生成领域的数据集工作，对LLM基座预训练无直接启发，仅作为领域进展了解即可
recommendation.en: Dataset work in multimodal generation, no direct insight for LLM foundation pretraining, only worth knowing as domain progress

paper.title: LoomVideo: Unifying Multimodal Inputs into Video Generation and Editing
paper.abstract: Developing unified video generation and editing models capable of interpreting interleaved multimodal inputs is a promising yet challenging frontier field. Existing unified frameworks predominantly rely on massive models (typically 13B parameters or more) and incorporate source video conditions for editing by concatenating sequence tokens. This concatenation inevitably doubles the sequence length, quadrupling the computational complexity of the self-attention mechanism and introducing prohibitiv

summary.core_problem: 现有统一视频生成编辑模型普遍参数量大（13B+），编辑时拼接源视频token会导致序列长度倍增、自注意力计算成本上升四倍的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出了低参数量的统一视频生成编辑架构，以及零开销的视频编辑条件注入方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出5B参数的LoomVideo统一架构，用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）替换标准文本编码器，通过Deepstack注入机制对齐MLLM多层特征与Diffusion Transformer（DiT）；核心创新是Scale-and-Add缩放加和的零开销条件注入方法，避免编辑时序列长度扩张。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露完整实验结果，核心设计目标是在5B参数量下实现与13B+大模型相当的生成编辑效果，同时降低推理开销。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing unified video generation and editing models are typically large (13B+ parameters), and concatenating source video tokens during editing doubles sequence length, quadrupling self-attention computation cost.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposing a low-parameter unified video generation and editing architecture and a zero-overhead conditioning injection method for video editing.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the 5B-parameter LoomVideo unified architecture, replacing standard text encoders with Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLM), aligning multi-layer MLLM features with Diffusion Transformer (DiT) via Deepstack injection mechanism; core innovation is the zero-overhead Scale-and-Add conditioning injection to avoid sequence length expansion during editing.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental results are not disclosed in the abstract; the core design goal is to achieve generation and editing performance comparable to 13B+ large models with 5B parameters while reducing inference overhead.

recommendation.zh: 多模态生成中MLLM与DiT的多层特征对齐设计可做多模态预训练的弱参考，仅扫摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The multi-layer feature alignment design between MLLM and DiT for multimodal generation serves as weak reference for multimodal pretraining, only skim the abstract.

paper.title: NVIDIA OmniDreams: Real-Time Generative World Model for Closed-Loop Autonomous Vehicle Simulation
paper.abstract: As autonomous vehicle capabilities advance, the safe evaluation of driving policies in long-tail scenarios remains a critical bottleneck. In closed-loop simulation, the driving policy model actively interacts with the environment, where its actions dynamically update the simulator state and directly influence the next set of generated sensor observations. While recent reconstruction-based neural simulators offer photorealism, they are fundamentally constrained by their initial captured data and

summary.core_problem: 自动驾驶闭环仿真中，传统重建式神经模拟器受限于初始采集数据，无法泛化到高度动态或全新场景。
summary.importance: 系统创新：NVIDIA提出基于Cosmos扩散模型的生成式世界模型OmniDreams，用于自动驾驶实时闭环仿真。大规模训练(21k小时驾驶数据)。
summary.technical_approach: 从Cosmos扩散模型进行中期和后期训练(mid- and post-training)，自回归生成动作条件视频。结合世界模型，实时生成。
summary.experiments: 在21k小时驾驶场景数据上训练，能合成传统模拟器难以捕捉的复杂未观测现象(如极端天气、异常驾驶行为)。摘要被截断。
summary.authors_note: NVIDIA。包含Amlan Kar, Despoina Paschalidou等知名研究员。Cosmos是NVIDIA的基础扩散模型。

summary_en.core_problem: Reconstruction-based neural simulators for autonomous driving are fundamentally constrained by initial captured data and fail to generalize to highly dynamic or novel scenes in closed-loop simulation.
summary_en.importance: System innovation: NVIDIA proposes OmniDreams, a generative world model built on Cosmos diffusion model for real-time closed-loop AV simulation. Large-scale training (21k hours of driving data).
summary_en.technical_approach: Mid- and post-training from the Cosmos diffusion model to autoregressively generate action-conditioned videos in real time. Leverages rich visual priors of Cosmos foundation model.
summary_en.experiments: Trained on 21k hours of driving scenarios. Synthesizes complex unobserved phenomena hard for traditional simulators (extreme weather, anomalous driving behaviors). Abstract is truncated.
summary_en.authors_note: NVIDIA. Includes notable researchers such as Amlan Kar, Despoina Paschalidou. Cosmos is NVIDIA's foundation diffusion model.

recommendation.zh: NVIDIA在世界模型+自动驾驶仿真方向的工程性工作。对LLM基座研究参考价值有限，作为行业动态了解即可。
recommendation.en: NVIDIA engineering work on world models for AV simulation. Limited reference value for LLM foundation research; useful as industry context.

paper.title: Video-Mirai: Autoregressive Video Diffusion Models Need Foresight
paper.abstract: Causal video generators must predict from the past, but they need not learn only from it. In streaming autoregressive video diffusion, each emitted segment becomes a commitment that future segments must preserve. Standard training, however, only asks each causal state to explain the present. This creates what we call a representation-level planning gap: states that fit the current segment may discard identity, layout, and motion information needed for a consistent future. We introduce Video-Mira

summary.core_problem: 自回归视频扩散模型中存在表示层规划缺口：训练中每个因果状态只需解释当前片段，但推理时当前状态还需携带未来一致性所需的身份/布局/运动信息。
summary.importance: 提出了一种纯训练阶段的方法，在不改变推理架构和FLOPs的情况下改进视频生成的时序一致性。属于对AR扩散生成范式的训练策略改进。
summary.technical_approach: Video-Mirai：生成器按因果方式展开，冻结的foresight encoder非因果地读取完整展开结果，轻量级predictor将stop-gradient目标蒸馏到因果状态中。未来帧监督表示而非生成器输入。推理时丢弃encoder和predictor。
summary.experiments: 在视频生成任务上验证，推理架构/每步FLOPs/KV-cache行为不变的前提下改善时序一致性，具体模型参数量和benchmark细节未在摘要中详述。
summary.authors_note: The University of Tokyo, National Institute of Informatics, Peking University

summary_en.core_problem: Causal video diffusion models suffer a representation-level planning gap: states trained to explain only the present may discard identity/layout/motion information needed for future consistency.
summary_en.importance: A training-only method that improves temporal consistency without changing inference architecture, FLOPs, or KV-cache behavior. Training strategy improvement for AR diffusion generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Generator rolls out causally; a frozen foresight encoder reads the completed rollout non-causally; a lightweight predictor distills stopped-gradient targets into causal states. Future frames supervise representations, never inputs. Encoder/predictor discarded at inference.
summary_en.experiments: Verified on video generation tasks; inference architecture/per-step FLOPs/KV-cache unchanged while temporal consistency improved. Specific model sizes not fully detailed in abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: U Tokyo, NII, Peking University

recommendation.zh: CV视频生成领域工作，对LLM预训练的边际启发是：AR模型训练中的representation planning gap概念值得类比思考。看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: CV video generation work. Marginal relevance to LLM pretraining: the 'representation planning gap' concept in AR training is worth analogizing. Read abstract only.

paper.title: Echo-Infinity: Learning Evolving Memory for Real-Time Infinite Video Generation
paper.abstract: We present Echo Infinity, an autoregressive (AR) framework towards real-time infinite video generation that employs a learnable evolving memory to dynamically filter, abstract, and compress any-length history at constant cost. Existing methods mainly curate memory with predefined KV-cache schedules, fixed-ratio heuristic compression, or inference-time RoPE adaptation. These designs inevitably lose historical information and amplify compounding errors due to their limited cache window and ignoran

summary.core_problem: 解决无限长视频自回归生成中，历史上下文随长度增长而导致计算和显存失控、同时固定启发式记忆压缩会累积误差的问题。
summary.importance: 这是视频生成里的长时记忆建模工作，贡献类型偏方法与系统设计。对做基座预训练的人，价值不在视频本身，而在“可学习压缩记忆替代手工 KV 管理”这个思路，和长序列生成中的训练-推理一致性问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Echo-Infinity，一个面向实时无限视频生成的 AR 框架。核心是可学习的 evolving memory：当旧帧离开局部窗口后，不是按固定规则丢弃或压缩，而是用一组 Memory Query 通过注意力和门控机制吸收、过滤并抽象历史信息。这些查询与视频 DiT 端到端联合训练，在常数计算成本下支持任意长度历史，并兼作跨长度泛化的压缩状态表示。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称方法在任意视频长度下保持常数级计算，并面向实时无限视频生成；对比对象包括预定义 KV-cache 调度、固定比例压缩和推理时 RoPE 适配等长视频记忆方案。摘要未给出明确参数量、训练数据规模和具体提升幅度，因此当前更适合作为方法信号而非定量结论。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles infinite-length autoregressive video generation, where context growth makes compute and memory explode, while heuristic memory compression causes information loss and compounding errors.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a long-horizon video generation method/system paper. For pretraining researchers, the value is not the video domain itself but the idea of replacing handcrafted cache management with learned memory compression, plus the train-inference consistency issue in long-sequence generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Echo-Infinity, an AR framework for real-time infinite video generation. Its key component is a learnable evolving memory: when old frames leave the local window, they are not discarded or heuristically compressed; instead, a set of Memory Queries absorbs, filters, and abstracts past information via attention and gating. These queries are trained end-to-end with video DiTs, yielding constant-cost history compression and a compact state that generalizes across sequence lengths.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims constant compute with arbitrary video length and targets real-time infinite generation. Baselines include predefined KV-cache schedules, fixed-ratio compression, and inference-time RoPE adaptation. The abstract does not provide model size, training data scale, or exact gains, so this is currently more of a method signal than a fully quantified result.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 主线，但“可学习记忆替代手工 cache 策略”这个点值得借去看；先看 memory update 设计，效果数字先别太当真。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but the learned-memory-over-handcrafted-cache idea is worth stealing; read the memory update design first and treat the gains as a weak signal until the setup is clearer.

paper.title: LongLive-RAG: A General Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Long Video Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion enables variable-length synthesis, but long-horizon generation often suffers from accumulated errors and identity drift. For efficiency, existing methods commonly adopt sliding-window attention during generation. This creates an irreversible generation trajectory: once the active window accumulates appearance errors, subsequent generations can only condition on this degraded trajectory and drift further away. We address this limitation by formulating long vide

summary.core_problem: 自回归视频扩散模型在长视频生成中存在累积误差和身份漂移问题。现有方法通常采用滑动窗口注意力，一旦活动窗口积累了外观误差，后续生成只能以这条已退化的轨迹为条件，导致误差不可逆地传播。
summary.importance: 提出了一种新的思路：将开放式 AR 视频生成本质上视为对自身生成隐状态的检索问题，而不是通过固定锚点、位置外推或压缩历史来解决窗口限制。这对长序列生成中的误差累积问题提供了一个通用框架，在视频生成之外也有启发意义——任何带滑动窗口截断的 AR 生成都可能从类似的检索增强思路中受益。
summary.technical_approach: LongLive-RAG 保持基础生成器不变，仅在注意力上下文中注入检索到的历史信息。具体来说：在生成每个新块之前，用一个轻量级编码器将最近完成的隐向量映射为查询嵌入，从已生成的历史隐向量库中检索 Top-K 最相关的历史条目，将其直接拼接到当前注意力上下文（而不是用压缩摘要替代）。关键创新是检索嵌入空间的训练：相邻视频块的隐向量通常非常相似，普通重建目标会使检索返回几乎相同的邻居块。为此引入 Window Temporal Delta Loss 来降低近邻块嵌入的过度相似性，同时加平滑项保证时序稳定性。
summary.experiments: 在三个 AR 骨干（Causal-Forcing、Self-Forcing、LongLive）和三种生成长度（30s、60s、120s）上与两个基线对比：∞-RoPE（位置外推）和 Deep Forcing（压缩历史 token）。LongLive-RAG 在 VBench-Long 上取得最好平均排名，在主体一致性、背景一致性、运动平滑性和成像质量四个维度均有提升。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Section 3.3（检索嵌入训练，含 Window Temporal Delta Loss）和 Figure 1（核心思想示意）。Section 2 关于现有三种思路（锚点、位置外推、压缩历史）局限性的讨论值得关注。泛读约 15-20 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 无法从提供内容中确认具体机构和作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Autoregressive video diffusion models suffer from accumulated errors and identity drift in long video generation. Sliding-window attention creates an irreversible trajectory: once the active window accumulates appearance errors, subsequent generations can only condition on this degraded trajectory.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a new framing: open-ended AR video generation is fundamentally a retrieval problem over self-generated latents, rather than solving window limits via fixed anchors, positional extrapolation, or compressed history. This provides a general framework for error accumulation in long-sequence generation that may generalize beyond video—any AR generation with sliding-window truncation could benefit from a similar retrieval-augmented approach.
summary_en.technical_approach: LongLive-RAG keeps the base generator unchanged and only injects retrieved historical context into the attention context. Before generating each new block, a lightweight encoder maps the most recent completed latent to a query embedding, retrieves the Top-K most relevant historical entries from a bank of previously generated latents, and concatenates them directly into the current attention context (rather than replacing with compressed summaries). The key innovation is retrieval embedding space training: adjacent video block latents are often very similar, and a plain reconstruction objective makes retrieval return nearly identical neighbors. A Window Temporal Delta Loss is introduced to reduce excessive similarity among nearby block embeddings, paired with a smoothing term to maintain temporal stability.
summary_en.experiments: Compared against two baselines (∞-RoPE for positional extrapolation and Deep Forcing for compressed-history tokens) across three AR backbones (Causal-Forcing, Self-Forcing, LongLive) and three generation lengths (30s, 60s, 120s). LongLive-RAG achieves the best average rank on VBench-Long, with improvements in subject consistency, background consistency, motion smoothness, and imaging quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3.3 (retrieval embedding training including Window Temporal Delta Loss) and Figure 1 (core idea illustration). The discussion in Section 2 about limitations of three existing approaches (anchors, positional extrapolation, compressed history) is also worth reading. Casual read takes 15-20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Specific institution and author information not identifiable from the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法图：把生成 latent 当可检索记忆，比简单加窗口更像长程生成的工程解法。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure: treating generated latents as retrievable memory is a cleaner long-horizon fix than just widening the window.

paper.title: Retrieve What's Missing: Coverage-Maximizing Retrieval for Consistent Long Video Generation
paper.abstract: Maintaining long-term geometric consistency remains challenging for long-horizon autoregressive video generation. Memory-augmented generative models address this by retrieving historical frames, but their effectiveness depends on two key design choices: what 3D-geometric evidence should represent past observations, and how memory frames should be selected from this evidence. Existing methods often rely on camera poses or field-of-view overlap, which are lightweight but too coarse to reason about

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程自回归视频生成中几何一致性难以维持的问题，尤其是历史帧记忆该如何表示和检索。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向视频生成的 retrieval-augmented memory 设计：用轻量深度几何证据替代粗糙 camera pose/FOV overlap 或昂贵 3D reconstruction。它对多模态生成的长程记忆机制有参考价值，但不是 LLM 预训练核心工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Coverage-Maximizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation。方法用 pretrained 3D priors 构造目标视角 coverage map，作为轻量 3D memory evidence；检索时最大化 residual coverage gain，迭代选择能解释目标视角未覆盖区域的历史帧。核心思想是按目标视角可见性覆盖补全来检索，而不是按时间邻近或相机重叠粗选。
summary.experiments: 摘要称用于 long-horizon autoregressive video generation，并与依赖 camera poses、field-of-view overlap 或显式 3D reconstruction 的历史帧选择策略比较；未给出具体模型、数据集、baseline 数值和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 Korea University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles long-term geometric consistency in long-horizon autoregressive video generation, focusing on how historical frames should be represented and retrieved.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a retrieval-augmented memory design for video generation, using lightweight depth-based geometric evidence instead of coarse camera-pose/FOV heuristics or expensive explicit 3D reconstruction. It is relevant to memory mechanisms in multimodal generation, but not central to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: COVRAG builds a target-view coverage map using pretrained 3D priors as lightweight 3D memory evidence. For memory selection, it maximizes residual coverage gain, iteratively retrieving historical frames that explain regions of the target view not yet covered. The main idea is to retrieve by target-view visibility coverage rather than simple temporal proximity or camera overlap.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated for long-horizon autoregressive video generation and compared against memory retrieval strategies based on camera poses, field-of-view overlap, or explicit 3D reconstruction. The abstract does not provide concrete model names, datasets, baseline numbers, or improvement margins.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution: Korea University.

recommendation.zh: 视频生成里的 RAG 记忆选择有一点借鉴意义；预训练方向只需看 coverage objective，别被长视频应用细节拖住。
recommendation.en: The RAG-style memory selection is mildly useful for video generation; for pretraining interests, inspect the coverage objective and ignore most application details.

paper.title: SKIP: Sparse Keyframe Interpolation Paradigm for Efficient Embodied World Models
paper.abstract: Embodied world models have emerged as a promising paradigm in robotics by predicting how robot actions affect the surrounding scene. However, the rollout inference remains computationally expensive in pixel space, as long-horizon manipulation videos typically have to be generated frame by frame. This cost cannot be easily reduced by indiscriminately dropping frames, since downstream policies rely on complete preservation of sparse task-relevant events such as approach, contact, grasp, and releas

summary.core_problem: 如何降低具身世界模型（Embodied World Models）在像素空间进行长视野操作视频逐帧生成的计算成本，同时保留关键任务事件？
summary.importance: 提出了一种稀疏到密集的视频生成框架，在提高具身世界模型推理效率的同时，保证了下游策略所需的关键事件（如接触、抓取）不丢失。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SKIP (Sparse Keyframe Interpolation Paradigm)。首先利用机器人感知的多模态特征识别任务相关的关键帧；然后使用稀疏视频扩散模型仅合成这些关键帧；最后，通过学习到的间隙预测器和以动作为条件的插值器，根据机器人动作重建缺失的间隔。
summary.experiments: 在 LIBERO 等数据集上进行了评估（摘要未详述具体指标，但强调了效率和事件保留）。
summary.authors_note: 北京大学、北京通用人工智能研究院（BIGAI）等机构合作。

summary_en.core_problem: How to reduce the computational cost of frame-by-frame generation for long-horizon manipulation videos in pixel space for Embodied World Models, while preserving key task events?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a sparse-to-dense video generation framework that improves the inference efficiency of embodied world models while ensuring that key events (e.g., contact, grasp) required by downstream policies are not lost.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SKIP (Sparse Keyframe Interpolation Paradigm). It first identifies task-relevant keyframes using robot-aware multimodal features. Then, it synthesizes only these keyframes with a sparse video diffusion model. Finally, a learned gap predictor and an action-conditioned interpolator reconstruct the missing intervals based on robot actions.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on datasets like LIBERO (specific metrics not detailed in abstract, but emphasizes efficiency and event preservation).
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration between Peking University, Beijing Institute for General Artificial Intelligence (BIGAI), etc.

recommendation.zh: 具身智能领域的视频生成/插帧优化，核心是解决长视频生成的效率问题，对通用多模态预训练（如 Sora 类模型）的架构设计有微弱的借鉴意义。
recommendation.en: Video generation/interpolation optimization in embodied AI, focusing on the efficiency of long video generation. It has weak reference value for the architecture design of general multimodal pre-training (like Sora-class models).

institutions: Beijing Institute for General Artificial Intelligence (BIGAI)

paper.title: SlotMemory: Object-Centric KV Memory for Streaming Long-Video Generation
paper.abstract: Streaming video generation models typically rely on temporal-centric memory, which organizes historical context as raw frames, chunk segments, or unclustered tokens. This organization frequently leads to identity drift and semantic inconsistency when entities exit the frame or during interactive prompt transitions. To address these limitations, we propose SlotMemory, an object-centric Key-Value memory mechanism for streaming video diffusion. Our approach shifts the memory abstraction from "when"

summary.core_problem: 长视频流式生成中的历史记忆通常按时间组织，例如原始帧、片段或未聚类 token。这样做在角色离开局部窗口后再出现、或多 prompt 交互切换时，容易出现身份漂移、道具丢失和语义不连续。SlotMemory 试图把记忆单元从“什么时候出现过”改成“表示哪个对象或语义实体”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在长程多模态生成的记忆表示，而不是纯文本 LLM 训练 recipe。它说明单纯扩大 temporal context 或保存更多 KV，并不一定解决长程一致性；更关键的是记忆索引的语义结构。这个思路对 video-native LM、AR+diffusion 统一建模、长上下文多模态模型都有参考价值：KV-cache 不只可以是顺序缓存，也可以被组织成可复用的实体级记忆。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是在视频 diffusion transformer 中加入 object-centric KV memory。它用 slot-based representation learning 将 transformer 的 KV manifold 分解成离散语义 slot。slot 不直接替代原始 KV，而是作为路由地址，用来索引和存储高保真的 transformer-compatible KV tokens。这样既保留 diffusion 生成需要的细节，又给历史信息加上实体级索引。系统包含递归的 read-write-update 流程：写入阶段用 temporally-initialized Slot Attention 把当前上下文划分到不同语义区域；读取阶段根据 slot 检索相关 KV；更新和淘汰阶段用 prompt-aware scoring 同时考虑文本对齐和视觉相关性，从而在 prompt 切换时保留核心实体、丢弃过时的短期运动上下文。它和普通滑窗或 chunk memory 的差别在于，后者按时间衰减，SlotMemory 按语义身份复用。
summary.experiments: 实验以 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 为 backbone，评估长视频和 60 秒交互式多 prompt 生成。报告中的关键数字包括：interactive narratives quality score 达到 81.61；30 秒 horizon 的 dynamic score 为 74.29，相比已有 streaming 方法有 22.8% 相对提升。论文强调的主要收益是减少 60 秒 rollout 中的累计 feature drift，尤其是角色离开画面后重新出现、场景切换后恢复关键道具、以及多阶段 prompt 中保持实体身份。消融的核心应围绕 slot memory、prompt-aware retrieval、eviction/update 逻辑和纯 temporal memory 的对比来理解。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读方法部分和实验可视化，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看三处：第一，slot 如何从 transformer KV 表示中产生，而不是从像素或显式检测框产生；第二，prompt-aware scoring 如何决定保留和淘汰，这决定它能否处理交互式 prompt 切换；第三，60 秒案例中的失败模式对比，尤其是 identity drift 和 re-entry consistency。对 LLM 研究员来说，不必细读视频生成细节，应该关注“语义索引的 KV memory”是否能迁移到长上下文、多实体对话、多模态 agent memory。

summary_en.core_problem: Streaming long-video generation usually stores history as frames, chunks, or unclustered tokens. This time-centric memory breaks down when an entity leaves the local window and later re-enters, or when the prompt changes across an interactive narrative. SlotMemory reframes the memory unit from temporal occurrence to semantic identity.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is long-horizon multimodal memory design, not text-only pretraining. The paper argues that increasing temporal capacity or retaining more KV tokens is insufficient if the memory has no semantic structure. For native video LMs, unified AR-diffusion systems, and long-context multimodal models, the useful idea is that KV memory can be organized around reusable entities rather than stored as a flat sequence.
summary_en.technical_approach: SlotMemory inserts an object-centric KV memory into a video diffusion transformer. It decomposes the transformer's KV manifold into discrete semantic slots using slot-based representation learning. These slots do not replace the original KV tokens; they serve as routing addresses for indexing and retrieving high-fidelity transformer-compatible KV tokens. The system follows a recursive read-write-update pipeline. During writing, temporally initialized Slot Attention partitions the current transformer states into semantic regions. During reading, the model retrieves KV tokens through slot addresses. During update and eviction, a prompt-aware scoring function balances text alignment and visual relevance, allowing persistent entities to survive prompt transitions while obsolete motion context is removed. This differs from sliding-window or chunk memory, where retention is mainly controlled by temporal distance.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B as the backbone and include long-form generation plus a 60-second interactive multi-prompt setting. Reported numbers include an interactive narrative quality score of 81.61 and a 30-second dynamic score of 74.29, corresponding to a 22.8% relative improvement over the compared streaming baseline. The qualitative results focus on reduced feature drift over 60-second rollouts, especially identity preservation after re-entry, persistent props across scene changes, and entity consistency under prompt transitions. The most informative ablations are expected to isolate slot memory, prompt-aware retrieval, and eviction/update logic against purely temporal memory.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim should take about 25–35 minutes. Focus on how slots are derived from transformer KV states rather than pixels or detector outputs, how prompt-aware scoring decides retention and eviction, and how the 60-second visual comparisons expose identity drift and re-entry failures. For LLM researchers, the key point is not the video diffusion implementation itself, but whether semantic KV indexing can transfer to long-context dialogue, multi-entity multimodal memory, or agent memory.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 预训练论文，但 object-centric KV routing 值得扫 Fig/方法；可作为长程记忆设计的弱信号。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM pretraining paper, but the object-centric KV routing is worth skimming as a weak signal for long-horizon memory design.

paper.title: SANA-Streaming: Real-time Streaming Video Editing with Hybrid Diffusion Transformer
paper.abstract: Real-time streaming video-to-video editing (V2V) is critical for interactive applications such as live broadcasting and gaming, yet it remains a formidable challenge due to the stringent requirements for temporal consistency and inference throughput. In this paper, we present SANA-Streaming, a system-algorithm co-designed framework for high-resolution, real-time streaming video editing on consumer GPUs, with the following three core designs: (1) Hybrid Diffusion Transformer architecture introduc

summary.core_problem: 实时流视频到视频编辑需要同时满足高时间一致性和高推理吞吐量，现有视频扩散模型难以在消费级GPU上实现。
summary.importance: 系统与算法协同设计的实时视频编辑框架，结合混合Diffusion Transformer架构、循环反向正则化和GPU系统优化。
summary.technical_approach: 混合Diffusion Transformer在部分块中引入softmax注意力以改善局部建模同时保持线性层效率；循环反向正则化通过flow matching从生成内容预测源帧来强制语义一致性；系统层融合GDN核与混合精度量化。
summary.experiments: 在消费级NVIDIA GPU上实现高分辨率实时流视频编辑，验证了三个核心设计的有效性。
summary.authors_note: Song Han团队（MIT），知名于高效深度学习系统设计，代表性工作包括剪枝、量化、Deep Compression。

summary_en.core_problem: Real-time streaming video-to-video editing requires both high temporal consistency and high inference throughput, which existing video diffusion models cannot deliver on consumer GPUs.
summary_en.importance: System-algorithm co-designed real-time video editing framework combining hybrid Diffusion Transformer architecture, cycle-reverse regularization, and GPU system optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Hybrid Diffusion Transformer introduces softmax attention in some blocks for better local modeling while preserving linear-layer efficiency; Cycle-Reverse Regularization enforces semantic consistency by predicting source frames from generated content via flow matching; system-level fused GDN kernels + Mixed-Precision Quantization.
summary_en.experiments: High-resolution real-time streaming video editing on consumer NVIDIA GPUs; validates the three core design components.
summary_en.authors_note: Song Han's group (MIT), known for efficient deep learning systems (Deep Compression, pruning, quantization).

recommendation.zh: 视频生成与实时推理优化结合不错，但与LLM预训练核心问题较远，作为前沿跟踪备查。
recommendation.en: Interesting combination of video generation and real-time inference optimization but peripheral to LLM pretraining; track as frontier reference.

paper.title: Robust Dreamer: Deviation-Aware Latent Gaussian Memory for Action-Controlled AR Video Generation
paper.abstract: Frame-wise action-controlled image-to-video generation is a promising paradigm for interactive world simulation, where each control signal should elicit an immediate visual response. However, maintaining visual fidelity and 3D consistency over long autoregressive rollouts remains challenging. Existing 3D-aware methods often suffer from catastrophic drift due to two impediments: information loss from \textit{Latent--RGB Cycling}, where generated latents are repeatedly decoded to RGB and re-encode

summary.core_problem: 解决 action-controlled 自回归视频生成在长 rollout 中视觉质量下降、3D 一致性漂移的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成和世界模拟里的方法改进：把长程自回归视频生成的失败原因拆成 Latent-RGB Cycling 信息损失和 clean-memory 训练假设导致的 train-inference gap。对研究多模态自回归生成稳定性有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Robust Dreamer。核心是 Latent Gaussian Memory：把扩散生成过程中的 latent 锚定到 Gaussian primitives，避免每一步都 latent 解码到 RGB 再重新编码；同时引入 deviation-aware 的训练或记忆使用方式，让模型在训练时接触带误差的记忆状态，降低推理时误差累积。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据和具体提升数字。实验任务是 frame-wise action-controlled image-to-video generation，重点评估长自回归 rollout 的视觉 fidelity 和 3D consistency。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Vertex Lab 和 Australian National University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses visual degradation and 3D inconsistency in long autoregressive rollouts for action-controlled video generation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a method for multimodal generation and world simulation. It identifies two failure modes in long-horizon AR video generation: information loss from latent-RGB cycling and a train-inference gap from clean-memory training. This is moderately relevant to stability questions in multimodal autoregressive generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Robust Dreamer introduces Latent Gaussian Memory, anchoring diffusion latents to Gaussian primitives so the system avoids repeatedly decoding latents to RGB and re-encoding them for future conditioning. It also uses deviation-aware memory handling so training better matches corrupted inference-time memory states.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, training data, or exact metric gains. The experiments target frame-wise action-controlled image-to-video generation, with emphasis on long-rollout fidelity and 3D consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Vertex Lab and the Australian National University.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和 drift ablation；它对文本预训练不直接有用，但长 AR 生成的误差累积诊断可借鉴。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and drift ablations; it is not directly useful for text pretraining, but the error-accumulation diagnosis for long AR generation transfers.

paper.title: Lumos-Nexus: Efficient Frequency Bridging with Homogeneous Latent Space for Video Unified Models
paper.abstract: Connector-based video unified models have demonstrated strong capability in instruction-grounded video synthesis, but integrating a large high-fidelity generator into the unified training loop is computationally prohibitive, limiting achievable visual quality. We therefore propose Lumos-Nexus, a training-efficient unified video generation framework that facilitates the development of strong reasoning-driven generation capabilities while significantly enhancing visual fidelity. Lumos-Nexus adopts

summary.core_problem: Lumos-Nexus 解决的是 connector-based 视频统一模型中的训练成本问题：理解模块需要把复杂指令和推理结果注入视频扩散生成器，但直接把 Wan2.1-14B 这类大生成器放进统一训练环路，成本很高，也限制了高保真生成器的可用性。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发点在于，它把“语义对齐训练”和“高保真合成能力”拆开处理。小模型负责在训练期学习如何接收理解模块的语义和推理先验，大模型只在推理期接管生成质量。这类设计对跨模态统一预训练有参考价值：不一定要把最强生成器完整纳入联合训练，前提是小、大生成器共享足够一致的 latent space，并且推理期交接机制稳定。
summary.technical_approach: 方法采用两阶段框架。训练阶段只微调轻量视频扩散生成器和 connector，使其把 VLM/理解模块输出映射到生成器的条件注入空间。选择轻量生成器的前提是它与大生成器处在 homogeneous latent space 中，也就是 latent 表示空间兼容；这样小生成器学到的语义结构可以被大生成器继承。推理阶段提出 Unified Progressive Frequency Bridging（UPFB），按生成过程逐步把责任从小生成器交给大生成器。直观上，小生成器先建立低频、结构性、语义相关的内容，大生成器随后利用其预训练能力补足高频细节、纹理和时间一致性。它和直接蒸馏或联合微调大生成器不同：训练成本主要落在小生成器上，大生成器不需要进入统一训练闭环。
summary.experiments: 实验主要围绕两类指标展开：VBench 用于评估视频质量、真实感和时间一致性；VR-Bench 用于评估推理意图与生成内容是否对齐。论文声称 Lumos-Nexus 在 VBench 上提升 visual realism 和 temporal coherence，同时在 VR-Bench 上保持较强的 reasoning-guided generation 能力。可见内容没有给出完整数值表，因此不宜补写具体提升幅度。值得注意的是，VR-Bench 覆盖八个维度，包括物理世界推理、常识推理和具身交互，说明作者不只看 prompt-following，而是尝试评估“推理后的意图”是否真正进入视频生成结果。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分的 connector 设计、homogeneous latent space 的定义、UPFB 的具体调度方式，以及实验中 UPFB 相比直接使用小生成器或直接使用大生成器的消融。VR-Bench 也值得扫一遍，尤其是任务构造和评分方式。需要注意的风险点是：小、大生成器 latent space 兼容并不自动保证 denoising trajectory 兼容，UPFB 的频率交接是否稳定，可能高度依赖具体扩散 backbone 和 VAE/tokenizer。

summary_en.core_problem: Lumos-Nexus targets the training cost bottleneck in connector-based unified video models. The understanding module needs to inject instruction-level semantics and reasoning signals into a video diffusion generator, but putting a large high-fidelity generator such as a 14B-scale video model into the unified training loop is computationally expensive.
summary_en.importance: The useful idea for pretraining research is the separation between semantic alignment and high-fidelity synthesis. A small generator is trained to absorb reasoning-driven semantic priors from the understanding block, while a larger pretrained generator is used only at inference time for visual quality. This is relevant to native multimodal pretraining because it suggests that the strongest modality generator does not always need to be jointly optimized, as long as the smaller and larger generators share a compatible latent space and the inference-time handoff is well controlled.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has two stages. During training, Lumos-Nexus aligns a lightweight video diffusion generator with the understanding block through a connector. The small generator learns to map high-level semantic and reasoning cues into structured generative conditions. The key assumption is a homogeneous latent space between the small and large generators, so that the semantic structure formed by the small model can be inherited by the larger model. During inference, Unified Progressive Frequency Bridging gradually transfers generation responsibility from the small generator to the high-capacity generator. The small generator mainly establishes coarse semantic structure, while the large generator contributes detail, texture, and temporal fidelity. This differs from directly fine-tuning the large generator or distilling it into a smaller one: the expensive generator is kept outside the unified training loop.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation has two main parts. VBench is used for visual quality, realism, and temporal coherence. VR-Bench is introduced to evaluate whether inferred intent is reflected in the generated video. The paper reports improved visual realism and temporal consistency on VBench while maintaining strong reasoning-guided generation on VR-Bench. The visible content does not expose the full numeric tables, so exact gains should be checked in the experimental section. VR-Bench covers eight dimensions, including physical-world reasoning, commonsense reasoning, and embodied interaction, which makes it more targeted than ordinary prompt-following checks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the connector formulation, the exact definition of homogeneous latent space, the UPFB schedule, and the ablations comparing UPFB with using only the small generator or directly using the large generator. The VR-Bench construction is also worth scanning. The main technical risk to examine is whether latent-space compatibility is sufficient for trajectory compatibility in diffusion sampling; the stability of frequency-level handoff may depend strongly on the specific diffusion backbone and visual tokenizer.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心统一多模态训练成本，这篇的价值在接口设计，不在视频指标；先看两阶段解耦和 latent handoff，别被生成样例带跑。
recommendation.en: If you care about the cost of unified multimodal training, the value here is in the interface design, not the video metrics; read the two-stage decoupling and latent handoff, not the demo samples.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: DecMem: Towards Minute-Long Consistent World Generation with Decoupled Memory
paper.abstract: Recent advances in video generative models have promoted rapid progress in controllable world models. However, maintaining fine-grained spatio-temporal consistency under long-horizon reasoning remains a key challenge. In this work, we move beyond explicit 3D memory and coarse frame-level implicit modeling, and propose a fine-grained, learnable, and scalable memory for consistent world generation. We first identify two fundamental limitations of naïve learnable memory architectures in long-horizo

summary.core_problem: 解决长视频/世界生成中分钟级外推时的细粒度时空一致性问题，尤其是历史信息如何被稳定、低成本地访问。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成架构创新。它不直接推进文本 LLM 预训练，但对长时程生成模型中的记忆组织、注意力稀释和历史状态压缩有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DecMem，将可学习记忆拆成 Sparse Global Memory 和 Anchored Local Memory：前者用于高效访问全局历史，后者用于稳定局部外推和保持画质。论文先分析朴素可学习记忆在长程外推中的两个问题：计算低效和 attention dispersion，再用解耦记忆结构处理二者的冲突。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在一致性世界生成任务上进行广泛实验，并显著超过当前方法；未给出具体模型规模、训练数据量、基线名称和提升幅度。实验重点应是分钟级生成的一致性、质量和推理效率。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港大学、快手 Kling Team 和 Kuaishou Technology；Kling 团队长期做视频生成系统，Xintao Wang 和 Kwan-Yee K. Wong 在视觉生成与底层视觉方向较有代表性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets fine-grained spatiotemporal consistency in minute-long world generation, focusing on how long histories can be accessed stably and efficiently.
summary_en.importance: This is an architectural contribution for multimodal generation rather than LLM pretraining. Its useful signal for pretraining researchers is the treatment of long-horizon memory, attention dilution, and state compression in generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: DecMem decouples learnable memory into Sparse Global Memory for efficient fine-grained access to global history and Anchored Local Memory for stable local extrapolation and visual quality. The design is motivated by an analysis of two failure modes in naive learnable memory: computational inefficiency and attention dispersion.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments and significant gains over current methods for consistent world generation, but does not provide model scale, data scale, baseline names, or exact margins. The likely evaluation axes are long-horizon consistency, generation quality, and efficiency.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from The University of Hong Kong, the Kling Team, and Kuaishou Technology. The Kling team is known for video generation systems; Xintao Wang and Kwan-Yee K. Wong are recognizable names in visual generation and vision research.

recommendation.zh: 不必读全篇；如果在做长上下文多模态生成，只看 attention dispersion 分析和 DecMem 的全局/局部拆分。
recommendation.en: Do not read it end to end; if you work on long-context multimodal generation, inspect the attention-dispersion analysis and the global/local memory split.

paper.title: Future Forcing: Future-aware Training-free KV Cache Policy for Autoregressive Video Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video generation has emerged as a promising paradigm for long-horizon video synthesis, where each frame is generated conditioned on previously generated tokens. To accelerate inference, the KV cache is used to avoid redundant recomputation across generation steps. Nevertheless, its growth with generation length introduces increasing memory and error accumulation, limiting the scalability of AR models to even longer sequences. Existing KV cache compression methods mitigate thi

summary.core_problem: 自回归视频生成中KV缓存随生成长度增长，带来内存占用上升和误差积累问题；现有压缩方法仅用短期上下文判断token重要性，易遗漏早期出现但对未来生成关键的token
summary.importance: 推理优化领域的方法创新，提出免训练的未来感知KV缓存策略，无需重训模型即可提升长序列AR生成的效率与质量
summary.technical_approach: 利用训练好的AR视频模型的固有特性：RoPE调制的query虽在自回归步骤中演化，但token的长期重要性可通过未来步的query反向评估，无需训练即可动态保留对未来生成关键的token
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未完整披露实验设置、参数量、基线与量化效果数据

summary_en.core_problem: In autoregressive video generation, KV cache grows with generation length, causing increased memory usage and error accumulation; existing compression methods only judge token importance with short-term context, easily missing tokens that are unimportant early but critical for future generation
summary_en.importance: Method innovation in inference optimization, proposing a training-free future-aware KV cache policy that improves long-sequence AR generation efficiency and quality without retraining
summary_en.technical_approach: Leverage the inherent property of trained AR video models: although RoPE-modulated queries evolve across autoregressive steps, the long-term importance of tokens can be reversely evaluated by queries from future steps, dynamically retaining tokens critical for future generation without training
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not fully disclose experimental setup, parameter count, baselines, or quantitative performance data

recommendation.zh: 未来感知KV缓存的筛选思路可尝试迁移到文本长上下文AR推理优化，仅看方法核心逻辑即可。
recommendation.en: Future-aware KV cache selection idea can be migrated to text long-context AR inference optimization, only read the core method logic.

paper.title: YoCausal: How Far is Video Generation from World Model? A Causality Perspective
paper.abstract: As video diffusion models (VDMs) advance toward world models, a key question arises: do they truly understand causality, or merely overfit to statistical temporal patterns? Existing benchmarks mostly rely on synthetic data, limiting real-world generalization due to the sim-to-real gap. We present YoCausal, a two-level benchmark inspired by the Violation of Expectation (VoE) paradigm from cognitive science. By temporally reversing real-world videos at zero cost as natural counterfactual samples,

summary.core_problem: 评估视频生成模型是否具备因果理解，而不是只学到时间顺序上的统计相关性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成世界模型评测。YoCausal 用真实视频的时间反转构造自然反事实样本，避免纯合成 benchmark 的 sim-to-real 缺口，并区分“感知时间箭头”和“理解因果”。
summary.technical_approach: 方法受认知科学中的 Violation of Expectation 范式启发，设计两级评估。Level 1 用 Reverse Surprise Index 通过 denoising loss 衡量模型对时间箭头的敏感性；Level 2 用 VLM 将数据分成 causal 和 non-causal 子集，再用 Causality Cognition Index 分离因果认知与普通时间偏置。
summary.experiments: 论文评估 13 个视频扩散模型。核心发现是：模型能感知时间箭头并不意味着能理解因果；部分模型的时间方向敏感性可能来自非因果的时序统计偏置。摘要未列出具体模型规模、训练数据和完整数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether video generation models understand causality or merely fit statistical temporal patterns.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a world-model-oriented benchmark for video generation. YoCausal uses temporally reversed real-world videos as natural counterfactuals, reducing the sim-to-real gap of synthetic-only evaluation and separating arrow-of-time perception from causal cognition.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inspired by the Violation of Expectation paradigm, the benchmark has two levels. Level 1 defines the Reverse Surprise Index based on denoising loss to measure arrow-of-time sensitivity. Level 2 uses a VLM to stratify data into causal and non-causal subsets, then defines the Causality Cognition Index to separate causal reasoning from temporal bias.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate 13 state-of-the-art video diffusion models. The main finding is that perceiving the arrow of time does not imply causal understanding; some temporal sensitivity can be explained by non-causal temporal bias. The abstract does not provide model scales, training data, or full numeric results.

recommendation.zh: 读 RSI/CCI 定义和 causal/non-causal 分层；这类反事实评测比看视频质量分更接近世界模型问题。
recommendation.en: Read the RSI/CCI definitions and the causal versus non-causal split; this counterfactual setup is more informative for world-model claims than video-quality scores.

paper.title: VPG: Visual Prefix Guidance for Autoregressive Image and Video Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive image and video generators are trained with teacher-forced histories but must sample from their own generated prefixes at inference time, making them vulnerable to exposure bias and prefix drift. Existing remedies either modify training or apply sampling-time guidance aimed primarily at external semantic conditions, such as class labels or text prompts, rather than testing whether a next-step prediction provides strong posterior support for the generated prefix itself. We propose

summary.core_problem: 缓解自回归图像和视频生成中 teacher forcing 训练与自由采样推理之间的不匹配，尤其是生成前缀漂移问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练无关的推理时 guidance。它不改变模型训练，但提出用前缀自一致性信号修正下一步预测；对研究 AR 生成的 exposure bias 有类比价值，但离 LLM 基座预训练主线较远。
summary.technical_approach: Visual Prefix Guidance 对比同一模型在当前生成前缀和被污染前缀下的输出分布，并把 logits 外推到更支持当前前缀的候选 token。它不依赖额外训练，也不同于主要围绕类别或文本条件做 guidance 的方法，而是把生成历史本身作为要被后验支持的对象。
summary.experiments: 摘要称方法在 VAR 的类别条件图像生成、Infinity 的文生图和文生视频设置中测试，并提升自回归视觉生成效果；未给出具体指标、提升幅度和采样成本。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the mismatch between teacher-forced training and free-running inference in autoregressive image and video generation, especially prefix drift.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free inference-time guidance method. It does not modify pretraining, but it introduces a prefix self-support signal for next-step prediction, which is useful by analogy for studying exposure bias in AR generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Visual Prefix Guidance contrasts the model's output under the generated prefix with its output under a corrupted prefix, then extrapolates logits toward candidates that better support the current prefix. Unlike guidance aimed at class labels or text prompts, it treats the generated history itself as the object whose posterior support should be reinforced.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on class-conditional image generation with VAR, text-to-image generation with Infinity, and text-to-video generation with Infinity-style models. It does not provide exact metrics, gains, or sampling overhead.

recommendation.zh: 看 abstract 和 guidance 公式就够；它是视觉 AR 解码技巧，不是会改变预训练 recipe 的证据。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and guidance equation only; this is a visual AR decoding trick, not evidence to change a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: What-If World: A Causal Benchmark for General World Models in Embodied Scenarios
paper.abstract: Video generation models are increasingly used as world simulators for tasks like driving and robotic manipulation. What matters in these settings is not whether a single video looks right, but whether the model's output changes when its input changes. We test this by giving a model two prompts describing the same scene with one physical detail varied, and checking whether the two videos diverge the way physics predicts. The wording difference between the prompts is small by design, since only on

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注一个现有视频世界模型评测几乎没有正面测到的问题：模型是否会随着输入中的受控物理变量变化而产生相应变化。现有 benchmark 往往逐条视频独立打分，只检查单个输出是否“看起来合理”，却无法发现一种更关键的失败模式——两条只改了一个物理条件的 prompt，模型却生成几乎一样的视频。对于自动驾驶、机器人操作、基于模型的规划和策略训练，这种 failure 比单视频不够真实更严重，因为它意味着模型没有学到可操控、可比较的因果响应。
summary.importance: 对预训练和统一世界模型研究的启发比较直接。它把“世界模型好不好”从视觉逼真度转向因果敏感性，尤其是对 intervention 的差分响应。这会影响未来视频生成或 action-conditioned world model 的训练目标、数据构造和评测协议：如果训练只优化单样本 realism，很可能学到的是视觉模板，而不是可用于规划的动力学响应。贡献量级属于中等：它不是新架构，但 benchmark 设计抓住了一个被主流评测忽略的核心能力，而且实验显示现有强模型在这一点上普遍偏弱。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由 benchmark 构建和 paired evaluation 两部分组成。第一部分是 What-If World 数据集。作者先定义什么样的物理干预变量适合做对比测试，并由两位领域专家在真实视频上筛选与归并，最后得到横跨自动驾驶和机械臂操作的六类 primitive：环境相关包括 surface friction、material/medium、obstacle configuration，动作相关包括 spatial alignment、force/degree、temporal sequencing。每个测试样本不是单 prompt，而是一个 paired triplet：同一初始帧 x0，加上一对只在一个语义变量上不同的 prompt。构建流程分三步：从 nuScenes 或 DROID 过滤出满足条件的真实片段；抽取动作开始前一帧并配上共享的场景描述；再人工写出只改一个干预变量的 prompt pair。这样做的目的，是尽量用文本设计近似 ceteris paribus，让输出差异能归因到该干预。第二部分是 APEO 评测框架。它把 paired generation 的好坏拆成四项：Adherence，干预是否被执行；Physics，动力学是否合理；Environment，非干预场景是否保持稳定；Outcome，成对输出是否按预期发生差异。前三项既看单视频也看成对视频，Outcome 只在 paired 模式下定义。这个拆分很有用，因为它能区分“没执行干预”“执行了但没拉开差异”“差异来自场景漂移”三种不同失败。评测实现依赖 VLM judge，并用人工标注做了验证。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 9 个当前视频生成世界模型，其中 4 个开源、5 个闭源。最关键的结果有三点。第一，没有模型在 paired metric 上超过 52%，4 个开源模型集中在约 28% 左右，说明因果敏感性远未过关。第二，单视频评测与 paired 评测之间存在明显落差，作者把它称为 contrastive bottleneck：模型能分别生成两条看起来都合理的视频，但无法让它们按输入差异正确分化。第三，模型表现更像依赖“后果是否显眼”，而不是稳定掌握物理机制。比如 Force/Degree 这类会带来明显运动差异的干预，得分可到 40.4%；而 Surface Friction 这类只带来细微轨迹变化的干预，得分只有 14.2%。数据规模方面，benchmark 含 319 个 paired triplets，来源于 nuScenes 和 DROID 两个真实 embodied 场景数据源。就诊断价值而言，这些数字已经足够说明：现有模型在单样本 realism 上的进步，并没有自动转化为可用于控制和规划的差分物理建模能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction，作者对 failure mode 的定义很清楚，能迅速理解为什么单视频 benchmark 不够。然后看 benchmark construction，重点是六类 intervention primitive 的定义标准，以及 prompt pair 如何保证只改一个变量。接着看 APEO 评测协议，尤其是 Adherence / Physics / Environment / Outcome 四项如何区分不同错误来源。最后看主结果表和按 primitive 分解的结果，那里最能体现 contrastive bottleneck。若只花 25 分钟，建议看图示样例、taxonomy、APEO 定义和主表；若要判断它是否能指导训练目标设计，再细读 human validation 和 failure case 分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a failure mode that current video world-model benchmarks mostly miss: whether the model’s output changes appropriately when a controlled physical variable in the input changes. Existing benchmarks score videos one by one and ask whether each sample looks plausible in isolation. That misses the more consequential error: two prompts differ in exactly one physical condition, yet the model produces nearly the same video for both. For driving, robotics, model-based planning, and policy training, this is more damaging than imperfect realism, because it means the model is not controllably responsive to interventions.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretraining and world-model research is fairly direct. The paper shifts the evaluation target from visual realism to causal sensitivity, especially differential response to interventions. That has implications for training objectives, data construction, and evaluation protocols for video generation and action-conditioned world models. If training only rewards single-sample realism, models may learn visual templates rather than dynamics that are useful for planning. The contribution is moderate but solid: no new architecture, but a benchmark that isolates a capability current evaluation largely ignores, and empirical evidence that many strong models remain weak on it.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two parts: benchmark construction and paired evaluation. First, What-If World builds a contrastive benchmark around physically meaningful interventions. Two domain experts define and merge intervention variables into six primitives spanning autonomous driving and robotic manipulation. Environment-side primitives include surface friction, material/medium, and obstacle configuration. Agent-side primitives include spatial alignment, force/degree, and temporal sequencing. Each test case is a paired triplet: the same initial frame x0 plus two prompts that differ in exactly one semantic variable. Construction proceeds in three steps: filter suitable clips from nuScenes or DROID; extract the frame right before the action starts and pair it with shared scene descriptors; then author a prompt pair that changes only the intervention variable. The goal is to approximate ceteris paribus through prompt design so that output differences can be attributed to the intervention. Second, the APEO evaluation framework decomposes success into four criteria: Adherence, whether the intervention was executed; Physics, whether the dynamics are valid; Environment, whether the non-intervened scene stays stable; and Outcome, whether the paired outputs diverge as the intervention predicts. The first three are scored in both single-video and paired modes, while Outcome is inherently paired-only. This decomposition is useful because it separates different failure modes: the intervention may be ignored, executed without sufficient divergence, or confounded by scene drift. The implementation uses a VLM judge validated against human annotation.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is applied to nine state-of-the-art video generation world models, including four open-source and five closed-source systems. Three results stand out. First, no model exceeds 52% on the paired metric, and the four open-source models cluster around 28%, indicating that causal sensitivity is still weak. Second, there is a substantial gap between single-video scores and paired scores, which the authors call the contrastive bottleneck: models can generate two individually convincing videos while still failing to differentiate them in the way the input requires. Third, performance appears to track the visual salience of the intervention’s consequences more than robust physical understanding. Force/Degree, which often causes large visible motion changes, reaches 40.4%, while Surface Friction, which induces subtler trajectory differences, drops to 14.2%. The benchmark itself contains 319 paired triplets built from real embodied data sources, nuScenes and DROID. As a diagnostic result, these numbers are already enough to show that better single-sample realism does not automatically translate into controllable physical simulation.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction. The failure mode is stated very clearly, and it immediately explains why per-video benchmarks are insufficient. Then read the benchmark construction section, focusing on how the six intervention primitives are defined and how prompt pairs are constrained to differ in only one variable. After that, read the APEO protocol, especially how Adherence, Physics, Environment, and Outcome disentangle different error sources. Finally, inspect the main result table and the per-primitive breakdown; that is where the contrastive bottleneck becomes most visible. If you only have 25 minutes, prioritize the motivating examples, the primitive taxonomy, the APEO definition, and the main quantitative table. Read the human-validation and failure-case sections only if you want to judge whether this benchmark can inform future training objectives.

recommendation.zh: 非常好的 World Model 评测视角，从单样本的 'plausibility' 转向对比样本的 'causality'，对于做多模态/视频生成的 pretrain 团队来说，这是衡量模型是否真正学到物理规律的关键 metric。
recommendation.en: An excellent evaluation perspective for World Models, shifting from single-sample 'plausibility' to contrastive 'causality'. Crucial metric for multimodal/video pretrain teams to measure if models actually learn physical laws.

paper.title: Which Pretraining Paradigm Better Serves Spatial Intelligence? An Empirical Comparison of Vision-Language and Video Generation Models
paper.abstract: Spatial intelligence requires visual representations that capture both semantic objects and geometric structure in the physical world. To support this, two major pre-training schemes are now widely used as foundation backbones: Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which use language supervision to align visual observations with semantic concepts, and Video Generation Models (VGMs), which learn from temporally evolving visual worlds. However, it still remains unclear which pre-training scheme provides

summary.core_problem: 比较视觉语言模型和视频生成模型两类预训练范式，哪一种冻结表示更适合作为空间智能任务的表示基础。
summary.importance: 贡献是预训练表示分析，而不是新模型训练方法。它把 VLM 的语言监督和 VGM 的时序生成监督放在同一 frozen-feature probing 框架下比较，对理解多模态预训练信号的取舍有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者使用轻量 probe，在冻结 backbone 上评估三类空间智能能力：语义标注、实例分组和 3D 几何预测。通过固定下游探针容量，尽量把差异归因到预训练表示本身，而不是下游训练能力。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 VLM 和 VGM 两个模型家族，在语义、实例和几何三个轴上进行对比。摘要给出的主要发现是两类表示存在互补性：VLM 更偏语义对象信息，VGM 更可能编码时序和几何结构。摘要未给出具体模型列表、参数量和数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper compares whether vision-language models or video generation models provide better frozen representations for spatial intelligence.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is representation analysis rather than a new training method. It places language-supervised VLMs and temporally trained video generation models under the same frozen-feature probing setup, offering a useful signal about pretraining objective trade-offs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use lightweight probes on frozen backbones and evaluate three axes of spatial intelligence: semantic tagging, instance grouping, and 3D geometry prediction. By controlling the probe, the comparison aims to attribute differences to pretrained representations rather than downstream capacity.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare VLM and VGM model families across semantic, instance-level, and geometric tasks. The abstract reports a complementary pattern: VLMs encode stronger semantic object information, while VGMs appear more favorable for temporal and geometric structure. Exact model lists, parameter counts, and numbers are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看 frozen-probe 设计和互补性结论；它更像表示诊断，不足以直接改动多模态预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Skim the frozen-probe setup and complementarity result; it is representation diagnostics, not enough to change a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Proprio: Latent Self-Scoring and Inference-Time Refinement for Physically Plausible Video Generation
paper.abstract: Modern video generative models produce visually impressive results, yet frequently violate basic physical principles. We propose Proprio, a training-free framework that enables a frozen video generator to assess and improve the physical plausibility of its own outputs. Inspired by proprioception, the biological sense of one's own movement, Proprio treats the model's flow residual under controlled latent perturbations as a self-scoring signal. Samples that are better explained by the generator's

summary.core_problem: 冻结的视频生成模型常生成违反基本物理规律的运动，论文试图在不重新训练的情况下识别并修正这些样本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成的推理期自评分与自修正方法。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对多模态生成中的内部一致性信号、best-of-N 选择和推理期优化有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: Proprio 用受控 latent perturbation 下的 flow residual 作为自评分信号：如果样本更符合生成器学到的动态，残差应更小且更稳定。方法在多个时间步和扰动上聚合该信号，并用动态时空 mask 聚焦运动区域，再用于 best-of-N 搜索、基于梯度的 latent refinement，或二者结合。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 text-to-video 与 image-to-video benchmark，并在 TurboWan2.2 等冻结视频生成器上测试。摘要报告 Proprio 能稳定提升物理合理性，在若干设置下优于 VLM-based scoring 和外部 world-model baseline；具体模型规模、N 值、提升幅度和完整数据集需看正文。
summary.authors_note: Alexandre Alahi 是 EPFL VITA Lab 负责人，长期研究视觉预测、轨迹建模和具身/物理场景理解。

summary_en.core_problem: Frozen video generators often produce motion that violates basic physical constraints, and the paper asks whether such failures can be detected and refined without retraining.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time self-scoring and self-refinement method for video generation. It is not a core LLM pretraining paper, but it is relevant as a concrete design for internal consistency signals, best-of-N selection, and test-time optimization in generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proprio uses the generator's flow residual under controlled latent perturbations as a self-score: samples that better match the model's learned dynamics should induce smaller and more stable residuals. The signal is aggregated across timesteps and perturbations, restricted to motion-relevant regions with a dynamic spatiotemporal mask, and used for best-of-N search, gradient-based latent refinement, or both.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on text-to-video and image-to-video benchmarks with frozen video generators including TurboWan2.2. The abstract reports consistent gains in physical plausibility and improvements over VLM-based scoring and external world-model baselines in several settings; model sizes, search budgets, and exact gains require the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Alexandre Alahi leads the VITA Lab at EPFL and is known for work on visual prediction, trajectory modeling, and physical scene understanding.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和 ablation 即可；latent residual 当自评分信号有意思，但离基座预训练还隔着视频生成器设定。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure and ablations only; the latent-residual self-score is neat, but the setup remains video-generator specific.

paper.title: Gamma-World: Generative Multi-Agent World Modeling Beyond Two Players
paper.abstract: World models for interactive video generation have largely focused on single-agent settings, where future observations are generated from a single control signal. However, many generated environments require multi-agent interaction: multiple players, robots, or embodied agents act simultaneously within a shared space. Scaling world models to such settings requires a principled multi-agent design: agents should remain independently controllable, permutation-symmetric, and support efficient infere

summary.core_problem: 现有交互式视频世界模型多按单智能体控制信号生成未来观测，难以自然扩展到多玩家、多机器人或多具身体同时行动的共享环境。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多智能体生成式世界模型的架构改进。它把可独立控制、置换对称和高效推理作为同一个建模约束处理，对交互视频生成和仿真式数据生成有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Simplex Rotary Agent Encoding，将 agent 身份表示为旋转角空间中正单纯形的顶点，是一种无参数的 3D RoPE 扩展。每个 agent 获得不同相位，同时在置换意义下等价，避免学习固定 slot identity 或依赖固定 agent 顺序。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据规模、基线和定量提升。可确认的实验目标是多智能体交互视频生成，并强调时间一致性、视角一致性和推理效率。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Sanja Fidler，其团队长期做视觉生成、具身感知和世界模型相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Interactive video world models are mostly built around a single control stream, which does not scale cleanly to shared environments with multiple players, robots, or embodied agents acting at the same time.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an architectural design for generative multi-agent world modeling. It is relevant as a way to impose independent controllability, permutation symmetry, and efficient inference in interactive simulation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Simplex Rotary Agent Encoding, a parameter-free extension of 3D RoPE that places agent identities at vertices of a regular simplex in rotary-angle space. This assigns distinct phases to agents while keeping them permutation-equivalent, avoiding learned slot identities or fixed ordering.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, data scale, baselines, or quantitative gains. The experimental setting is multi-agent interactive video generation with an emphasis on temporal and perspective consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: Sanja Fidler is among the authors; her group is known for work on visual generation, embodied perception, and world modeling.

recommendation.zh: 看 Simplex RoPE 设计即可；它对多主体 token/slot 编码有借鉴，但离 LLM 预训练主线还有一层距离。
recommendation.en: Skim the Simplex RoPE design; it is a useful cue for multi-entity token or slot encoding, but still one step away from core LM pretraining.

paper.title: EvalVerse: Pipeline-Aware and Expert-Calibrated Benchmarking for Professional Cinematic Video Generation
paper.abstract: The rapid evolution of generative video foundation models has propelled the field toward professional-grade cinematic synthesis. To achieve such demanding quality, the community transitions towards Reinforcement Learning (RL) and agentic workflows. However, reliable evaluation has emerged as a critical bottleneck. Existing benchmarks predominantly evaluate ''whether it is right'' (basic prompt-following) while fundamentally neglecting ''whether it is good'' (cinematic quality, acting, and aesthe

summary.core_problem: EvalVerse 解决的是专业级视频生成的评测信号问题：现有视频生成 benchmark 多数只看提示词是否被满足，难以评价电影制作中更关键的美术设计、表演、镜头、情绪、剪辑和声音等质量维度。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在模型结构，而在评测和奖励信号。视频生成模型正在从纯 SFT 转向 RL 和 agentic workflow，评测框架会影响 reward model、偏好数据和模型迭代方向。EvalVerse 的启发是：多模态生成的 reward 不能只依赖通用 VLM 打分，需要把专业流程拆成可诊断维度，再用专家校准自动评估器。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由两部分组成。第一是 pipeline-aware cinematic taxonomy，把最终生成视频映射回传统影视流程中的 pre-production、production、post-production 三类诊断维度，分别覆盖视觉概念设计、动态表演、摄影、美学、情绪表达、多镜头叙事和声音设计。第二是 expert-calibrated Chain-of-Thought evaluator，通过电影从业者、艺术家、算法研究者和工程人员的人机交叉校准，让 VLM 在打分前先生成专业化推理理由，再输出分数。数据构造上使用 Real-to-Gen 引擎，从真实专业视频数据中按比例采样，做层级结构标注和 asset disentanglement，构造带参考视频的测试对，避免只靠人工拼接 prompt 带来的分布偏差。
summary.experiments: 给定内容主要描述框架设计和 benchmark 构造思路，没有完整列出模型数量、人工标注规模、评估一致性、VLM-human correlation 或具体 leaderboard 数字。值得关注的实验应包括：专家评分与自动 evaluator 的相关性；CoT 校准前后的稳定性；不同视频生成模型在单镜头、多镜头、声音和叙事维度上的能力差异；Real-to-Gen 测试对相比纯 prompt benchmark 是否能更好地区分模型。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看 taxonomy 设计、专家校准流程、Real-to-Gen 数据引擎，以及自动评估器和人类专家一致性的实验。如果关注视频模型 RL，可重点看 reward 信号如何从主观审美拆成可操作维度；如果只关注文本 LLM 预训练，可跳过具体影视维度。

summary_en.core_problem: EvalVerse targets a missing evaluation signal for professional video generation: current benchmarks mostly measure whether the prompt was followed, but they do not reliably assess cinematic quality such as art direction, acting, camera work, affect, editing, and sound.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is mainly through evaluation and reward construction rather than architecture. As video generation moves from supervised fine-tuning toward RL and agentic production workflows, the evaluation stack becomes part of the training signal. The useful lesson is that reward signals for multimodal generation need structured domain decomposition and expert calibration, not just generic VLM scoring.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has two main components. First, it defines a pipeline-aware cinematic taxonomy that audits a generated video through the lens of pre-production, production, and post-production. These stages cover concept design, acting dynamics, cinematography, aesthetics, emotional expression, multi-shot structure, and sound design. Second, it builds expert-calibrated Chain-of-Thought evaluators. Filmmakers, artists, algorithm researchers, and engineers repeatedly calibrate human judgments against the perceptual limits of current VLMs, forcing the evaluator to produce professional rationales before scoring. The benchmark construction uses a Real-to-Gen engine: it samples from real professional video data, performs hierarchical structural annotation and asset disentanglement, and builds test pairs with reference videos instead of relying only on synthetic prompt permutations.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content emphasizes the benchmark design and calibration methodology, but does not expose full quantitative details such as annotation scale, model coverage, human-machine correlation, or leaderboard results. The most important empirical checks would be expert agreement, VLM-human correlation before and after CoT calibration, robustness across cinematic dimensions, and whether Real-to-Gen pairs separate model capabilities better than prompt-only benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the taxonomy, the expert calibration loop, the Real-to-Gen data engine, and any experiments measuring agreement with professional human raters. For video-generation RL, the useful part is how subjective quality is decomposed into trainable reward dimensions. For text-only LLM pretraining, most cinematic-specific details can be skipped.

recommendation.zh: 对基座训练只提供弱信号；如果做视频 RL/reward，读评价维度和专家校准流程，不必追模型分数。
recommendation.en: Weak signal for base pretraining; if you work on video RL or rewards, read the dimensions and expert calibration, not the leaderboard.
