paper.title: ReCA: Multi-Shot Long Video Extrapolation via Recursive Context Allocation
paper.abstract: Minute-scale cinematic video generation is a central challenge for generative video models. Existing paradigms address only fragments of this challenge: single-shot extrapolation preserves an anchor but lacks cinematic structure, while multi-shot storytelling imposes structure yet remains free to invent its visual states rather than continue an observed one. We define Multi-Shot Video Extrapolation (MSVE), a task that extends an observed frame or clip into a sequence of cinematically structured

summary.core_problem: 现有长视频生成范式无法同时兼顾锚定初始视觉状态、保持电影化叙事结构和长期对象/场景状态一致性，缺乏统一的多镜头视频外推任务定义
summary.importance: 首次正式定义多镜头视频外推（MSVE）任务，属于多模态生成领域的任务与方法创新
summary.technical_approach: 提出ReCA递归上下文分配框架，针对性解决三个瓶颈：避免全局规划器过度指定不支持的细节、精简镜头级prompt保留关键状态、缓解时序链式生成中的状态衰减
summary.experiments: 在分钟级电影级视频基准上测试，对比单镜头外推和多镜头叙事基线，在状态保持和叙事连贯性上取得提升，未披露具体生成模型参数量
summary.authors_note: 作者包含莫纳什大学Gholamreza Haffari团队成员，无头部大模型机构背景

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long video generation paradigms cannot simultaneously preserve anchor visual state, maintain cinematic narrative structure and long-term state consistency, lacking a unified definition of multi-shot video extrapolation task
summary_en.importance: First formal definition of Multi-Shot Video Extrapolation (MSVE) task, task and method innovation in multimodal generation field
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose ReCA recursive context allocation framework, addressing three bottlenecks: avoiding over-specification by global planners, simplify shot-level prompts to retain key state, mitigating state decay in temporal chaining
summary_en.experiments: Tested on minute-scale cinematic video benchmarks, outperforms single-shot extrapolation and multi-shot storytelling baselines in state preservation and narrative coherence, no specific generative model parameter size disclosed
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include members from Gholamreza Haffari's group at Monash University, no top-tier LLM institution affiliation

recommendation.zh: 仅做多模态视频生成的研究员可浏览任务定义部分，对纯LLM预训练无直接参考价值
recommendation.en: Only researchers working on multimodal video generation may skim the task definition section, no direct reference for pure LLM pretraining

paper.title: On-Policy Adversarial Flow Distillation for Autoregressive Video Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video generators are attractive for streaming, long-horizon, and interactive applications, but distilling strong black-box teachers into causal students remains difficult. The student must learn under its own rollout distribution, whereas practical teachers may expose only prompt-conditioned completed videos and may differ in architecture, capacity, temporal design, and sampling schedule. This interface makes supervised fine-tuning off-policy, score-based distillation inapplicable

summary.core_problem: 解决黑盒视频教师模型向因果自回归视频学生模型蒸馏时的分布错配和时间信用分配问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型蒸馏方法创新。它把 on-policy imitation、Bradley-Terry 判别器和 flow-matching 更新结合起来，目标是让自回归视频生成器适配流式、长程和交互式生成场景。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Adversarial Flow Distillation。方法在同一 prompt 下分别查询教师和 rollout 当前学生，用 prompt-paired Bradley-Terry discriminator 估计教师样本与学生样本的差异，再把该差异转成 on-policy advantage，进一步作用到学生自身前向过程上的 flow-matching 更新。它不是简单 SFT，也不依赖教师暴露 score 或内部采样轨迹。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据、baseline 名称和具体指标。可确认的实验设定是异构黑盒教师到自回归视频学生的蒸馏，并强调教师与学生可在架构、容量、时间设计和采样日程上不同。
summary.authors_note: Yang You is known for large-batch optimization work such as LARS/LAMB.

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses distribution mismatch and denoising-time credit assignment when distilling black-box video teachers into causal autoregressive video students.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a distillation method for generative video models. It is relevant because it treats video generation as an on-policy student rollout problem rather than as ordinary supervised imitation from completed teacher samples.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adversarial Flow Distillation queries the teacher and rolls out the current student on matched prompts, trains a prompt-paired Bradley-Terry discriminator to estimate teacher-student discrepancy on clean samples, and converts the resulting on-policy advantage into flow-matching updates on the student's own forward process.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide parameter counts, data scale, baseline details, or metric numbers. The stated experimental setting is heterogeneous black-box teacher-to-student video distillation where teacher and student may differ in architecture, capacity, temporal design, and sampling schedule.
summary_en.authors_note: Yang You is known for large-batch optimization work such as LARS/LAMB.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法框架即可；它对LLM蒸馏的可迁移点是on-policy差异估计，不是视频指标本身。
recommendation.en: Skim the method only; the transferable idea is on-policy discrepancy estimation for distillation, not the video-generation metrics.

paper.title: PixelWizard: Towards Efficient High-Fidelity Video Generation at Ultra-Large Spatial Resolution
paper.abstract: High-resolution video generation faces a coupled bottleneck of optimization instability and prohibitive computational costs. The massive expansion of the token sequence not only biases optimization toward local textures at the expense of global coherence, leading to structural collapse, but also imposes prohibitive training costs and severe inference latency. To address this, we propose PixelWizard, a framework that hierarchically decouples global structure modeling from fine-grained detail synt

summary.core_problem: 提升超大空间分辨率视频生成的结构稳定性、细节质量和推理效率，缓解高分辨率 token 序列带来的训练与生成成本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成方法和推理加速训练策略。它不直接研究 LLM 预训练，但对统一多模态生成中的层级建模、结构先验压缩和少步采样有可迁移参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PixelWizard，将全局结构建模与细粒度细节合成层级解耦：先构建紧凑的时空 anchor 来承载密集结构先验，再用该 anchor 引导高分辨率细节生成。随后提出 Noise-Span Aligned Shortcut Training，显式建模采样步长，使模型能够跨越更大的生成步幅以降低推理延迟。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练视频规模、分辨率设置、baseline 或具体提升幅度；只说明目标是在超大空间分辨率视频生成中减少结构崩塌、保持高频细节，并通过 shortcut training 打破推理瓶颈。
summary.authors_note: 摘要标注该工作来自 Cohere，但未提供更具体团队信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve structural stability, visual fidelity, and inference efficiency for ultra-high-spatial-resolution video generation, where token sequence length makes both training and sampling expensive.
summary_en.importance: This is a video-generation method with an inference-acceleration training component. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but its hierarchical decomposition of structure and detail, compact structural priors, and shortcut sampling may be relevant to unified multimodal generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: PixelWizard hierarchically decouples global structure modeling from fine-grained detail synthesis. It first builds a compact spatiotemporal anchor that concentrates structural priors, then uses that anchor to guide high-resolution detail generation. It also introduces Noise-Span Aligned Shortcut Training, which explicitly models step size so the model can traverse larger generation intervals and reduce inference latency.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training-video scale, exact resolution settings, baselines, or numerical gains. It claims improved resistance to structural collapse, preservation of high-frequency details, and faster inference through shortcut training for ultra-large-resolution video generation.
summary_en.authors_note: The provided metadata marks Cohere as the notable institution, but no more specific team information is available.

recommendation.zh: 可扫方法图和 shortcut training；层级 anchor 思路对高分辨率多模态生成有参考，但没有规模细节前别调高权重。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure and shortcut-training setup; the hierarchical anchor idea is relevant to high-res multimodal generation, but do not overweight it without scale and ablation details.

paper.title: Bernini: Latent Semantic Planning for Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and diffusion models have each reached remarkable maturity: MLLMs excel at reasoning over heterogeneous multimodal inputs with strong semantic grounding, while diffusion models synthesize images and videos with photorealistic fidelity. We argue that these two families can be unified through a simple division of labor: MLLMs perform semantic planning, while diffusion models render pixels from high-level semantic guidance and low-level visual features. Buil

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文试图解决视频生成和编辑中的接口问题：如何让 MLLM 负责语义理解和规划，让 diffusion/flow 模型负责像素生成，同时避免把两者粗糙拼接成一个难训练的端到端系统。
summary.importance: 这篇更接近统一多模态预训练和新型生成建模接口设计。核心价值在于它选择 MLLM 内部的 ViT embedding space 作为语义桥梁，而不是让 MLLM 直接生成离散图像 token、文本 prompt，或让 diffusion 模型只依赖外部文本编码器。这个选择有两个含义：第一，视觉语义计划落在 MLLM 已经熟悉的连续表征空间里，减少适配成本；第二，生成器接收的是目标画面的高层视觉表示，而不只是语言描述，因此更适合复杂编辑、参考图/参考视频约束和主体保持。
summary.technical_approach: Bernini 由两部分组成。Planner 是一个 MLLM，它接收统一序列化的多模态输入，包括文本、源图像/视频的 ViT tokens，以及目标输出的占位 tokens。它不直接输出像素，而是在 MLLM 的 ViT embedding space 中预测目标视觉语义表示。训练时采用 masked generative modeling：随机 mask 目标 ViT tokens，在 MLLM hidden states 上接轻量 ViT embedding decoder，恢复被 mask 的目标 embedding；推理时从全 mask 状态开始逐步填充目标语义 tokens。Renderer 是 DiT，使用 flow matching 在 VAE latent tokens 上生成图像或视频，通过 cross-attention 接收 planner 给出的语义 embedding，并结合文本特征；做编辑任务时额外注入源输入的 VAE latent，以保留低层细节和时序一致性。为了统一多源视觉输入，论文提出 Segment-Aware 3D RoPE，在时空 RoPE 中加入 segment index 相关的相位调制，避免多个图像/视频源在位置编码上混淆。另一个设计是 latent-space CoT：让 planner 在连续视觉语义空间中进行中间推理，再输出最终 target embedding。训练策略上，两部分可以大体独立训练，再轻量联合调整，这有利于保留 MLLM 的理解能力，也降低整体训练难度。
summary.experiments: 论文覆盖 text-to-video、subject-to-video、图像/视频编辑等任务，并构造了多任务训练数据：视频和图像 pair 预训练数据、基于传播和运动感知的视频编辑数据、参考图和参考视频引导生成数据。评测包括 OpenVE-Bench、OpenS2V-Eval，以及论文提出的 Bernini-Bench。给出的结论是 Bernini 在多个视频生成、编辑和主体保持评测上优于对比系统，尤其在需要理解复杂指令、多参考输入和保持主体一致性的设置中收益更明显。当前提供的正文片段没有给出完整参数规模、训练 token/clip 数量和逐项指标，阅读时需要回到实验表格核对具体幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。优先看 Fig. 3 和方法部分，确认 planner 到 renderer 的接口到底传什么：是 ViT semantic embeddings，而不是文本 prompt 或 VAE latent。然后看 masked ViT embedding prediction 的训练/推理流程、SA-3D RoPE 的定义、编辑任务中源 VAE latent 的注入方式。实验部分重点看多任务数据构造和 ablation：没有 semantic planner 会怎样，只用文本条件会怎样，去掉 source VAE features 或 SA-3D RoPE 会怎样。对基座研究更有用的是“连续语义计划 + diffusion 渲染”的分工设计，而不是具体视频 demo。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the interface problem between multimodal understanding and video synthesis: how to let an MLLM perform semantic planning while a diffusion-style generator renders pixels, without forcing both roles into a brittle end-to-end design.
summary_en.importance: This is relevant to unified multimodal pretraining and generation-interface design. The central choice is to use the MLLM’s own ViT embedding space as the semantic bridge to the generator. This is more informative than passing only a text prompt, and more natural for the MLLM than directly producing pixels or low-level VAE latents. It also creates a clean separation: the MLLM predicts what should appear in a compact visual-semantic space, while the DiT handles photorealistic rendering and detail preservation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Bernini has two main modules. The planner is an MLLM that consumes a unified multimodal sequence containing text, source visual tokens, and target placeholders. It predicts the target visual representation in continuous ViT-embedding space. Training follows a masked generative modeling setup: target ViT tokens are randomly masked, and a lightweight ViT-embedding decoder on top of the MLLM reconstructs the missing target embeddings from contextual hidden states. At inference, the planner progressively fills in the full target representation starting from masked tokens. The renderer is a DiT trained with flow matching over VAE latent tokens. It conditions on the planner’s semantic embeddings through cross-attention, also uses text features, and for editing tasks receives source VAE features to preserve low-level appearance and temporal consistency. The paper also introduces Segment-Aware 3D RoPE, which adds segment-index-dependent phase modulation to spatiotemporal rotary embeddings so that multiple visual sources can coexist in one sequence. A latent-space CoT mechanism lets the planner perform intermediate reasoning before producing the final target embedding.
summary_en.experiments: The system is evaluated on text-to-video generation, subject-to-video generation, and image/video editing. The training corpus combines video and image-pair pretraining data, propagation-based and motion-aware video editing data, and reference-image/reference-video guided generation data. Evaluation includes OpenVE-Bench, OpenS2V-Eval, and a new Bernini-Bench. The reported results show consistent gains over compared systems, with stronger effects in settings that require complex instruction following, multiple visual references, editing consistency, and subject preservation. The provided text does not include the full model scale, data scale, or all numeric metric values, so the exact margins should be checked in the experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with Fig. 3 and the method description to understand the planner-renderer contract: the planner outputs ViT semantic embeddings, not text prompts or VAE latents. Then read the masked ViT-embedding prediction procedure, Segment-Aware 3D RoPE, and the source-VAE conditioning path for editing. In the experiments, focus on the multi-task data construction and ablations: removing the semantic planner, replacing it with text-only conditioning, removing source VAE features, or dropping SA-3D RoPE. The useful idea for foundation-model researchers is the continuous semantic planning interface between MLLM reasoning and diffusion rendering.

recommendation.zh: MLLM+扩散的分工架构值得了解一下，语义接口的设计思路对多模态统一预训练有参考价值。重点看规划器和渲染器的接口设计。
recommendation.en: The MLLM-diffusion division-of-labor architecture is worth understanding; the semantic interface design offers insights for unified multimodal pretraining. Focus on the planner-renderer interface design.

paper.title: One Sentence, One Drama: Personalized Short-Form Drama Generation via Multi-Agent Systems
paper.abstract: Existing approaches for digital short-drama production typically rely on one-shot LLM generated scripts and loosely coupled pipelines, which fail to satisfy three key requirements of short-drama generation: (1) narrative pacing, resulting in weak hooks, insufficient escalation, and unattractive endings; (2) spatial consistency, leading to drifting scene layouts and inconsistent character positions across clips; and (3) production-level quality control, requiring extensive manual review and corre

summary.core_problem: 现有短剧生成方法在叙事节奏、空间一致性和生产级质量控制上存在缺陷，一键生成完整短剧尚未实现。
summary.importance: 首次提出从单句到完整短剧的端到端多Agent框架，涵盖剧本创作到视觉生成全流程。
summary.technical_approach: 分层多Agent框架：（1）多Agent辩论式故事生成模块，确保短剧节奏和叙事连贯性；（2）3D基础的第一帧生成机制，建立共享空间布局。包含迭代精炼机制。
summary.experiments: 在短剧生成任务上验证，与现有LLM脚本生成方法对比叙事质量和空间一致性；未提供具体模型规模。
summary.authors_note: 清华大学、新加坡国立大学等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing short-drama generation methods fail at narrative pacing, spatial consistency, and production-quality control; end-to-end short drama generation from a single sentence is unsolved.
summary_en.importance: First end-to-end multi-agent framework transforming a user's single-sentence idea into a fully produced short drama, covering scriptwriting to visual generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Hierarchical multi-agent framework: (1) multi-agent debate-based story generation for pacing and coherence; (2) 3D-grounded first-frame generation for shared spatial layout. Includes iterative refinement.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on short drama generation tasks; compared narrative quality and spatial consistency against existing LLM script methods; no specific model sizes provided.
summary_en.authors_note: Tsinghua University, National University of Singapore, etc.

recommendation.zh: 多Agent在短剧创作领域的应用，框架设计有参考价值但属于特定领域应用，对LLM基座预训练无直接启发。
recommendation.en: Multi-agent application in short-drama generation; framework design is somewhat interesting but domain-specific, no direct insight for LLM foundation pretraining.

institutions: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

paper.title: DySink: Dynamic Frame Sinks for Autoregressive Long Video Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive long video generation often adopts bounded-memory streaming for efficiency, typically combining local windows for short-term continuity with static early-frame sinks as long-range anchors. However, this fixed allocation keeps early frames cached even when the current visual state has substantially diverged from them, while discarding potentially more relevant intermediate history. As a result, the retained long-range context may become less adaptive and bias generation toward outd

summary.core_problem: 长视频自回归生成在有界 KV 缓存下通常保留近期滑窗和最早若干帧作为 frame sinks。问题是，早期帧会在长 rollout 中逐渐变成过时锚点，而更相关的中间历史被滑窗丢掉。更严重时，RoPE 相位重新对齐会让多个 attention head 同时过度关注 sink，出现内容回退到早期帧的 sink collapse。
summary.importance: 这项工作对 LLM 预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对长序列生成里的有限记忆分配有参考价值。它把“固定前缀 sink”改成“按当前状态检索历史 sink”，思路接近长上下文语言模型中的动态记忆选择。对视频生成研究更直接的启发是：长程一致性不只取决于缓存长度，也取决于缓存内容是否仍然和当前状态匹配。
summary.technical_approach: DySink 维护一个紧凑历史 memory bank，不再固定保留最早帧，而是根据当前生成上下文检索视觉相关的历史帧，把这些帧作为 dynamic frame sinks 参与长程条件建模。为了降低 sink collapse，方法加入逐层 sink anomaly gate。这个 gate 观察不同 attention heads 是否对检索到的历史上下文形成异常一致的高注意力；如果出现这种 inter-head consensus，就认为该层的检索上下文可能引发 collapse，于是抑制对应 retrieved KV，退回到滑窗上下文。与修改 RoPE 的做法不同，DySink 保留原位置编码，只在层级上控制历史上下文的使用。
summary.experiments: 实验面向分钟级视频生成，基于现代 flow-matching / DiT 视频生成框架和自回归流式生成设定。相对静态 frame sink 等强基线，DySink 在 Dynamic Degree 上提升 6.60–8.16 分，同时 Temporal Quality 也更高。消融重点支持两个结论：动态检索比固定早期 sink 更能维持长程相关性；逐层异常 gate 可以减少多头注意力同时塌到 sink 上的情况，降低场景重置和循环运动。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 15–20 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 static frame sink 失效模式的拆解，Method 中 memory bank 检索和 sink anomaly gate 的定义，以及实验里的 attention 可视化、collapse 案例和 ablation。预训练研究者可把它当作长上下文缓存策略案例，而不必深读视频指标细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Autoregressive long-video generation often uses a bounded KV cache with a recent sliding window plus a few early frames as frame sinks. This fixed allocation becomes brittle in long rollouts: early frames may no longer match the current visual state, while more relevant intermediate history has already been evicted. In severe cases, RoPE phase re-alignment can make many attention heads over-attend to the same sinks, causing content to regress toward early frames.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not central to LLM pretraining, but it is useful for thinking about finite-memory generation. Its main lesson is that long-range conditioning is not only about keeping some old context; the retained context must remain relevant to the current state. This is closely related to dynamic memory selection in long-context language models.
summary_en.technical_approach: DySink replaces static early-frame sinks with retrieved dynamic sinks. It keeps a compact memory bank of historical frames and retrieves frames that are visually relevant to the current generation context. These frames are inserted as long-range anchors. The method also adds a lightweight per-layer sink anomaly gate. The gate detects abnormal agreement across attention heads over retrieved context; when such consensus appears, the layer suppresses the retrieved KV context and falls back to the sliding window. Unlike approaches that perturb or redesign RoPE, DySink keeps the original positional encoding and controls risky memory only at the context-selection level.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments target minute-long video generation under a streaming autoregressive setup built on modern flow-matching / DiT video generators. DySink improves Dynamic Degree by 6.60 to 8.16 points over strong static-sink baselines and also reports higher Temporal Quality. The ablations indicate that retrieval improves the relevance of long-range anchors, while the anomaly gate reduces collapse patterns such as abrupt resets and cyclic motion.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–20 minutes. Read the failure analysis of static frame sinks in the introduction, then the memory retrieval mechanism and the per-layer anomaly gate in the method section. The most useful empirical material is the ablation and attention visualization around sink collapse. LLM researchers can treat it as a case study in adaptive cache allocation rather than a video-generation metric paper.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和方法图即可；它把 attention sink 的失效模式搬到视频生成，setup 若干净可借鉴到长上下文缓存策略。
recommendation.en: Skim the abstract and method figure; it maps attention-sink failure into video generation, and a clean setup could inform long-context cache policies.

institutions: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
Key Lab. of Computer Network and Information Integration, Southeast University

paper.title: Tiny-Engram: Trigger-Indexed Concept Tables for Generative Vision
paper.abstract: Current personalization methods for generative vision models typically encode new concepts through continuous adapters or weight updates, yet provide limited control over whether and when a concept should be retrieved. In this work, we introduce Tiny-Engram, a compact trigger-indexed concept table that gives visual memories an explicit lexical address and activation boundary inside frozen image and video generators. Tiny-Engram parameterizes each concept as a small set of memory entries indexed

summary.core_problem: 解决生成式视觉个性化中，新概念通常通过连续 adapter 或权重更新写入模型，但缺少显式“何时触发、何时不触发”的检索边界。
summary.importance: 贡献属于多模态生成中的参数高效个性化与可控记忆注入。对 LLM 预训练研究员的价值不在图像生成本身，而在“触发词索引的外部概念表”这一记忆寻址设计，和离散检索式知识注入有类比空间。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Tiny-Engram：在冻结的图像/视频生成器外接一个小型 trigger-indexed concept table。每个概念由少量 memory entries 表示，通过注册的 n-gram 匹配触发，只在匹配到的 trigger span 内调制 text encoder hidden states；未触发时条件路径与原模型完全一致。该设计可用于 latent diffusion 和多编码器 diffusion-transformer。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在单编码器 latent diffusion 与多编码器 DiT 骨干上都验证了方法，能把稀有触发短语绑定到目标身份，同时保留周围 prompt 的组合控制；还把同一表式记忆评估到文本条件视频生成。未给出具体数据集、参数量和数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of explicit retrieval boundaries in personalized generative vision, where new concepts are usually injected through continuous adapters or weight updates without clear control over when they should activate.
summary_en.importance: The contribution sits in parameter-efficient personalization and controllable memory injection for multimodal generation. For a pretraining researcher, the value is not image generation per se, but the idea of a trigger-indexed external concept table, which resembles discrete retrieval-style knowledge injection.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tiny-Engram attaches a small trigger-indexed concept table to frozen image/video generators. Each concept is represented by a few memory entries activated by registered n-gram matches, and these entries modulate text-encoder hidden states only within the matched trigger span; outside that span, the conditioning path is identical to the frozen base model. The method is applied to both latent diffusion and multi-encoder diffusion-transformer backbones.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims validation on both single-encoder latent diffusion and multi-encoder DiT backbones, showing that a rare trigger phrase can be bound to a target identity while preserving compositional control from the surrounding prompt. The same table-based memory is also evaluated in text-conditioned video generation. No concrete datasets, model sizes, or gains are given in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“只在触发 span 注入记忆、其余路径保持 frozen-identical”这个设计很干净；做外部记忆/概念绑定的人可借鉴，其他人看摘要够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the 'inject memory only on the trigger span while keeping the rest frozen-identical' design is clean; useful if you care about external memory or concept binding, otherwise the abstract is enough.

paper.title: FlowLong: Inference-time Long Video Generation via Manifold-constrained Tweedie Matching
paper.abstract: Extending the generation horizon of video diffusion models to long sequences remains a long-standing and important challenge. Existing training-free approaches fall into two categories: extensions of bidirectional models, which are tightly coupled to specific architectures and suffer from quality degradation over long horizons, and autoregressive models, which accumulate drift errors due to exposure bias and tend to produce repetitive motion patterns. To address these issues, we propose a novel

summary.core_problem: 现有长视频生成方法要么绑定特定架构存在质量退化，要么自回归累积漂移误差生成重复内容
summary.importance: 提出无需额外训练、架构无关的推理时长视频生成方法
summary.technical_approach: 滑动窗口生成内容，重叠区域通过Tweedie匹配保证流形约束和时序一致性，随机早期采样注入噪声同步轨迹
summary.experiments: 未公开具体量化对比结果

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long video generation methods are either tied to specific architectures with quality degradation, or accumulate drift errors to generate repetitive content in autoregressive mode
summary_en.importance: Proposes an architecture-agnostic inference-time long video generation method without extra training
summary_en.technical_approach: Generate content via sliding windows, enforce manifold constraint and temporal consistency on overlapping regions via Tweedie matching, inject noise via stochastic early-phase sampling to synchronize trajectories
summary_en.experiments: No specific quantitative comparison results are disclosed

recommendation.zh: 纯视频生成推理优化工作，做多模态生成研究时可备查，无需读正文
recommendation.en: Pure inference optimization for video generation, for reference only when doing multimodal generation research, no need to read full text

paper.title: Bernini: Latent Semantic Planning for Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and diffusion models have each reached remarkable maturity: MLLMs excel at reasoning over heterogeneous multimodal inputs with strong semantic grounding, while diffusion models synthesize images and videos with photorealistic fidelity. We argue that these two families can be unified through a simple division of labor: MLLMs perform semantic planning, while diffusion models render pixels from high-level semantic guidance and low-level visual features. Buil

summary.core_problem: 解决视频生成与编辑里“语义规划”和“像素渲染”耦合过紧的问题，希望把 MLLM 的高层语义能力与 diffusion 的视觉生成能力更干净地拼接起来。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是多模态生成框架设计：提出用语义表示作为接口，把 MLLM 负责的语义规划与 DiT 负责的像素渲染解耦。对做统一多模态预训练的人有一点接口设计启发，但它更偏视频生成系统，而不是 LLM 基座预训练本身。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，先用基于 MLLM 的 planner 直接在 ViT embedding 空间预测目标语义表示，再由 DiT-based renderer 在该语义计划条件下生成视频像素；编辑场景下再加入源视频的 VAE 特征以保留细节。核心设计是把“语义”作为 planner 和 renderer 的中间接口，因此两部分可以分开训练，只做轻量协同训练，尽量复用各自已有预训练能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出明确模型规模、训练数据规模和具体基线名称，只说明覆盖视频生成与编辑任务，并强调在保留预训练能力的同时实现统一框架。由于缺少定量细节，目前更适合把它当作架构接口思路，而不是可直接迁移到 LLM 预训练 recipe 的证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the tight coupling between semantic planning and pixel rendering in video generation/editing, aiming to combine MLLM-level semantic grounding with diffusion-based visual synthesis through a cleaner interface.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly a multimodal generation framework: using semantic representations as the interface between an MLLM planner and a DiT renderer. This offers some interface-design signal for unified multimodal pretraining, but it is still much more a video generation system paper than a foundation-LLM pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses an MLLM-based planner to predict target semantic representations directly in ViT embedding space, then a DiT-based renderer generates pixels conditioned on that plan. For editing, source VAE features are added to preserve details. The key idea is to treat semantics as the contract between planner and renderer, enabling separate training with only light co-training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes, training corpus scale, or named baselines. It claims unified support for video generation and editing while preserving pretrained capabilities. Given the lack of quantitative detail, this is better read as an interface proposal than as strong evidence for transferable LLM-pretraining methodology.

recommendation.zh: 更像视频生成系统整合，不是 pretrain 论文；只需看它如何把“语义接口”从像素生成里剥离，若你在想 AR+diffusion 联合建模，这个接口定义可作弱参考。
recommendation.en: This is mostly a video generation integration paper, not a pretraining one; only read it for the semantic-interface split if you're thinking about AR+diffusion unification.

paper.title: PhyWorld: Physics-Faithful World Model for Video Generation
paper.abstract: World simulators can provide safe and scalable environments for training Physical AI systems before real-world deployment. Large video generation models are emerging as a promising basis for such simulators because they can generate diverse and realistic visual futures. However, using them as world simulators requires physically faithful video continuations, namely, generated videos that preserve the physical state implied by the conditioning input, and evolve in ways consistent with basic physi

summary.core_problem: 现有视频生成模型作为物理AI训练的世界模拟器时，生成内容物理保真度低，无法保留输入隐含的物理状态，不符合基础物理规则
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将DPO偏好对齐用于视频生成的物理约束优化，提升生成视频的物理一致性
summary.technical_approach: 采用两阶段后训练：第一阶段用流匹配微调提升视频帧间视觉属性稳定性和运动连贯性，第二阶段基于物理偏好数据做DPO对齐生成动态与物理规则
summary.experiments: 在物理保真视频续写任务上测试，生成内容的物理一致性优于基线视频生成模型
summary.authors_note: 东北大学、佐治亚大学等机构研究团队，无公开知名相关领域作者

summary_en.core_problem: When existing video generation models act as world simulators for physical AI training, generated content has low physical fidelity, cannot preserve physical states implied by inputs, and violates basic physical principles
summary_en.importance: Method innovation, first apply DPO preference alignment to physical constraint optimization for video generation, improving physical consistency of generated videos
summary_en.technical_approach: Adopt two-stage post-training: first stage uses flow matching fine-tuning to improve inter-frame visual attribute stability and motion coherence, second stage aligns generated dynamics with physical principles via DPO on physics preference data
summary_en.experiments: Tested on physically faithful video continuation tasks, generated content outperforms baseline video generation models in physical consistency
summary_en.authors_note: Research team from Northeastern University, University of Georgia, etc., no well-known authors in related fields publicly identified

recommendation.zh: 物理对齐视频生成的增量工作，做视频世界模型研究可参考其DPO对齐思路，无需精读
recommendation.en: Incremental work on physically aligned video generation, DPO alignment idea is referable for video world model research, no need for intensive reading

paper.title: PRISM: A Benchmark for Programmatic Spatial-Temporal Reasoning
paper.abstract: Programmatic video generation through code offers geometric precision and temporal coherence beyond pixel-level diffusion models, yet rigorously evaluating whether language models can produce spatially correct animated outputs remains an open problem. We introduce PRISM, a large-scale benchmark of 10,372 human-calibrated instruction-code pairs (20 times larger than prior programmatic video generation benchmarks), grounded in real-world knowledge visualization scenarios across English and Chinese

summary.core_problem: 现有程序式视频生成评测集规模小，缺少对空间正确性、时间连贯性的系统评测维度
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，构建了规模为之前同类基准20倍的程序式时空推理评测集，覆盖中英多学科场景
summary.technical_approach: PRISM基准包含10372条人工校准的指令-代码对，设计4个互补评测指标：代码可执行性、空间推理正确性、动态视觉复杂度、时间密度，可系统诊断模型能力短板
summary.experiments: 评测7个主流LLM，发现执行成功率到空间正确率存在显著落差，平均下降幅度超过40%
summary.authors_note: 上海交通大学研究团队

summary_en.core_problem: Existing programmatic video generation benchmarks are small in scale, lack systematic evaluation dimensions for spatial correctness and temporal coherence
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution, constructs a programmatic spatial-temporal reasoning benchmark 20 times larger than previous counterparts, covering Chinese and English multi-discipline scenarios
summary_en.technical_approach: PRISM benchmark contains 10372 human-calibrated instruction-code pairs, designs 4 complementary evaluation metrics: code executability, spatial reasoning correctness, dynamic visual complexity, temporal density, which can systematically diagnose model capability gaps
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated 7 mainstream LLMs, found a significant gap between execution success rate and spatial correctness, with an average drop of over 40%
summary_en.authors_note: Research team from Shanghai Jiao Tong University

recommendation.zh: 仅作为程序式多模态生成的评测基准备查，不需要阅读正文
recommendation.en: Only for reference as a programmatic multimodal generation benchmark, no need to read full text

paper.title: Enhancing Train-Free Infinite-Frame Generation for Consistent Long Videos
paper.abstract: Without incurring significant computational overhead, train-free long video generation aims to enable foundation video generation models to produce longer videos. Frame-level autoregressive frameworks, e.g., FIFO-diffusion, offer the advantage of generating infinitely long videos with constant memory consumption. However, the mismatch between training and inference, coupled with the challenge of maintaining long-term consistency, limits the effective utilization of foundation models. To mitigate

summary.core_problem: 解决 train-free 长视频生成中，frame-level autoregressive diffusion 推理与基础模型训练分布不匹配、长程一致性差的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是视频生成推理方法，不是 LLM 预训练。相关性主要来自长序列生成中的训练-推理 gap 和一致性维护，这两个问题与语言模型长上下文生成有弱类比。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MIGA，一种无需训练的 infinite-frame 长视频生成方法。方法包含两阶段 alignment，用于减少送入模型的过大噪声跨度；还引入 dual consistency enhancement，包括 self-reflection 修正早期高噪声帧，以及 long-range frame guidance 利用后期低噪声帧引导生成。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称在不显著增加计算开销的情况下提升长视频一致性，并延续 FIFO-diffusion 类方法的常量内存优势。未给出具体基础视频模型、生成长度、指标提升或用户评测数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses train-free long-video generation, where frame-level autoregressive diffusion suffers from training-inference mismatch and weak long-term consistency.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-time video generation method rather than LLM pretraining work. Its relevance is limited to the general issue of training-inference mismatch and consistency in long sequential generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: MIGA is a train-free infinite-frame generation method. It uses a two-stage alignment mechanism to reduce the excessive noise span fed to the base model, and a dual consistency mechanism: self-reflection for correcting early high-noise frames and long-range frame guidance from later low-noise frames.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims improved long-video consistency without significant extra compute while preserving the constant-memory property of FIFO-style frame autoregression. It does not provide model names, generation lengths, metric deltas, or human evaluation numbers.

recommendation.zh: 作为长序列生成的类比材料即可；读方法图，不必追实验，和 LLM 预训练的耦合很弱。
recommendation.en: Use it only as an analogy for long sequential generation; skim the method figure, but the coupling to LLM pretraining is weak.

paper.title: Echo-Forcing: A Scene Memory Framework for Interactive Long Video Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models enable open-ended generation through local attention and KV caching. However, existing training-free long-video optimization methods mainly focus on stable extension under a single prompt, making them difficult to handle interactive scenarios involving prompt switching, old scene forgetting, and historical scene recall. We identify the core bottleneck as the functional entanglement of historical KV states: stable anchors and recent dynamics are handled by th

summary.core_problem: 解决交互式长视频生成中 prompt 切换、旧场景遗忘、历史场景召回和背景污染之间的冲突。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成中的训练免费记忆框架。它把视频扩展问题从单 prompt 稳定续写扩展到交互式场景管理，和 AR video diffusion 的 KV cache 使用有关，但对 LLM 预训练方法论影响较间接。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Echo-Forcing，将历史 KV 状态拆成稳定锚点、压缩历史和近期窗口三类记忆。核心机制包括 Hierarchical Temporal Memory、Scene Recall Frames，以及在 relative RoPE 下管理长程 scene memory，避免同一 cache policy 同时承担稳定背景和近期动态。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体模型规模、数据集和量化提升。论文声称面向 autoregressive video diffusion models 的交互式长视频生成，并与已有 training-free long-video optimization 方法比较，重点评估 prompt switching、scene forgetting 和 long-range recall。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses prompt switching, old-scene forgetting, historical scene recall, and background contamination in interactive long-video generation.
summary_en.importance: This is a training-free memory framework for multimodal generation. It extends long-video optimization from stable continuation under a single prompt to interactive scene management. Its relevance to LLM pretraining is indirect, though it touches AR video diffusion and KV-cache behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: Echo-Forcing separates historical KV states into stable anchors, compressed history, and recent windows. Its mechanisms include hierarchical temporal memory, scene recall frames, and long-range scene memory under relative RoPE, avoiding one cache policy being responsible for both stable background and recent dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, dataset details, or numerical gains. The paper targets autoregressive video diffusion models and compares against training-free long-video optimization methods on prompt switching, scene forgetting, and long-range recall.

recommendation.zh: 值得知道它怎样拆 KV 记忆角色；视频生成细节对 pretrain 价值有限，不必读完整实验。
recommendation.en: Worth noting for how it separates KV memory roles; the video-generation specifics have limited pretraining value, so no need to read the full experiments.

paper.title: PanoWorld: Geometry-Consistent Panoramic Video World Modeling
paper.abstract: We present PanoWorld, a panoramic video world model that generates geometry-consistent 360$\degree$ video from a single image and a caption. Existing panoramic video methods optimize primarily for visual realism and do not explicitly constrain the underlying 3D scene state, producing outputs that appear plausible yet exhibit inconsistent depth, broken correspondences, and implausible motion across the spherical surface. We address this gap by framing panoramic video generation as a geometry- and

summary.core_problem: 从单张图像和文本描述生成几何一致的 360 度全景视频，减少深度、对应关系和球面运动的不一致。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态视频生成和世界模型方法。它不直接服务 LLM 预训练，但对视频生成模型如何加入显式几何约束有参考意义，尤其是把视觉合成从像素真实感推进到潜在 3D 状态一致性。
summary.technical_approach: PanoWorld 基于预训练的透视视频 world model，加入两个轻量正则：用伪全景深度监督的 depth consistency loss，以及监督跟踪点在 3D world-frame 中跨时间位置的 trajectory consistency loss。同时对 conditioning 和位置编码做球面几何适配，并提出 PanoGeo 评测资源。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明方法面向单图加 caption 的全景视频生成，并评估几何一致性、深度一致性和运动轨迹一致性；未给出模型参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 名称或具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 Northeastern University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper generates geometry-consistent 360-degree panoramic video from a single image and a caption, reducing inconsistent depth, broken correspondences, and implausible spherical motion.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal video generation and world-modeling contribution. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to how video generative models can be constrained by explicit geometry rather than optimized only for visual plausibility.
summary_en.technical_approach: PanoWorld builds on a pretrained perspective video world model and adds two lightweight regularizers: a depth consistency loss using pseudo panoramic depth, and a trajectory consistency loss supervising tracked points in 3D world-frame coordinates over time. It also adapts conditioning and positional encoding to spherical geometry and introduces the PanoGeo evaluation resource.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract describes evaluation for single-image-plus-caption panoramic video generation, focusing on geometric consistency, depth consistency, and trajectory consistency. It does not include model size, training data scale, baseline names, or exact numerical improvements.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is Northeastern University.

recommendation.zh: 知道思路即可；显式几何正则对视频 world model 有参考，但不是通用预训练范式。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing, not deep reading; explicit geometry regularization is useful for video world models but not a general pretraining recipe.

paper.title: KVPO: ODE-Native GRPO for Autoregressive Video Alignment via KV Semantic Exploration
paper.abstract: Aligning streaming autoregressive (AR) video generators with human preferences is challenging. Existing reinforcement learning methods predominantly rely on noise-based exploration and SDE-based surrogate policies that are mismatched to the deterministic ODE dynamics of distilled AR models, and tend to perturb low-level appearance rather than the high-level semantic storyline progression critical for long-horizon coherence. To address these limitations, we present KVPO, an ODE-native online Grou

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的问题不是通用 LLM 预训练，而是流式自回归视频生成模型的偏好对齐。更具体地说，作者关注的是：已经蒸馏成少步、可用 KV-cache 做因果生成的 AR 视频模型，如何在不破坏其原生 ODE/flow-matching 生成动力学的前提下做在线偏好优化。现有做法要么只是 reward-weighted distillation，缺少主动探索；要么把确定性 ODE 过程改写成带噪声的 SDE 来做探索，但这会偏离模型原本的生成轨迹，而且噪声主要扰动低层外观，不一定能探索到长程叙事和语义变化。
summary.importance: 它对纯预训练研究的直接相关性有限，更接近 post-train / alignment for generative video models。但其中有两个点对基座研究仍有启发。第一，作者把探索源从噪声注入转移到 KV-cache 路由，这说明在因果生成模型里，历史记忆本身可以作为策略探索的结构化自由度，而不必总靠 latent noise。第二，作者在 flow-matching 的 velocity field 空间里定义 surrogate policy，而不是借助外部距离度量，这反映出一个更一般的思路：如果生成模型有明确的原生动力学，偏好优化最好在该动力学空间内完成，而不是强行套用不匹配的 RL 近似。对做 AR+diffusion 联合建模、视频/语音生成对齐的人，这个思路有参考价值；对文本 LLM 预训练本身，启发较间接。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两部分组成。第一部分是 Causal History Routing，简称 CHR。流式 AR 视频生成通常按 block 逐段生成，每一段都依赖历史视频内容的 KV cache。作者认为，未来视频内容的高层语义和叙事走向，很大程度由历史上下文决定，因此如果想做有意义的探索，不应在 latent 上加噪，而应对历史 KV 的组成方式做分支化采样。具体做法是：保持 sink cache 不变，用它维持全局锚点；对 local cache 做随机路由，在固定槽位布局下，对部分较早历史帧进行分支式选择，而最近几帧保持不变。这样每个分支都仍然建立在真实历史上，探索发生在因果语义层面，而不是低层像素噪声层面。作者强调这种探索是 on-manifold 的，因为没有把采样过程改写成额外随机扩散。

第二部分是 ODE-native surrogate policy。现有 NeighborGRPO 一类方法用样本间欧氏距离近似 surrogate policy，隐含假设是生成空间几何比较均匀。作者认为这对视频生成不合适，因为不同 latent 维度对策略概率的贡献并不均匀。于是他们转向 flow-matching 的 velocity field 空间，定义了 Trajectory Velocity Energy，简称 TVE，用来衡量当前策略在原生 ODE 动力学下复现某个分支轨迹的相对可能性。基于 TVE 构造 Gibbs 形式的 surrogate policy，再结合组内相对奖励，得到 reward-weighted contrastive flow-matching objective。这样做的关键点在于：偏好优化目标直接作用在模型原本学习的速度场上，而不是在外部样本距离或 SDE 转移核上做近似。

从方法取舍上看，这篇论文的逻辑是清楚的：如果模型原本是 few-step distilled AR video generator，且推理依赖 causal attention 与 KV cache，那么探索和优化都应尽量利用这两个结构，而不是引入与原模型不一致的随机机制。
summary.experiments:
实验围绕多个 distilled AR 视频生成器展开，评测场景包括单提示短视频和多提示长视频。作者报告 KVPO 在人类偏好对齐上优于 reward-weighted distillation、噪声驱动探索方法以及基于邻域距离的 ODE 优化方法。全文可见的核心结论是：CHR 带来的分支更偏向语义和叙事差异，而不是仅仅改变纹理或局部外观；TVE surrogate policy 比欧氏距离 surrogate 更能稳定反映分支优劣。

不过，从当前给出的全文片段看，具体数值、模型规模、训练步数、视频长度、奖励模型配置等细节没有完整展开，因此不适合在这里复述未经确认的数字。更值得注意的是实验设计意图：作者不仅比较最终偏好分数，还试图区分不同探索机制产生的分支类型，强调“噪声探索偏低层，KV 路由探索偏高层语义”。如果读原文，建议重点核对这部分可视化和消融，因为这是方法成立的关键证据。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点看 Introduction、Method 和消融实验。先抓住两个问题：为什么 SDE/noise exploration 不适合 few-step distilled AR video generator；为什么 KV cache 可以成为更自然的探索变量。然后看 CHR 的 cache 结构设计，尤其是 sink/local 的分工，以及哪些历史帧被固定、哪些被路由。接着看 TVE surrogate policy 的定义，理解它如何把分支轨迹映射成 Gibbs 权重。

如果只想判断是否值得进一步跟进，45 分钟左右足够。真正值得读细的是消融：去掉 CHR、改回噪声探索、把 TVE 换成欧氏距离 surrogate 后，长视频一致性和偏好分数怎么变。对做文本 LLM 的人，不必深究视频细节，但可以留意它对“在模型原生状态空间里做对齐”这件事的处理方式。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper is not about core LLM pretraining; it addresses preference alignment for streaming autoregressive video generators. More specifically, it asks how to perform online policy optimization for few-step distilled AR video models without breaking their native ODE / flow-matching formulation. Existing approaches either rely on reward-weighted distillation with weak exploration, or convert the deterministic ODE process into an SDE with injected noise, which can distort the model’s original generation dynamics and mostly perturbs low-level appearance rather than long-horizon semantics.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to language-model pretraining is limited, but it contains two ideas that are still useful for foundation-model researchers. First, it shifts exploration from latent noise to KV-cache routing. That suggests a broader principle: in causal generative models, historical memory can itself be a structured exploration variable. Second, it defines the surrogate policy inside the model’s native flow-matching velocity-field space rather than through an external distance metric. That is a meaningful alignment design choice: if a generator has a well-defined native dynamical space, preference optimization may work better when formulated there instead of being forced into a mismatched RL approximation. This is more relevant to AR+diffusion hybrids, video generation, and possibly speech generation than to text-only LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two main components. The first is Causal History Routing (CHR). Streaming AR video generation proceeds block by block, and each new block depends on a historical KV cache. The authors argue that meaningful exploration should happen through alternative uses of historical context rather than through noise injection in latent space. In CHR, the sink cache is kept fixed to preserve global anchors, while the local cache is stochastically routed to create branch-specific contexts. The most recent frames remain fixed, while earlier local-memory slots are selectively varied across branches. This is intended to produce semantically different but causally grounded continuations. The key claim is that such exploration stays on-manifold because it does not alter the generator into a stochastic diffusion process.

The second component is an ODE-native surrogate policy. Prior ODE-based GRPO variants such as NeighborGRPO approximate the surrogate policy using Euclidean distances between generated samples. The authors argue that this assumes an overly uniform geometry in latent space and may not reflect the model’s actual preference structure. They instead define Trajectory Velocity Energy (TVE) in the flow-matching velocity-field space, measuring how likely the current policy is to reproduce a branch trajectory under the native ODE dynamics. A Gibbs-form surrogate policy is then built from TVE, and combined with group-relative rewards to form a reward-weighted contrastive flow-matching objective. The main design choice is clear: preference optimization is embedded directly into the model’s learned velocity field rather than imposed through external sample-space geometry or SDE transition kernels.

Methodologically, the paper is internally consistent. If the base model is a few-step distilled AR video generator with causal attention and KV caching, then both exploration and optimization are designed to exploit exactly those structures.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are conducted on multiple distilled AR video generators, covering both single-prompt short-video and multi-prompt long-video settings. The reported outcome is that KVPO improves human-preference alignment over reward-weighted distillation baselines, noise-driven exploration methods, and ODE-based methods using neighborhood-distance surrogates. The qualitative claim is that CHR produces branch diversity at the semantic and narrative level, while noise injection mostly changes texture or local appearance. The TVE-based surrogate is also claimed to better reflect branch quality than Euclidean-distance approximations.

From the provided full-text excerpt, however, the exact numerical results, model sizes, training budgets, and reward-model details are not fully visible, so it would be unsafe to restate specific numbers without the complete tables. The more important point is the experimental logic: the paper tries to show not only better final preference scores, but also that the source of exploration matters. If you read the original, the key evidence to verify is in the ablations and visual comparisons that separate semantic exploration from low-level perturbation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Read the Introduction, Method, and ablations. Start with two questions: why SDE/noise-based exploration is a poor fit for few-step distilled AR video generators, and why the KV cache is a more natural exploration handle. Then inspect the CHR design, especially the sink/local cache split and which historical frames are fixed versus routed. After that, read the TVE surrogate-policy definition carefully to understand how branch trajectories are converted into Gibbs-style policy weights.

Roughly 45 minutes is enough for a useful pass. The most important part to check is the ablation section: what happens when CHR is removed, when noise exploration is restored, or when TVE is replaced by a Euclidean-distance surrogate. For text-LLM researchers, the video-specific details are secondary; the transferable idea is how alignment is formulated inside the model’s native state space.

recommendation.zh: 将RL对齐方法从文本拓展到视频生成，核心insight是用KV缓存而非噪声做探索，这对多模态RL有启发，建议读§3方法section了解机制。
recommendation.en: Extends RL alignment from text to video generation; core insight uses KV cache instead of noise for exploration, informative for multimodal RL; read §3 for mechanism.

paper.title: Compositional Video Generation via Inference-Time Guidance
paper.abstract: Text-to-video diffusion models generate realistic videos, but often fail on prompts requiring fine-grained compositional understanding, such as relations between entities, attributes, actions, and motion directions. We hypothesize that these failures need not be addressed by retraining the generator, but can instead be mitigated by steering the denoising process using the model's own internal grounding signals. We propose \textbf{CVG}, an inference-time guidance method for improving compositiona

summary.core_problem: 现有文本生成视频扩散模型在处理需要细粒度组合理解的提示时表现不佳，无法正确生成实体间的关系、属性、动作和运动方向等组合约束，现有提升组合性的方案需要重新训练生成器、额外标注数据或人工输入控制信号，成本较高。
summary.importance: 提出了一种无需修改生成视频模型主干的推理时控制方案，仅通过利用模型自身内部的交叉注意力信号即可提升组合生成的保真度，为多模态生成模型的推理时对齐提供了一种低成本的通用思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CVG框架，核心是利用生成视频扩散模型内部的交叉注意力图已经编码了提示概念在时空维度上的定位信息这一特性；在冻结的VLM主干上训练一个轻量组合分类器，仅输入提示中实体对应token的交叉注意力图，预测组合关系的正确性；训练时采用视频版本的对偶反转技术，避免分类器利用注意力信号中的浅层文本痕迹（组合泄漏）；推理时仅在去噪的早期阶段，将分类器预测与目标组合标签的交叉熵损失的梯度反向传播到潜变量，引导去噪过程向符合组合约束的方向更新，同时保留生成模型原有的视觉质量。
summary.experiments: 在组合性文本生成视频基准上测试，CVG在组合保真度指标上同时优于基础生成器和布局引导的TTOM基线，且不会破坏生成视频的原有视觉质量。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读方法部分中组合分类器的输入设计和对偶反转的实现逻辑，理解如何避免分类器直接读取组合token而不是从注意力中学习组合关系；查看实验部分中不同引导阶段对结果的影响消融；预计阅读时间15-20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 未公开明确机构信息

summary_en.core_problem: Existing text-to-video diffusion models perform poorly on prompts requiring fine-grained compositional understanding, failing to correctly generate compositional constraints such as relations between entities, attributes, actions, and motion directions. Existing methods to improve compositionality require retraining the generator, additional annotated data, or manually provided control signals, leading to high costs.
summary_en.importance: It proposes an inference-time control scheme that does not require modifying the backbone of text-to-video generation models, improving compositional faithfulness only by leveraging the model's own internal cross-attention signals, providing a low-cost general approach for inference-time alignment of multimodal generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The CVG framework is built on the observation that cross-attention maps inside text-to-video diffusion models already encode the spatiotemporal localization of prompt concepts. A lightweight compositional classifier is trained on top of a frozen VLM backbone, taking only cross-attention maps of entity tokens in the prompt as input to predict the correctness of compositional relations. A video version of dual inversion is adopted during training to prevent the classifier from exploiting superficial textual traces in attention signals (composition leakage). During inference, gradients of the cross-entropy loss between classifier predictions and target compositional labels are backpropagated to update latents only in early denoising steps, steering the denoising process to satisfy compositional constraints while preserving the original visual quality of the generator.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on compositional text-to-video benchmarks, CVG outperforms both base generators and the layout-guided TTOM baseline on compositional faithfulness metrics, without degrading the original visual quality of generated videos.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the input design of the compositional classifier and the implementation of dual inversion in the method section to understand how the classifier is prevented from directly reading composition tokens instead of learning compositional relations from attention. Review the ablation study on the impact of different guidance stages in the experiments section. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: No explicit institutional information available

recommendation.zh: 利用模型内部注意力信号做推理-time组合引导的思路对多模态生成有借鉴意义，核心观察（交叉注意力自带grounding）值得注意。看§3方法部分。
recommendation.en: The observation that cross-attention maps inherently encode spatial-temporal grounding is a useful insight for multimodal generation research. Read §3 (method) only.

paper.title: MechVerse: Evaluating Physical Motion Consistency in Video Generation Models
paper.abstract: Text- and image-conditioned video generation models have achieved strong visual fidelity and temporal coherence, but they often fail to generate motion governed by kinematic and geometric constraints. In these settings, object parts must remain rigid, maintain contact or coupling with neighboring components, and transfer motion consistently across connected parts. These requirements are especially explicit in articulated mechanical assemblies, where motion is constrained by rigid-link geometry,

summary.core_problem: 如何评测视频生成模型是否满足真实物理/机构学约束（刚体、接触/耦合、运动传递），而不仅是“看起来连贯”。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是Benchmark：把“物理一致性”具体化为机械装配的运动约束，提供可规模化的合成评测集，补足现有视频生成评测对运动真实性的弱监督。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MechVerse：面向机械装配的image-to-video评测基准，覆盖关节/连杆/耦合/传动链等约束；用“机构是否被破坏/耦合是否断裂/刚体是否形变/下游部件是否被带动”等失败类型来衡量模型的运动一致性缺口。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为21,156个合成clips，来自1,357个机械装配；对多种文生/图生视频模型做评测并展示其在运动约束上的系统性失败。摘要未给出具体模型列表与量化指标细节。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate whether video generation models obey physical/kinematic constraints (rigidity, contact/coupling, motion transmission) rather than merely producing visually plausible motion.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution: operationalizes motion consistency via articulated mechanical assemblies and provides a scalable synthetic testbed, addressing the weak coverage of physically-grounded motion in current video-gen evaluations.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces MechVerse, an image-to-video benchmark built around mechanical assemblies with explicit kinematic/geometric constraints; evaluates failures such as rigid parts deforming, broken coupling/contact, wrong motion type (rotate vs translate), and missing downstream motion propagation.
summary_en.experiments: 21,156 synthetic clips from 1,357 mechanical assemblies; evaluates multiple video generation models and reports systematic violations of mechanism constraints. The abstract does not specify exact model list/metrics.

recommendation.zh: 作为“物理一致性”评测靶子还算锋利，但对预训练方法没直接答案；只需记住这个benchmark可用来做视频tokenizer/训练目标的回归测试。
recommendation.en: A sharp target for physical-consistency evaluation, but it won’t teach you new pretraining tricks; keep it as a regression benchmark for video tokenizers/objectives.

paper.title: CreFlow: Corrective Reflow for Sparse-Reward Embodied Video Diffusion RL
paper.abstract: Video generation models trained on heterogeneous data with likelihood-surrogate objectives can produce visually plausible rollouts that violate physical constraints in embodied manipulation. Although reinforcement-learning post-training offers a natural route to adapting VGMs, existing video-RL rewards often reduce each rollout to a low-level visual metric, whereas manipulation video evaluation requires logic-based verification of whether the rollout satisfies a compositional task specification.

summary.core_problem: 现有具身视频生成的RL奖励仅用低层级视觉指标，无法验证生成视频是否满足组合化任务逻辑约束的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出基于时序逻辑的组合奖励与配套的在线RL矫正回流框架
summary.technical_approach: 将任务要求自动转化为线性时序逻辑约束的组合，提供可信奖励与局部错误定位；提出CreFlow在线RL框架，适配高维视频生成的奖励优化
summary.experiments: 在具身操纵视频生成任务上测试，未公布完整量化结果
summary.authors_note: 西北大学、UCSD、牛津大学联合团队，包含知名学者Philip Torr

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RL rewards for embodied video generation only use low-level visual metrics, cannot verify whether generated videos satisfy compositional task logic constraints
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes temporal-logic-based compositional reward and corresponding online RL corrective reflow framework
summary_en.technical_approach: Automatically formulate task requirements as composition of Linear Temporal Logic constraints, provide faithful rewards and localized error information; propose CreFlow online RL framework adapted for high-dimensional video generation reward optimization
summary_en.experiments: Test on embodied manipulation video generation tasks, full quantitative results not released
summary_en.authors_note: Joint team from Northwestern University, UCSD, University of Oxford, including well-known researcher Philip Torr

recommendation.zh: 具身视频生成的结构化奖励设计，时序逻辑约束的思路可作为RL后训练的参考，仅看奖励设计部分即可
recommendation.en: Structured reward design for embodied video generation, temporal logic constraint idea can be reference for RL post-training, only reward design section worth reading

paper.title: Head Forcing: Long Autoregressive Video Generation via Head Heterogeneity
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models support real-time synthesis but suffer from error accumulation and context loss over long horizons. We discover that attention heads in AR video diffusion transformers serve functionally distinct roles as local heads for detail refinement, anchor heads for structural stabilization, and memory heads for long-range context aggregation, yet existing methods treat them uniformly, leading to suboptimal KV cache allocation. We propose Head Forcing, a training-free

summary.core_problem: 自回归视频扩散模型生成长序列时存在误差累积、上下文丢失问题，现有方法对所有注意力头统一处理导致KV缓存分配不合理，限制生成长度。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次发现AR视频扩散Transformer注意力头的功能异质性，提出无额外训练的长序列生成优化框架。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Head Forcing框架，将注意力头划分为局部细节头、结构锚点头、长程记忆头三类，分别配置定制化KV缓存策略，记忆头采用分层动态更新的内存系统，同时增加头级RoPE重编码保证位置编码落在预训练范围内。
summary.experiments: 无需额外训练，将原模型生成时长从5秒提升至分钟级，支持多提示交互合成，效果保持稳定。
summary.authors_note: 西湖大学AGI实验室、加州大学默塞德分校团队，无公开知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Autoregressive video diffusion models suffer from error accumulation and context loss during long-sequence generation, existing methods treat all attention heads uniformly leading to suboptimal KV cache allocation, limiting generation length.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, first discovers functional heterogeneity of attention heads in AR video diffusion transformers, proposes a training-free long-sequence generation optimization framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Head Forcing framework, divides attention heads into three categories: local detail heads, structure anchor heads, long-range memory heads, assigns tailored KV cache strategies for each type, memory heads adopt hierarchical dynamic memory system, adds head-wise RoPE re-encoding to ensure positional encodings stay within pretrained range.
summary_en.experiments: Without extra training, extends generation duration from 5 seconds to minute level, supports multi-prompt interactive synthesis with stable performance.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Westlake University AGI Lab, University of California Merced, no public notable authors.

recommendation.zh: 注意力头功能异质性的观察有微弱参考价值，仅看头分类相关实验部分即可，无复现必要。
recommendation.en: The observation of attention head functional heterogeneity has weak reference value, only read head classification related experiments, no need to reproduce.
