paper.title: Towards Continuous Sign Language Conversation from Isolated Signs
paper.abstract: Sign language is the primary language for many Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing (DHH) signers, yet most conversational AI systems still mediate interaction through spoken or written language. This spoken-language-centered interface can limit access for signers for whom spoken or written language is not the most accessible medium, motivating direct sign-to-sign conversational modeling. However, sentence-level sign video data are expensive to collect and annotate, leaving existing sign translation and pro

summary.core_problem: 在句子级手语视频数据稀缺的情况下，构建可用于连续手语对话建模的数据和基线。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态数据构建和合成流程，目标是从孤立手语片段重组连续手语对话；对语音/视频语言建模中的离散动作单元和数据合成有一点参考，但领域较窄。
summary.technical_approach: 把大规模带标签的孤立手语片段视为词汇级动作原语，再根据现有对话语料中的话语顺序和手语语言顺序重组为连续手语 utterance；提出SignaVox-W作为大词汇孤立手语集合，SignaVox-U作为连续手语对话数据。
summary.experiments: 摘要称SignaVox-W是目前最大的带标签孤立手语词汇之一，并构建SignaVox-U用于连续对话；未给出具体词表规模、视频时长、模型参数量、基线和量化效果。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括Yonsei University和Emory University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds data and modeling resources for continuous sign-language conversation under the scarcity of sentence-level sign videos.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal data-construction and synthesis pipeline that recomposes isolated sign clips into continuous sign conversations. It has some relevance to discrete motion units and data synthesis for video-language modeling, but the domain is narrow.
summary_en.technical_approach: Large-scale labeled isolated sign clips are treated as lexically grounded motion primitives, then recomposed into sign-language-ordered utterances derived from existing dialogue corpora. The paper introduces SignaVox-W as a large isolated-sign vocabulary resource and SignaVox-U as a continuous sign-conversation dataset.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims that SignaVox-W provides one of the largest labeled isolated-sign vocabularies and that SignaVox-U supports continuous conversation modeling. It does not provide vocabulary size, video hours, model size, baselines, or quantitative gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Yonsei University and Emory University.

recommendation.zh: 可作为“动作原语重组生成序列数据”的案例备查；手语域太窄，缺少规模和评测细节。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a case of recomposing motion primitives into sequence data; the sign-language domain is narrow and the abstract lacks scale and evaluation details.

paper.title: A$^2$RD: Agentic Autoregressive Diffusion for Long Video Consistency
paper.abstract: Synthesizing consistent and coherent long video remains a fundamental challenge. Existing methods suffer from semantic drift and narrative collapse over long horizons. We present A$^2$RD, an Agentic Auto-Regressive Diffusion architecture that decouples creative synthesis from consistency enforcement. A$^2$RD formulates long video synthesis as a closed-loop process that synthesizes and self-improves video segment-by-segment through a Retrieve--Synthesize--Refine--Update cycle. It comprises three

summary.core_problem: 现有长视频生成方法遵循被动开环范式，在长时间尺度上存在两个核心问题：（1）时间一致性无法维持，实体/环境在跨段出现时发生漂移；（2）叙事连贯性崩溃，出现语义漂移和内容重复。逐帧自回归模型（FAR）的错误会无修正地传播；分段式模型（SAR）在段间难以保持一致性。同时现有基准缺乏实体/环境循环出现（消失再出现）和状态变化的真实复杂性。
summary.importance: 这是视频生成领域对自回归开环范式局限性的一次明确反思。论文将agentic闭环范式引入视频扩散建模，通过检索-合成-精炼-更新的循环来实现自我修正。对于LLM基座研究者而言，其启发在于：将长程生成从『一次性自回归』转向『闭环自我修正』是一个可能的范式迁移方向，这种思路原则上也可应用于超长文本生成等其他模态。此外，多模态记忆（MVMem）的设计对长上下文建模有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: A²RD将长视频生成形塑为一个闭环的agentic过程，无需额外训练（training-free），基于现有Text-Image-to-Video（TI2V）模型构建。三个核心组件：（1）多模态视频记忆（MVMem）——不仅存储视觉参考，还将每个视频段拆解为文本状态（Visual Arcs追踪实体特征及时空演化、Spatial Relations记录主-谓-宾三元组、Camera状态）+ 关键帧 + 原始视频段，实现跨模态的世界状态追踪。（2）自适应段生成——根据记忆中的上下文，自动在extrapolation（外推新内容）和interpolation（内插衔接）模式间切换，保证段间边界自然过渡。（3）分层测试时自我改进——在帧级别和视频级别对生成内容进行两轮自我精炼。整个系统形成Retrieve-Synthesize-Refine-Update循环：每生成一个新段时，从记忆中检索相关上下文→自适应合成→分层自我改进→更新记忆。此外还提出了LVbench-C基准，专门评测实体/环境循环出现（cyclic appearance）带状态变化的长程一致性。
summary.experiments: 实验在LVbench-C和多个公开基准上进行。A²RD仅通过2次自我改进迭代就在一致性和叙事连贯性上取得SOTA结果，人类评测也验证了这一结论。但具体的模型参数量、数据规模和量化提升幅度未在提供的文本中给出。值得注意的是，A²RD是training-free方案，其性能提升完全来自推理时的闭环架构设计，而非模型权重更新。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，重点关注第2节A²RD架构（特别是MVMem的多模态拆解设计和自适应生成模式切换），以及Figure 4的系统架构图。LVbench-C的设计思路（cyclic entity appearance with state evolution）对基准设计感兴趣的读者值得一看。预计阅读时间25-35分钟。
summary.authors_note: 未在提供的文本中明确标注作者和机构信息

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long video synthesis methods follow a passive open-loop paradigm, suffering from two core failures at scale: (1) temporal consistency breaks down, with entities/environments drifting across segments, and (2) narrative coherence collapses, leading to semantic drift and content repetition. Frame-autoregressive (FAR) models propagate errors uncorrected; segment-autoregressive (SAR) models fail to maintain inter-segment consistency. Additionally, existing benchmarks lack the realistic complexity of entities/environments appearing cyclically (disappearing and reappearing) with state changes.
summary_en.importance: This is an explicit rethinking of the open-loop autoregressive paradigm in video generation. The paper introduces an agentic closed-loop paradigm to video diffusion modeling via a Retrieve-Synthesize-Refine-Update cycle for self-correction. For LLM researchers, the insight is that shifting long-range generation from "one-shot autoregression" to "closed-loop self-improvement" represents a potential paradigm shift that could in principle apply to other modalities such as ultra-long text generation. The multimodal memory (MVMem) design also offers lessons for long-context modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: A²RD frames long video synthesis as a closed-loop agentic process. It is training-free, built atop existing Text-Image-to-Video (TI2V) models. Three core components: (1) Multimodal Video Memory (MVMem) — stores not just visual references but disentangles each segment into Textual States (Visual Arcs tracking entity features and their temporal evolution, Spatial Relations as subject-relation-object triplets, Camera states) + Key Frames + Raw Video, enabling cross-modal world state tracking. (2) Adaptive Segment Generation — automatically switches between extrapolation (generating new content) and interpolation (bridging segments) modes based on memory context for natural boundary transitions. (3) Hierarchical Test-Time Self-Improvement — two rounds of self-refinement at both frame and video levels. The full system forms a Retrieve-Synthesize-Refine-Update cycle. The paper also contributes LVbench-C, a benchmark for long-horizon consistency with cyclic entity appearance and optional state evolution.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on LVbench-C and multiple public benchmarks. A²RD achieves SOTA consistency and narrative coherence in just 2 self-improvement iterations, corroborated by human studies. Specific parameter counts, dataset sizes, and quantitative improvement margins are not provided in the available text. Notably, A²RD is training-free — all performance gains come from inference-time closed-loop architecture design, not weight updates.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommended. Focus on Section 2 (A²RD architecture, especially MVMem's multimodal decomposition design and adaptive mode switching) and Figure 4 (system architecture diagram). The LVbench-C design rationale (cyclic entity appearance with state evolution) is worthwhile for readers interested in benchmark design. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Author and institution information not explicitly stated in the provided text

recommendation.zh: Google的长视频生成工作，将agentic闭环与自回归扩散结合的思路对统一建模范式有一定参考价值，建议快速浏览方法部分。
recommendation.en: Google long video generation work. The agentic closed-loop + autoregressive diffusion combination is conceptually interesting for unified modeling paradigms; skim the method section.

paper.title: Not All Tokens Need 40 Steps: Heterogeneous Step Allocation in Diffusion Transformers for Efficient Video Generation
paper.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved state-of-the-art video generation quality, but they incur immense computational cost because standard inference applies the same number of denoising steps uniformly to every token in the sequence. It is well known that human vision ignores vast amounts of redundant motion. Why, then, do our densest models treat every spatiotemporal token with equal priority? In this paper, we introduce Heterogeneous Step Allocation (HSA), a training-free inference algo

summary.core_problem: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for video generation apply uniform denoising steps to all spatiotemporal tokens, wasting compute on redundant motion that human vision ignores.
summary.importance: Proposes the first training-free heterogeneous step allocation for video DiTs, enabling dynamic compute budgets per token while maintaining global context via KV-cache synchronization.
summary.technical_approach: Heterogeneous Step Allocation (HSA): assigns varying step budgets to spatiotemporal tokens based on velocity dynamics. Resolves sequence-length mismatch via KV-cache synchronization where active tokens attend to full sequence while inactive tokens are skipped. Uses cached Euler update for latent states of skipped tokens.
summary.experiments: Evaluated on video generation benchmarks. Training-free inference method that reduces compute while maintaining generation quality. KV-cache synchronization mechanism preserves global context.
summary.authors_note: Johns Hopkins University. Ernie Chu is a notable researcher in efficient computer vision.

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion Transformers for video generation waste compute by applying uniform denoising steps to all spatiotemporal tokens, even though much video content contains redundant motion.
summary_en.importance: First training-free heterogeneous step allocation approach for video diffusion transformers, enabling dynamic compute allocation per token while preserving global context via KV-cache synchronization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Heterogeneous Step Allocation (HSA) assigns varying denoising step budgets to spatiotemporal tokens based on velocity dynamics. KV-cache synchronization resolves sequence-length mismatches so active tokens attend to the full sequence while inactive tokens are bypassed. Cached Euler update advances latent states of skipped tokens without extra model evaluations.
summary_en.experiments: Training-free inference algorithm evaluated on video generation tasks. Reduces compute while maintaining generation quality through dynamic compute reallocation.
summary_en.authors_note: Johns Hopkins University. Ernie Chu is a recognized researcher in efficient computer vision and model acceleration.

recommendation.zh: 视频DiT的异构步数分配，KV-cache同步机制对LLM推理优化有微弱概念启发，但领域差异大，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Heterogeneous step allocation for video DiTs. The KV-cache synchronization mechanism has weak conceptual relevance for LLM inference optimization, but domain differences are substantial.

paper.title: Render, Don't Decode: Weight-Space World Models with Latent Structural Disentanglement
paper.abstract: Training world models on vast quantities of unlabelled videos is a critical step toward fully autonomous intelligence. However, the prevailing paradigm of encoding raw pixels into opaque latent spaces and relying on heavy decoders for reconstruction leaves these models computationally expensive and uninterpretable. We address this problem by introducing NOVA, a world modelling framework that represents the system state as the weights and biases of an auxiliary coordinate-based implicit neural re

summary.core_problem: 用更结构化、可渲染的潜表示替代视频世界模型中昂贵且不透明的像素解码器。
summary.importance: 贡献是世界模型表示形式的探索：把状态表示成辅助 INR 的权重和偏置，再解析渲染。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对 latent representation、视频 tokenizer 和可解释生成状态有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 NOVA，将系统状态编码为 coordinate-based implicit neural representation 的参数，而不是普通 opaque latent；图像通过解析渲染得到，从而移除重型 decoder。作者还声称可通过 action-matching objective 将其蒸馏为上下文相关的视频生成器，并在无辅助 loss 或 GAN loss 的情况下产生背景、前景等结构分解。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露模型参数量、视频数据规模、baseline 名称或具体指标提升。宣称优势包括紧凑性、可移植性、零样本超分辨率，以及对场景结构成分的无监督 disentanglement。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Manchester 和 University of Bristol。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper replaces heavy, opaque pixel decoders in video world models with a structured latent state that can be analytically rendered.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a representation proposal for world models: states are stored as the weights and biases of an auxiliary INR. It does not directly advance LLM pretraining, but it is adjacent to latent representation design, video tokenization, and interpretable generative state spaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: NOVA represents the system state as parameters of a coordinate-based implicit neural representation rather than a conventional opaque latent vector. Frames are produced by analytical rendering, removing the heavy decoder. The method can also be distilled into a context-dependent video generator with an action-matching objective, and the authors report structural disentanglement without auxiliary or adversarial losses.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not specify parameter count, video-data scale, baselines, or numerical gains. It claims compactness, portability, zero-shot super-resolution, and unsupervised disentanglement of background and foreground structure.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Manchester and the University of Bristol.

recommendation.zh: 想找视觉 latent/tokenizer 新表示可看方法部分；实验细节缺失，先当概念备查。
recommendation.en: Worth a method skim if you track visual latents or tokenizers; the missing experimental detail makes it a concept note for now.

paper.title: FaithfulFaces: Pose-Faithful Facial Identity Preservation for Text-to-Video Generation
paper.abstract: Identity-preserving text-to-video generation (IPT2V) empowers users to produce diverse and imaginative videos with consistent human facial identity. Despite recent progress, existing methods often suffer from significant identity distortion under large facial pose variations or facial occlusions. In this paper, we propose \textit{FaithfulFaces}, a pose-faithful facial identity preservation learning framework to improve IPT2V in complex dynamic scenes. The key of FaithfulFaces is a pose-shared id

summary.core_problem: 解决身份保持文本到视频生成中，人脸在大姿态变化和遮挡场景下容易发生身份漂移的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成方法与数据流程改进。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但涉及视频生成基础模型的条件控制、身份表征和高质量视频数据筛选，对统一多模态生成研究有边缘参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FaithfulFaces，一个姿态忠实的身份保持学习框架。核心是 pose-shared identity aligner：通过 pose-shared dictionary 对不同视角的人脸姿态进行细化和对齐，并加入姿态变化-身份不变约束；同时把单视角输入映射到带显式 Euler angle embedding 的全局人脸姿态表征，作为生成模型的姿态先验。
summary.experiments: 摘要称构建了一个包含大姿态变化与遮挡人脸的视频数据集，并在身份保持文本到视频生成任务上验证更好的身份一致性和姿态鲁棒性。摘要未给出底座视频模型、训练规模、数据量、baseline 数量或具体指标提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者机构包括 Nanyang Technological University、University of Science and Technology of China、Beijing Normal University；摘要信息不足以确认更具体团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles identity drift in identity-preserving text-to-video generation, especially under large facial pose changes and occlusions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a method and data-pipeline improvement for multimodal generation. It does not directly advance LLM pretraining, but its treatment of conditional control, identity representation, and curated video data is marginally useful for unified multimodal generation research.
summary_en.technical_approach: FaithfulFaces introduces a pose-faithful identity preservation framework. Its main component is a pose-shared identity aligner that refines and aligns facial poses across views via a pose-shared dictionary and a pose-variation identity-invariance constraint. It also maps single-view inputs into a global facial pose representation with explicit Euler angle embeddings to guide the video generator.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the authors curate a video dataset with large pose variation and facial occlusion, and evaluate identity consistency and pose robustness in identity-preserving T2V generation. It does not provide the base video model, training scale, dataset size, baseline list, or numerical improvements.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed affiliations include Nanyang Technological University, University of Science and Technology of China, and Beijing Normal University. The abstract does not provide enough information to identify a more specific lab lineage.

recommendation.zh: 只扫方法图和数据构造即可；身份-姿态解耦有参考价值，但这是 T2V 控制增量，不会改变预训练判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and data curation; the identity-pose factorization is useful, but this is an incremental T2V control paper, not a pretraining signal.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: AniMatrix: An Anime Video Generation Model that Thinks in Art, Not Physics
paper.abstract: Video generation models internalize physical realism as their prior. Anime deliberately violates physics: smears, impact frames, chibi shifts; and its thousands of coexisting artistic conventions yield no single "physics of anime" a model can absorb. Physics-biased models therefore flatten the artistry that defines the medium or collapse under its stylistic variance. We present AniMatrix, a video generation model that targets artistic rather than physical correctness through a dual-channel condi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般的视频生成质量问题，而是一个更具体也更难的问题：当目标域不是自然视频，而是故意违背物理规律、且内部风格分布高度离散的 anime 视频时，现有以“物理合理性”为隐式先验的视频扩散模型会系统性失效。全文反复强调，anime 的难点不只是风格化外观，而是“正确性定义”本身变了。自然视频里，模型只要学到稳定的物理与时序约束，很多样本会朝同一套规律收敛；anime 则没有统一物理法则，夸张变形、节奏停顿、冲击帧、Q 版切换、镜头语言和特效表达都可能是有意为之。于是，直接在通用视频模型上微调，会把这些表达压平；直接混入大量 anime 数据，又会因为风格差异过大、形变过强而训练早期崩掉。论文真正处理的是：如何把生成目标从“物理上像真”改成“制作上正确”，并让模型学会区分有意的艺术性变形与无意的结构性坏帧。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把“目标域先验不匹配”这个问题讲得很清楚：不是所有视频生成都该沿用自然视频学到的物理 prior。这个判断对更广义的基座建模有启发，尤其是当训练分布包含漫画、动画、游戏过场、UI 交互视频、合成世界等非自然数据时，单一 realism objective 可能并不合适。第二，它提出的解决路径不是简单加数据或加控制，而是先重写 supervision 的组织方式，再设计 curriculum 去跨越 prior gap，最后用偏好优化重建质量判据。这种“三段式迁移”对 domain-shift 下的预训练很有参考价值。第三，论文把 caption 从“描述可见内容”改成“表达制作决策”，这与近年预训练里从 surface description 走向 latent factors / process supervision 的趋势一致。贡献量级上，它更像是一个面向特殊生成域的系统性训练框架，而不是单点算法突破；但如果全文实验确实支撑其三步闭环有效，那么它对 stylized video pretrain、统一多模态生成中的 domain-specific objective 设计，会有持续参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法的主线很清楚：先定义 anime 生成里什么叫“对”，再让模型逐步摆脱物理先验，最后建立新的优劣判别标准。

第一部分是 Production Knowledge System。作者认为 anime 数据自身过于多样，不能指望模型从原始像素里自动归纳出稳定的艺术先验，所以先人为提供一个结构化中介。这个系统至少包含两层：一层是工业化制作 taxonomy，把片段分解到 Style、Motion、Camera、VFX 四个可控轴；另一层是 AniCaption，把视频片段转成更像导演指令的语言，而不是普通视频 caption。这里的关键不是“多写一点描述”，而是把监督信号从结果描述改成生产变量描述。论文还提到用 graph-based multimodal reasoning 辅助标注，说明它不是纯模板抽取，而是试图从画面、时序和语义关系里推断制作意图。配合 dual-channel conditioning，模型一边接收精确的生产控制，一边接收更开放的艺术意图，从而避免单一文本条件既要承担硬约束又要承担模糊风格表达的冲突。

第二部分是 progressive style-motion-deformation curriculum。这是全文最像训练方法创新的地方。作者把 anime 相对自然视频的偏离拆成三条轴：风格多样性、运动幅度、形变强度。直接把高形变、高风格方差样本混进训练，会让已有物理 prior 与目标分布冲突过大，出现早期 collapse。于是他们采用渐进式课程，让模型先在更接近物理、风格更收敛、形变更弱的子分布上适应，再逐步扩大到更极端的表达。这个设计比常见的按分辨率或噪声级别 curriculum 更贴近 domain gap 的来源。它隐含的判断是：anime 迁移的难点不是单一复杂度，而是多个偏离维度叠加后导致优化面骤变，因此需要分轴控制训练路径。

第三部分是 deformation-aware preference optimization。作者指出，标准视频指标如 FVD、CLIP score 会把“艺术性变形”和“坏掉的结构”都视作偏离自然分布，因此无法作为 anime 域的可靠质量信号。为此他们引入领域奖励模型，并做偏好优化，让模型学会在“允许变形”的前提下仍保持角色一致性、动作意图、镜头节奏和特效合理性。这里的价值不只在于加了 reward model，而在于 reward 的判别边界被重新定义：不是惩罚一切 physics violation，而是惩罚没有艺术意图支撑的失真。若全文给出了偏好数据构造、正负样本来源、以及 reward 与生成器联训或后训的细节，这部分会很值得细看。

与已有方法相比，AniSora 这类工作更多是在 physics-trained video backbone 上加控制模块；AnimeReward 则偏向用人类反馈做质量对齐。AniMatrix 的区别在于，它把问题前移到预训练目标和数据组织层面：控制、课程学习、偏好优化三者围绕同一个“artistic correctness”定义协同，而不是在原有 realism objective 上做局部修补。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段看，实验部分的完整数字没有展开到参数量、训练 token/frame 数、基座规模和全部指标表，因此这里能确认的是实验设计逻辑，而不是所有具体数值。论文至少会围绕三类问题做验证。

第一类是与通用视频模型或直接微调方案的对比。核心结论应当是：保留自然视频物理先验的模型，虽然时序更平滑，但会系统性压制 anime 中需要的夸张动作、冲击帧和风格切换；而 AniMatrix 在艺术表达完整性上更好。若正文有主观评测或专门的 anime 质量指标，重点看这些结果，而不是只看 FVD。

第二类是 curriculum 的消融。这里最关键的是证明三轴渐进训练确实缓解了 early collapse，而不是普通的数据排序也能做到。值得关注的证据包括：训练 loss 是否更稳定、样本复杂度提升时是否仍能保持角色结构、去掉 style/motion/deformation 任一轴后性能是否明显下降、直接混合训练是否出现模式坍塌或高频坏帧。若正文给出训练曲线、失败案例分布、不同阶段生成样例，这部分信息量会很高。

第三类是偏好优化与奖励模型的作用。需要看两点：一是 deformation-aware reward 是否比通用视频质量模型更能区分“有意夸张”和“结构崩坏”；二是加入偏好优化后，是否在不明显牺牲可控性的前提下提升了主观质量。若有 pairwise preference win rate、人工打分、或对不同形变强度样本的分层评测，这些都比单一平均分更有说服力。

摘要里提到 Production Knowledge System、AniCaption 和 dual-channel conditioning，因此实验大概率也会包含标注体系与条件接口的消融，例如：普通描述性 caption vs 导演指令式 caption、单通道文本条件 vs 双通道条件、是否使用图推理增强标注。若这些消融成立，才能说明性能提升来自“监督定义改变”，而不只是数据量增加。

由于当前可见全文片段没有给出明确参数规模、数据规模拆分、提升幅度和统计显著性，阅读时需要优先核对主表、消融表和附录中的训练配置，避免只凭定性样例下结论。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“问题定义—训练迁移—质量判据”三条线来读。

先看 Introduction 和方法总览图。重点不是看 anime 例子有多炫，而是确认作者如何论证“physics correctness 不再是合适目标”。如果这个论证站不住，后面的系统设计就会显得过度工程化。

然后精读 Production Knowledge System 相关章节。要看清四个 production axes 的定义是否互相独立、是否足够覆盖 anime 制作变量、标注流程里哪些是自动推断、哪些需要人工校正。AniCaption 的例子尤其值得看：它到底是在生成更长的 caption，还是在显式编码镜头、动作夸张、特效节奏等 latent production factors。若有标注一致性分析或 taxonomy 覆盖率统计，这部分很关键。

接着看 curriculum 章节和训练曲线。这里是全文最值得深挖的地方。重点关注：三轴课程是如何排序和调度的；样本难度如何量化；为什么要同时控制 style、motion、deformation，而不是只按形变强度排序；训练稳定性的证据是否充分。若有 collapse case study、梯度/损失分析、阶段切换策略，这些对预训练研究员最有价值。

再看 reward model 与 preference optimization。要确认奖励模型的训练数据从哪里来，偏好标注标准是什么，如何避免把“更像自然视频”误当成“更高质量 anime”。如果作者做了与 FVD、CLIP、通用 VLM judge 的相关性比较，这部分值得细看。

最后看失败案例和局限性。真正重要的问题包括：角色身份一致性在高形变下是否仍稳定；双通道条件是否会互相冲突；taxonomy 是否会限制开放生成；方法是否依赖高成本标注；能否迁移到漫画动态化、游戏过场、儿童动画等相邻域。完整读下来预计需要 60–90 分钟；若只抓主干，优先看方法图、课程学习消融、偏好优化评测和附录中的标注示例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a domain-mismatch problem in video generation: anime video is not just a stylized version of natural video, but a medium whose notion of correctness often departs from physical realism. Existing video diffusion models inherit a strong physics prior from natural video data, which helps on real-world motion but becomes a liability for anime. Exaggerated deformation, impact frames, chibi shifts, rhythmic holds, and director-driven camera/VFX choices are often intentional in anime, yet a physics-biased model tends to smooth them away or treat them as errors. Naively scaling anime data does not solve this either, because the domain is highly heterogeneous and lacks a single shared “law” analogous to real-world physics. The core problem, then, is how to redefine the training target from physical plausibility to artistic correctness, and how to train a model that can separate intentional stylization from genuine structural failure.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is broader than the anime setting. First, it makes a useful point about prior mismatch: a foundation video model trained under a realism objective may be systematically misaligned with domains whose structure is governed by production conventions rather than physical laws. That matters for stylized video, synthetic worlds, game footage, UI interaction video, and potentially multimodal generative models that mix natural and non-natural data. Second, the paper does not treat the issue as a simple fine-tuning problem. It proposes a full transition recipe: redefine supervision, bridge the prior gap with curriculum, then rebuild quality signals with domain-aware preference optimization. That is a meaningful template for domain adaptation under severe objective mismatch. Third, the move from descriptive captions to production-oriented directives is conceptually aligned with a larger trend in pretraining: replacing surface-level reconstruction targets with latent factor or process-level supervision. The contribution is less about a single algorithmic trick and more about a coherent training framework for a difficult target distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is organized around a three-step transition: define artistic correctness, progressively override the inherited physics prior, and then distinguish valid artistic deformation from failure.

The first component is the Production Knowledge System. The authors argue that raw anime data is too diverse for a stable implicit prior to emerge on its own, so they introduce structured supervision. This includes an industrial production taxonomy that factorizes clips along four controllable axes: Style, Motion, Camera, and VFX. On top of that, they build AniCaption, which is not a standard captioner describing visible content, but a system that infers production variables and verbalizes them as creator- or director-like instructions. This is an important shift. The conditioning signal is no longer “what is in the clip,” but “how the clip should be authored.” The paper also mentions graph-based multimodal reasoning in the annotation pipeline, suggesting that the labels are inferred from relations across frames, semantics, and visual cues rather than extracted from a flat template. A dual-channel conditioning interface then separates precise production control from more flexible artistic intent, which likely reduces the burden on a single text channel to encode both hard constraints and soft style cues.

The second component is a progressive style-motion-deformation curriculum. This appears to be the main training innovation. The gap between natural-video priors and extreme anime expression is decomposed into three axes: style diversity, motion amplitude, and deformation intensity. Instead of mixing all anime samples at once, which the authors claim leads to early collapse, training proceeds through a controlled schedule that gradually increases difficulty along these axes. The rationale is strong: the optimization difficulty is not just “harder samples,” but a compounded mismatch across multiple dimensions that each break the original prior in a different way. A curriculum aligned with the source of domain shift is more principled than generic curricula based only on resolution or noise level.

The third component is deformation-aware preference optimization. Standard metrics such as FVD or CLIP-based similarity are poorly suited here because both intentional stylization and pathological corruption can look like deviations from natural video statistics. The paper therefore introduces a domain-specific reward model and uses preference optimization to teach the generator what counts as good anime deformation versus broken structure. The key idea is not merely adding a reward model, but redefining the reward boundary itself: physics violations are not uniformly bad; unsupported distortions are. If the full paper provides details on preference data construction, positive/negative pair generation, and how the reward model is integrated into training, that section is likely one of the most informative parts.

Compared with prior anime-generation work that mainly adds control modules or post-hoc alignment on top of physics-trained backbones, AniMatrix seems to intervene earlier, at the level of supervision design and optimization trajectory. Control, curriculum, and preference learning are all tied to the same target notion of artistic correctness.
summary_en.experiments:
The visible full-text excerpt does not include the complete experimental tables, so the strongest conclusions here are about evaluation design rather than all exact numbers. The paper is clearly set up to validate three claims.

First, it should compare against general-purpose video models or straightforward anime fine-tuning baselines. The expected result is that physics-biased models produce smoother but artistically flattened motion, while AniMatrix better preserves exaggerated action, impact framing, and style-specific expression. For this paper, subjective evaluation and domain-specific quality judgments matter more than generic video metrics alone.

Second, the curriculum should be tested through ablations. This is likely the most important experimental section. The paper needs to show that the three-axis curriculum specifically reduces early collapse, rather than any sample ordering giving similar gains. Useful evidence would include more stable training curves, better structural consistency as sample difficulty increases, and clear degradation when removing style, motion, or deformation progression. Direct mixed training should ideally show collapse modes or severe artifact rates.

Third, the reward model and preference optimization need to demonstrate that they can distinguish intentional exaggeration from failure better than generic metrics or judges. The most convincing evidence would be pairwise preference win rates, human evaluation, or stratified analysis across different deformation intensities. It is also important to check whether preference optimization improves quality without hurting controllability.

Given the emphasis on the Production Knowledge System, AniCaption, and dual-channel conditioning, the paper likely includes supervision ablations as well: descriptive captions versus production-oriented directives, single-channel versus dual-channel conditioning, and possibly the effect of graph-based multimodal reasoning in annotation. Those ablations are essential, because otherwise gains could be attributed simply to more annotation effort or more data.

Since the excerpt does not expose model size, training scale, or exact deltas, those details should be verified directly in the main tables and appendix before drawing strong conclusions.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it along three threads: problem formulation, optimization path, and evaluation criterion.

Start with the introduction and the overview figure. The key question is whether the paper convincingly argues that physical realism is the wrong target for anime generation. If that argument is weak, the rest may look like a heavily engineered domain-specific stack.

Then focus on the Production Knowledge System. Check whether the four production axes are well defined, reasonably disentangled, and broad enough to cover anime production choices. AniCaption deserves close attention: is it merely a richer captioner, or does it explicitly encode latent production factors such as camera intent, deformation style, timing, and VFX rhythm? Any annotation examples, taxonomy coverage statistics, or inter-annotator consistency analysis are worth reading carefully.

Next, spend time on the curriculum section and the associated training curves. This is probably the most valuable part for a pretraining researcher. Look for how difficulty is quantified, how the three axes are scheduled, why all three are needed, and what evidence is provided for improved stability. If the paper includes collapse case studies, loss/gradient behavior, or stage-transition heuristics, that is where much of the practical insight will be.

After that, read the reward model and preference optimization section. The main question is whether the reward signal truly reflects anime quality rather than natural-video realism in disguise. Comparisons against FVD, CLIP-based metrics, or generic VLM judges would be especially informative.

Finally, inspect the failure cases and limitations. Important questions include identity consistency under strong deformation, possible conflicts between the two conditioning channels, whether the taxonomy constrains open-ended generation, and how annotation-heavy the pipeline is. A full careful read is likely a 60–90 minute paper; for a targeted pass, prioritize the method overview, curriculum ablations, preference evaluation, and annotation examples in the appendix.

recommendation.zh: 可看 conditioning 设计，尤其结构化制作标签如何覆盖视频模型先验；预训练方法论收获有限。
recommendation.en: Worth checking for the conditioning design, especially how structured production tags override video priors; limited pretraining-method insight.

paper.title: RoboAlign-R1: Distilled Multimodal Reward Alignment for Robot Video World Models
paper.abstract: Existing robot video world models are typically trained with low-level objectives such as reconstruction and perceptual similarity, which are poorly aligned with the capabilities that matter most for robot decision making, including instruction following, manipulation success, and physical plausibility. They also suffer from error accumulation in long-horizon autoregressive prediction. We present RoboAlign-R1, a framework that combines reward-aligned post-training with stabilized long-horizon in

summary.core_problem: 现有机器人视频世界模型多采用重建、感知相似度等低层目标训练，与机器人决策所需的指令遵循、操作成功、物理合理性等高阶能力不匹配，同时自回归预测在长时序场景下存在误差累积问题。
summary.importance: 将大模型领域的奖励对齐范式迁移到机器人世界模型训练中，打通了多模态奖励蒸馏、对齐训练、推理稳定性优化的完整链路，对通用具身智能的统一预训练、多模态对齐方法有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出RoboAlign-R1框架，分为两部分：1）奖励对齐训练：构建包含1万条标注视频-指令对的RobotWorldBench基准，训练8B参数的多模态教师判分模型RoboAlign-Judge提供6维细粒度生成视频评估，再蒸馏为98M参数的轻量学生奖励模型，支撑高效RL后训练，替代原有低层损失目标；2）长时序推理稳定性优化：提出无需训练的滑动窗口重编码（SWR）策略，在生成过程中定期刷新自回归上下文，缓解误差累积。
summary.experiments: 相比最优基线，域内评估综合性能提升10.1%，在线奖励计算开销降低10倍以上，结果同时通过VLM评估和盲测人类研究验证。滑动窗口重编码仅引入1%的额外延迟，带来SSIM提升2.8%、PSNR提升0.62dB、LPIPS降低9.8%，感兴趣区域LPIPS降低12.2%。
summary.reading_guide: 精读第3节方法细节、第4节实验结果，重点关注图1的框架架构、表2的消融实验结果、附录的奖励蒸馏实现细节。值得深挖的点包括多模态奖励蒸馏的成本-精度tradeoff、滑动窗口重编码策略对通用自回归长序列生成的可迁移性、具身模型对齐与LLM对齐范式的共性差异。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing robot video world models are mostly trained with low-level objectives like reconstruction and perceptual similarity, which mismatch high-level capabilities required for robot decision making including instruction following, manipulation success and physical plausibility. Autoregressive prediction also suffers from error accumulation in long-horizon scenarios.
summary_en.importance: It migrates the reward alignment paradigm from LLM domain to robot world model training, completing the full pipeline of multimodal reward distillation, alignment training and inference stability optimization. It provides direct reference for unified pre-training of general embodied intelligence and multimodal alignment methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: The RoboAlign-R1 framework includes two modules: 1) Reward-aligned training: Construct RobotWorldBench, a benchmark with 10K annotated video-instruction pairs, train an 8B-parameter multimodal teacher judge RoboAlign-Judge to provide 6-dimensional fine-grained evaluation of generated videos, then distill it into a 98M-parameter lightweight student reward model to support efficient RL post-training, replacing original low-level loss objectives. 2) Long-horizon inference stability optimization: Propose a training-free sliding window re-encoding (SWR) strategy, which periodically refreshes autoregressive context during generation to mitigate error accumulation.
summary_en.experiments: Compared with the strongest baseline, aggregate in-domain evaluation performance improves by 10.1%, online reward computation overhead reduces by over 10x, results are validated by both VLM-based evaluation and blinded human studies. SWR introduces only 1% extra latency, bringing 2.8% higher SSIM, 0.62dB higher PSNR, 9.8% lower LPIPS, and 12.2% lower ROI-LPIPS.
summary_en.reading_guide: Intensively read Section 3 (method details) and Section 4 (experimental results). Focus on the framework architecture in Figure 1, ablation study results in Table 2, and reward distillation implementation details in the appendix. Worth further exploring points include the cost-accuracy tradeoff of multimodal reward distillation, transferability of SWR strategy to general autoregressive long-sequence generation, and similarities and differences between embodied model alignment and LLM alignment paradigms.

recommendation.zh: 只看奖励建模和滑窗重编码；机器人设定偏窄，但对生成式世界模型的 post-train 接口有参考。
recommendation.en: Skim the reward-modeling and sliding-window re-encoding parts; the robotics setup is narrow, but the post-train interface for generative world models is useful.

paper.title: A Benchmark for Interactive World Models with a Unified Action Generation Framework
paper.abstract: Achieving Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) requires agents that learn and interact adaptively, with interactive world models providing scalable environments for perception, reasoning, and action. Yet current research still lacks large-scale datasets and unified benchmarks to evaluate their physical interaction capabilities. To address this, we propose iWorld-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for training and testing world models on interaction-related abilities such as distance perception an

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是 interactive world model 缺少统一、可比、覆盖面足够广的评测框架，尤其是不同模型使用的动作输入形式不一致，导致“交互能力”很难公平比较。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接推动有限，但对 world model 方向有现实价值。它把评测对象从一般视频生成拉回到“动作条件下的环境响应”，并把数据、动作表示、任务设计和指标放到同一框架里。对于做统一视频/世界模型预训练的人，这篇工作的启发主要在两点：一是动作空间的标准化会影响模型比较与训练接口设计；二是 memory 与 action-following 需要单独测，不能只看视觉质量。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上主要是 benchmark engineering，而不是新的 world model 架构。作者先清洗并标准化 12 个高质量数据集的坐标系和相机内外参，又从 4 个模拟器的 18 个环境自动采集并筛选 10 万段 1080P 视频，最终得到 33 万段视频的数据池。然后提出一个统一的 Action Generation Framework，用 modality-agnostic 的方式编码动作，把不同模型常见的文本命令、键盘输入、连续轨迹等控制形式映射到同一个动作字典中，定义了 81 个基础运动动作。在此基础上设计 6 类交互任务轨迹，并加入带逻辑一致性的 memory 任务。评测时从 33 万视频中挑出 2100 个高质量样本，构造 4900 个任务，用 9 个指标从视觉质量、动作跟随、记忆能力三方面评估 14 个现有模型。
summary.experiments: 实验重点不是提出新模型，而是系统评测。可确认的规模包括：33 万视频数据池、2100 个评测视频、4900 个任务、14 个 interactive world models、9 个指标。模型覆盖 5 个文本控制世界生成模型、2 个 one-hot 动作编码模型、7 个基于相机内外参控制的模型。论文的主要结果应当是不同动作接口下模型能力差异明显，且视觉质量好不代表动作响应或记忆能力强；同时，任务难度和 memory 设计能拉开模型差距。阅读时要重点看各类任务上的排名是否稳定、不同指标之间是否冲突，以及统一动作框架是否真的减少了比较偏差。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看三部分：数据构建流程图、Action Generation Framework 定义、以及主评测表。先确认动作统一映射是否严谨，再看 6 类任务是否覆盖了交互世界模型的核心能力，最后看 9 个指标里哪些真正有区分度。若只想抓要点，30 分钟左右足够。若你关心 world model 训练接口，可以再看附录里关于坐标系统一、动作编码细节和人工标注难度分级的说明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a benchmarking gap for interactive world models: current models use heterogeneous action interfaces, datasets are fragmented, and there is no unified evaluation setup that can fairly compare interaction capability across modalities.
summary_en.importance: Its direct impact on language-model pretraining is limited, but it is useful for the world-model stack around foundation models. The main value is practical: it standardizes action-conditioned evaluation rather than treating world models as generic video generators. For pretraining researchers, the useful takeaway is that action representation is part of the model interface, and that visual fidelity alone is not enough; action following and memory need to be measured separately.
summary_en.technical_approach: This is primarily a benchmark and evaluation framework, not a new model architecture. The authors standardize 12 existing datasets by unifying coordinate systems and camera parameters, and also collect 100k 1080P clips from 18 environments across 4 simulators. The resulting pool contains 330k video clips. They then introduce an Action Generation Framework that maps heterogeneous control modalities—text commands, keyboard inputs, continuous trajectories, and related formats—into a modality-agnostic action dictionary with 81 basic motion actions. On top of this interface, they design six task types with varying difficulty, including memory-oriented tasks. For evaluation, they select 2,100 high-quality videos and build 4,900 tasks, then assess 14 interactive world models using 9 metrics covering visual quality, action following, and memory.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental contribution is a broad evaluation rather than a new performance claim. The confirmed scale is substantial: a 330k-clip data pool, 2,100 benchmark videos, 4,900 tasks, 14 evaluated models, and 9 metrics. The evaluated systems include 5 text-controlled world generation models, 2 one-hot action encoding models, and 7 models controlled by camera parameters. The main empirical value is likely in showing that model rankings depend strongly on which capability is measured: strong visual quality does not necessarily imply good action responsiveness or memory. When reading, focus on whether rankings are stable across task types, whether the metrics disagree in meaningful ways, and whether the unified action framework actually reduces comparison bias.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough for most readers. Prioritize three parts: the dataset construction pipeline, the definition of the Action Generation Framework, and the main evaluation tables. First check whether the action unification is principled rather than ad hoc. Then see whether the six task types cover the core abilities expected from interactive world models. Finally, inspect which of the nine metrics are actually discriminative. A focused read should take about 30 minutes. If you care about training interfaces for world models, the appendix sections on coordinate normalization, action encoding details, and human-assisted difficulty labeling are worth an extra pass.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 benchmark design 和 14 模型失败模式；它更像 world-model 评测基建，不会直接改变预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Skim the benchmark design and failure modes across 14 models; this is world-model evaluation infrastructure, not something that directly changes a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Stream-R1: Reliability-Perplexity Aware Reward Distillation for Streaming Video Generation
paper.abstract: Distillation-based acceleration has become foundational for making autoregressive streaming video diffusion models practical, with distribution matching distillation (DMD) as the de facto choice. Existing methods, however, train the student to match the teacher's output indiscriminately, treating every rollout, frame, and pixel as equally reliable supervision. We argue that this caps distilled quality, since it overlooks two complementary axes of variance in DMD supervision: Inter-Reliability ac

summary.core_problem: 解决自回归流式视频 diffusion 模型蒸馏时，学生模型把所有 teacher rollout、帧和像素等权学习，导致低质量或低收益监督被同等放大的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是视频生成蒸馏目标的训练信号重加权。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对 diffusion/AR 混合生成模型里的 reward shaping、teacher-student 信号质量控制有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Stream-R1，一个 Reliability-Perplexity Aware Reward Distillation 框架。在 DMD 蒸馏中同时建模两个维度：rollout 级别的 inter-reliability，用来判断是否该从某次学生 rollout 学；帧、空间区域级别的 intra-perplexity，用来判断优化应该集中在哪里。核心是对蒸馏 loss 做自适应重加权，而不是均匀匹配 teacher 输出。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据、视频分辨率、采样步数或提升幅度；只说明目标场景是自回归流式视频 diffusion 模型的蒸馏加速，并与 DMD 式均匀监督形成对比。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Science and Technology of China、FrameX.AI 和独立研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a weakness in distilling autoregressive streaming video diffusion models: the student learns from all teacher rollouts, frames, and pixels with uniform weight, even when supervision quality and improvement potential vary.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-signal reweighting method for video-generation distillation. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to reward shaping and teacher-student signal quality in diffusion or AR-diffusion generation systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Stream-R1 introduces Reliability-Perplexity Aware Reward Distillation. It separates two axes of variance in DMD supervision: inter-reliability across student rollouts, deciding whether a rollout should be trusted, and intra-perplexity across spatial regions and temporal frames, deciding where optimization should focus. The main change is adaptive weighting of the distillation objective instead of uniform teacher-output matching.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes, datasets, video resolutions, sampling steps, or numerical gains. It positions the method against standard DMD-style uniform supervision for accelerating autoregressive streaming video diffusion models.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Science and Technology of China, FrameX.AI, and independent research.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 预训练论文；若在做 diffusion 蒸馏，只看 loss weighting 设计，别把视频指标外推到语言建模。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM pretraining paper; if you work on diffusion distillation, inspect the loss-weighting design, but do not extrapolate video metrics to language modeling.

paper.title: Motion-Aware Caching for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video generation paradigms offer theoretical promise for long video synthesis, yet their practical deployment is hindered by the computational burden of sequential iterative denoising. While cache reuse strategies can accelerate generation by skipping redundant denoising steps, existing methods rely on coarse-grained chunk-level skipping that fails to capture fine-grained pixel dynamics. This oversight is critical: pixels with high motion require more denoising steps to prevent er

summary.core_problem: 在自回归（chunk-wise）视频扩散生成里，推理时间主要被“每个 chunk 仍要做很多步迭代去噪”拖住。已有 cache/skip 方法要么面向非自回归 DiT、要么只能做 chunk 级二值跳步，忽略了同一 chunk 内不同帧/不同空间位置的运动差异，导致要么加速不够、要么高运动区域误差累积引发时序崩坏。论文要解决的是：在不引入显著额外显存的前提下，如何做细粒度（token/pixel 级）自适应缓存复用，让高运动区域多算、静态区域多跳，从而稳定加速 AR 视频扩散推理。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏“推理加速/缓存策略”，不是预训练方法论文；但它对做统一生成范式（AR+diffusion、chunk-wise 长视频）的人有参考价值：1）把“缓存误差”与“残差/速度场的稳定性”联系起来，给了一个可操作的判据；2）指出 AR chunk 设定下的两个结构性现象：跨 chunk 的时间冗余不均匀（heterogeneous temporal redundancy）以及 chunk 内帧差异（intra-chunk frame discrepancy），解释了为什么 chunk 级跳步会失效；3）用极轻量的运动代理（帧差）驱动 token 级算力分配，属于工程上可落地的加速路径。对预训练研究的直接影响有限，但对“长序列生成的训练-推理接口”（训练用 CDF/AR，推理要可承受）有间接价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 MotionCache：
1）误差分析：把 step-level residual caching 的近似误差上界与“残差不稳定性（residual instability）”绑定，强调误差不是均匀扩散的，而是会在不稳定区域累积并放大。
2）运动-误差的桥：证明/论证 chunk 内相邻帧差（frame difference）可作为缓存误差的上界或高相关代理，从而把“该不该重算”转化为“该 token 的运动强不强”。这一步的关键取舍是：不用光流/额外网络，避免引入额外推理成本与系统复杂度。
3）分层推理日程（coarse-to-fine schedule）：先做结构 warm-up（前若干步不激进跳步）以锁定全局结构与低频一致性；随后进入 token-wise 自适应阶段。
4）token 重要性与累计策略：为每个空间 token 计算 motion-aware importance（由帧差得到），并用加权的 token accumulation policy 决定哪些 token 在当前去噪步需要更新、哪些直接复用缓存 residual。直观上是“高运动区域更频繁刷新缓存，静态背景更激进复用”。
5）与已有方法差异：相对 FlowCache 的 chunk 级二值跳步，MotionCache 在 chunk 内做空间/帧级细粒度；相对 layer-level caching，保持 step-level 的低显存特性；相对通用 DiT 加速方法，显式适配 AR chunk + KV cache 的生成形态。
summary.experiments:
文中给了两个代表性 AR 视频生成模型上的加速与质量对比：
- SkyReels-V2：报告最高约 7.26× 加速，同时保持更好的视觉保真与时序一致性（相对基线与现有 cache/skip 方法）。引言里还给了未加速时的量级：A800、bs=1，生成 7 秒、540×540 约需 27 分钟，说明痛点主要在推理步数与时空注意力成本。
- MAGI-1：约 2.07× 加速，并同样强调质量保持。
摘要/引言层面能确认的硬数字主要是上述 speedup；更细的质量指标（如 FVD、CLIP-score、用户偏好、时序一致性度量）与消融（warm-up 长度、importance 计算、阈值/预算策略、不同噪声步调度）需要看实验章节与表格/附录才能完整复述。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对 AR chunk 设定的两类结构性问题（heterogeneous temporal redundancy / intra-chunk frame discrepancy），这是它区别于“普通 DiT 加速”的关键动机。
- 再看理论部分关于“缓存误差 ≤ 残差不稳定性”以及“帧差作为误差上界/代理”的推导，理解它为什么敢用极轻量信号做 token 级决策。
- 最后看方法章节的 coarse-to-fine schedule：warm-up 的必要性、token accumulation policy 的具体形式（如何从 motion importance 变成更新掩码/预算）。
- 实验部分重点核对：不同运动强度场景下的失败案例、与 FlowCache 的对比、以及在不同分辨率/时长/步数设置下 speedup-质量曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: Autoregressive (chunk-wise) diffusion video generators still require many iterative denoising steps per chunk, making inference prohibitively slow. Existing caching/skip methods either target non-AR DiT setups or apply coarse chunk-level binary skipping, ignoring intra-chunk heterogeneity: high-motion regions need more updates to avoid error accumulation, while static regions can be aggressively reused. The paper addresses how to design a fine-grained, motion-adaptive caching policy (token/pixel-level) for AR video diffusion that accelerates inference without blowing up memory or destabilizing temporal coherence.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-acceleration paper rather than a pretraining-method contribution. Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect but practical for teams building AR+diffusion long-video systems: (1) it provides a stability-oriented lens—bounding caching approximation error via residual/velocity-field instability; (2) it highlights two AR-specific structural issues (heterogeneous temporal redundancy across chunks and intra-chunk frame discrepancy) explaining why chunk-level skipping underperforms; (3) it proposes a lightweight motion proxy (frame differences) to allocate compute at token granularity, aligning the training-time AR chunking design with a feasible inference-time budget.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MotionCache combines a theoretical motivation with a coarse-to-fine inference schedule:
1) Error bound: analyzes step-level residual caching and links approximation error to “residual instability”, emphasizing that errors amplify in unstable regions.
2) Motion proxy: argues/proves that intra-chunk frame differences upper-bound or strongly correlate with caching error, enabling motion-aware token importance without optical flow or extra networks.
3) Coarse-to-fine schedule: a warm-up phase computes early denoising steps more faithfully to lock global structure; later steps switch to token-wise adaptive reuse.
4) Token-wise adaptive policy: computes per-token motion importance and applies a weighted token accumulation/update rule—high-motion tokens are recomputed more often, static background tokens reuse cached residuals more aggressively.
5) Positioning vs prior work: finer than FlowCache’s chunk-level binary skipping; retains step-level caching’s low-memory profile compared to layer-level caching; explicitly tailored to AR chunk generation with KV cache rather than generic DiT acceleration.
summary_en.experiments:
Reported headline speedups on two AR video generators:
- SkyReels-V2: up to ~7.26× speedup while maintaining better visual fidelity and temporal coherence than baselines/previous caching methods. The introduction quantifies the baseline pain point: on an A800 with batch size 1, generating a 7-second 540×540 video takes ~27 minutes.
- MAGI-1: ~2.07× speedup with quality preservation.
The provided excerpt confirms speedup numbers; detailed quality metrics (e.g., FVD or other temporal-consistency measures), ablations (warm-up length, importance computation, thresholds/budgets, step schedules), and failure-case analysis should be taken from the main experiment section/tables.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the AR-specific motivation: heterogeneous temporal redundancy and intra-chunk frame discrepancy.
- Focus on the theory that ties caching error to residual instability, and why frame difference is a justified proxy.
- Study the method section describing the coarse-to-fine schedule (why warm-up is needed) and the exact token accumulation/update rule.
- In experiments, prioritize speedup–quality tradeoff curves, comparisons against FlowCache, and robustness across motion intensity, resolution, and video length.

recommendation.zh: 读误差分析和速度-质量曲线即可；这不是 pretrain 方法，但对长序列生成里的 cache 复用边界有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Skim the error analysis and speed-quality curves; this is not a pretraining method, but it is useful for thinking about cache reuse limits in long-sequence generation.

paper.title: Mamoda2.5: Enhancing Unified Multimodal Model with DiT-MoE
paper.abstract: We present Mamoda2.5, a unified AR-Diffusion framework that seamlessly integrates multimodal understanding and generation within a single architecture. To efficiently enhance the model's generation capability, we equip the Diffusion Transformer backbone with a fine-grained Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) design (128 experts, Top-8 routing), yielding a 25B-parameter model that activates only 3B parameters, significantly reducing training costs while scaling up the model capacity. Mamoda2.5 achieves top-

summary.core_problem: 统一多模态生成模型中，Diffusion Transformer（DiT）架构随参数规模、视频分辨率及时长提升计算成本爆炸式增长，同时现有开源统一模型在视频编辑场景性能和效率均不足。
summary.importance: 验证了细粒度MoE架构在统一AR+Diffusion多模态预训练中的可行性，为大参数规模的低成本扩缩提供可复用的实践方案，兼顾多任务能力和效率。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Mamoda2.5统一AR-Diffusion框架，视觉生成器采用128专家、Top-8路由的细粒度DiT-MoE架构，总参数量25B，单步前向仅激活3B参数，配合4×16×16高压缩率VAE降低token量，同时引入少步蒸馏加强化学习联合策略压缩推理步数，单模型支持图文理解/文生图/文生视频/图像编辑/视频编辑/多模态理解全能力。
summary.experiments: VBench 2.0上达到第一梯队生成性能，OpenVE-Bench视频编辑指标超过所有测评开源模型，对齐可灵O1性能，视频编辑推理速度比同类基线快12倍，经少步蒸馏后压缩为4步无CFG版本，步数减少7.5倍，额外节省约2倍CFG开销。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看MoE架构设计和蒸馏策略部分，预计阅读时间20分钟，无需关注具体训练数据配比，重点参考细粒度MoE在视频生成场景的路由设计和效率收益。

summary_en.core_problem: For unified multimodal generation models, the computational cost of Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture explodes as parameter scale, video resolution and duration increase, while existing open-source unified models have insufficient performance and efficiency in video editing scenarios.
summary_en.importance: It verifies the feasibility of fine-grained MoE architecture in unified AR+Diffusion multimodal pre-training, provides a reusable practice scheme for low-cost scaling of large parameter scales, and balances multi-task capability and efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Mamoda2.5 unified AR-Diffusion framework is proposed. The visual generator adopts a fine-grained DiT-MoE architecture with 128 experts and Top-8 routing, with 25B total parameters and only 3B parameters activated per forward pass. It is paired with a 4×16×16 high-compression VAE to reduce token count. A joint few-step distillation and reinforcement learning strategy is introduced to compress inference steps. The single model supports full capabilities including text-image understanding, text-to-image, text-to-video, image editing, video editing and multimodal understanding.
summary_en.experiments: It achieves top-tier generation performance on VBench 2.0. Its video editing metric on OpenVE-Bench outperforms all evaluated open-source models and matches Kling O1 performance. Video editing inference speed is 12× faster than comparable baselines. After few-step distillation, it is compressed to a 4-step CFG-free version, step count reduced by 7.5×, with an additional ~2× CFG overhead saving.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on MoE architecture design and distillation strategy sections. Estimated reading time is 20 minutes. No need to pay attention to specific training data ratio, focus on the routing design and efficiency benefits of fine-grained MoE in video generation scenarios.

recommendation.zh: 值得看架构和 ablation：DiT-MoE 是否真能让 AR+diffusion 统一模型按 active 参数扩展，是关键问题。
recommendation.en: Read the architecture and ablations: the key question is whether DiT-MoE makes unified AR+diffusion scale with active rather than total parameters.

paper.title: Embody4D: A Generalist 4D World Model for Embodied AI
paper.abstract: World models have made significant progress in modeling dynamic environments; however, most embodied world models are still restricted to 2D representations, lacking the comprehensive multi-view information essential for embodied spatial reasoning. Bridging this gap is non-trivial, primarily due to challenges from severe scarcity of paired multi-view data, the difficulty of maintaining spatiotemporal consistency in generated 3D geometries, and the tendency to hallucinate manipulation details. To

summary.core_problem: 解决具身AI世界模型只建模2D动态画面、缺少多视角4D空间一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成世界模型和数据合成管线；对预训练研究的间接价值在于如何用合成数据和几何约束补齐稀缺的多视角交互数据。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Embody4D，一个面向具身场景的视频到视频世界模型，可从单目视频合成任意新视角。方法包括3D-aware compositional synthesis，用不同机械臂和背景组合构造异构数据；再用adaptive noise injection约束时空几何稳定，减少操作细节幻觉。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量、baseline和具体指标；声称能在跨具身形态的机器人场景中提升泛化，并保持生成3D几何的时空一致性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自浙江大学、中国科学技术大学、中国科学院自动化所、北京航空航天大学等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of multi-view 4D spatial consistency in embodied world models that mostly operate in 2D video space.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a generative embodied world model and synthetic data pipeline. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is how synthetic composition and geometric constraints are used when paired multi-view interaction data is scarce.
summary_en.technical_approach: Embody4D is a video-to-video world model that synthesizes arbitrary novel views from a monocular video. It uses a 3D-aware compositional synthesis pipeline to combine robotic arms and backgrounds, and an adaptive noise injection strategy to improve spatiotemporal geometry stability and reduce manipulation hallucinations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training scale, baselines, or numerical gains. It claims improved cross-embodiment generalization and more stable 3D geometry in generated embodied scenes.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Zhejiang University, University of Science and Technology of China, Institute of Automation CAS, and Beihang University.

recommendation.zh: 只扫数据合成和noise injection即可；它不是LLM预训练，但多视角稀缺数据的处理方式可作多模态预训练备忘。
recommendation.en: Skim the data synthesis and noise-injection parts only; not LLM pretraining, but useful as a note on scarce multi-view data.

paper.title: Divide and Conquer: Decoupled Representation Alignment for Multimodal World Models
paper.abstract: Emerging multi-modal world models attempt to jointly generate videos across diverse modalities (e.g., RGB, depth, and mask), yet they fail to fully exploit the rich priors of existing foundation models. We propose $M^2$-REPA, the first representation alignment method tailored for multi-modal video generation. Our key insight is that foundation models trained on different modality spaces naturally capture distinct domain-specific priors, acting as complementary "experts." Specifically, we first d

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态世界模型在联合生成 RGB、深度、mask 等视频时，难以同时利用不同基础模型的模态专属先验、导致表示混叠和扩展性不足的问题。
summary.importance: 这是多模态生成/世界模型方向的方法论文。虽然不属于 LLM 预训练主线，但“把不同模态 foundation model 当 expert，对中间表示做解耦对齐”的思路，对统一多模态预训练有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 M²-REPA，面向多模态视频生成的表示对齐方法。核心做法是先从 diffusion 模型中间表示中解耦出模态特异特征，再分别与对应模态的 expert foundation model 对齐；训练目标包括多模态表示对齐损失和模态特异解耦正则，以鼓励不同模态先验互补而非相互污染。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据和具体 benchmark。实验应是在多模态视频生成任务上，对比不使用 expert 对齐、只做联合生成、以及加入解耦对齐后的质量与跨模态一致性表现。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自清华大学、华中科技大学等团队，工作更接近多模态生成与世界模型，而非语言模型预训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the difficulty of jointly generating RGB, depth, masks, and other modalities in multimodal world models while fully exploiting modality-specific priors from existing foundation models.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal generation/world-model paper rather than core LLM pretraining, but the idea of treating modality-specific foundation models as experts and aligning decoupled internal representations is relevant to unified multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes M²-REPA, a representation alignment method for multimodal video generation. The method decouples modality-specific features from the diffusion model’s intermediate representations and aligns each part with its corresponding expert foundation model, using both a multimodal alignment loss and a modality-specific decoupling regularizer.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or exact numbers. The evaluation likely compares plain joint multimodal generation against the proposed decoupled alignment, focusing on generation quality and cross-modal consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Tsinghua University, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, and collaborators; the work sits closer to multimodal generation and world models than language-model pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 主线，但“中间表示先解耦、再按模态对 expert 对齐”这个 recipe 值得记；读方法图和 loss 设计就够了。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM-core paper, but the recipe—decouple intermediate features, then align each modality to its own expert—is worth stealing; the method figure and losses are enough.
