paper.title: AesRM: Improving Video Aesthetics with Expert-Level Feedback
paper.abstract: Despite rapid advances in photorealistic video generation, real-world applications such as filmmaking require video aesthetics, e.g., harmonious colors and cinematic lighting, beyond visual fidelity. Prior work on visual aesthetics largely focuses on images, often reducing aesthetics to coarse definitions, e.g., visual pleasure, without a rigorous and systematic evaluation. To improve video aesthetics, we propose a hierarchical rubric that decomposes video aesthetics into three core dimensions,

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“视频生成够不够清晰”，而是“如何把视频美学变成可训练、可评估、可用于后训练优化的监督信号”。现有视频美学研究大多停留在粗粒度整体打分，标签解释性弱，无法告诉模型问题出在构图、色彩、光线还是物理 plausibility，也很难直接作为生成模型对齐时的 reward。作者试图补上这条链路：先定义细粒度视频美学标准，再构建专家偏好数据，再训练可解释的 reward model，最后把它接到视频生成后训练里。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练本身的直接相关性不高，它更接近视频生成 post-training / reward modeling；但对“如何把主观质量转成结构化监督”这件事有方法论价值。具体启发有三点。第一，reward 不一定要做成单标量回归，分层 rubric 往往更适合复杂主观属性。第二，把 reward modeling 写成原生 next-token prediction，而不是外挂 regression head，是一种值得注意的设计，和近来把判别任务重新表述为生成任务的趋势一致。第三，作者对 CoT 质量、self-consistency 合成、process reward 的处理，和文本 RM / judge model 训练中的问题高度同构：教师推理链质量差，会把幻觉和错误判断蒸馏进学生模型。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分四层。第一层是评价框架。作者把视频质量拆成三大维度：Visual Aesthetics、Visual Fidelity、Visual Plausibility，并进一步细化成 15 个标准。这样做的目的不是增加标签复杂度，而是让偏好数据和 reward 输出有可解释坐标系，便于后续训练时区分“审美问题”和“生成缺陷”。第二层是数据构建。作者先合成约 20K 高质量 prompts，用多个主流 T2V 模型生成候选视频，再让美学专家按 15 条标准做 pairwise preference 标注，最终形成约 19K 训练偏好对，以及约 2.5K 对的 AesVideo-Bench。这里的关键不是数据量本身，而是标注协议：偏好不是泛泛地选“更好”，而是围绕 VA/VF/VP 三个维度做结构化比较。第三层是 reward model 训练。AesRM 基于 VLM，不走传统“编码后接一个分数头”的路线，而是把比较任务写成生成式 next-token prediction，让模型直接输出 pairwise judgment；作者认为这样更贴近底座 VLM 的原始目标，也更能利用其已有的视觉-语言推理能力。训练分三阶段：先用 atomic aesthetics datasets 做能力注入，让模型学会基础审美元素；再用偏好数据做 cold-start instruction tuning；最后用 GRPO 做基于验证奖励的进一步优化。第四层是可解释 CoT 版本。AesRM-Base 直接输出比较结果，AesRM-CoT 额外输出基于 15 条标准的推理。作者发现单一路径生成的 CoT 容易带来 hallucination，于是用 self-consistency 式 CoT 合成：从 teacher 采多条 reasoning trajectory，用一致性指标筛选和集成，再把高质量 CoT 蒸馏给学生。GRPO 阶段还加入 process reward，用学生 CoT 与教师 CoT 的相似度来约束推理过程，而不只看最终偏好判断。
summary.experiments: 从全文可确认的关键规模包括：约 20K prompts、19K 偏好训练对、2.5K benchmark 视频对。模型族分为 AesRM-Base 和 AesRM-CoT，并在多个视频美学 benchmark 上与已有 aesthetic models 比较。作者的主要实验结论不是单点分数，而是三类现象。第一，分层 rubric + 专家偏好数据能显著提升 reward model 在视频美学判断上的一致性和可解释性。第二，CoT 不是天然有益，低质量 CoT 会放大误判；采用 ensemble/self-consistency 生成 CoT 后，AesRM-CoT 的表现和稳定性都更好。第三，process reward 对 CoT 型 reward model 有额外帮助，说明只优化最终偏好标签不足以约束推理质量。应用层面，作者把 AesRM 接到两种后训练策略里：Flow-RWR 和 Pref-GRPO。定性结果显示，生成视频在光照、构图、细节层次上更好。就你关心的研究价值而言，最该看的不是“美学分数提升多少”，而是 reward 设计和 CoT 数据质量控制如何影响后训练信号。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是 25–35 分钟。先看引言里对三层目标的定义：评价标准、偏好数据、reward model，这决定了整篇工作的边界。然后重点看 hierarchical rubric 的具体 15 条标准，以及数据标注协议；这部分决定 reward 是否真的可解释。接着看 AesRM 的训练方式，尤其是为什么作者坚持用 next-token prediction 而不是 regression head。再看 CoT 合成和 process reward，那是方法里最有可迁移性的部分，和文本 judge / RM 训练很接近。实验部分建议优先看三类消融：是否需要 atomic aesthetics pretraining、单路径 CoT 与 self-consistency CoT 的差异、是否加入 process reward。若时间有限，可以略过大量定性案例图，只保留几组能看出 VA/VF/VP 区分度的例子。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not mainly about improving raw video fidelity. It asks a more operational question: how to turn video aesthetics into a trainable, interpretable, and post-training-friendly supervision signal. Prior work often collapses aesthetics into a single coarse score, which is hard to diagnose and even harder to use as a reward for alignment. The authors build the full pipeline: define a fine-grained rubric, collect expert preference data under that rubric, train reward models on top of it, and use those rewards for video generation post-training.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to LLM pretraining is limited, since this is closer to video generation post-training and reward modeling. Still, it carries useful lessons for foundation-model researchers. First, subjective quality is often better modeled with a structured rubric than with a single scalar reward. Second, framing reward modeling as native next-token prediction instead of attaching a regression head is a notable design choice, aligned with the broader trend of recasting discriminative tasks into generative form. Third, the treatment of CoT quality, self-consistency synthesis, and process reward maps closely to issues in text reward models and judge models: poor teacher reasoning can easily distill hallucinations into the student.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has four layers. First, the evaluation framework. Video quality is decomposed into three top-level dimensions: Visual Aesthetics, Visual Fidelity, and Visual Plausibility, further broken into 15 fine-grained criteria. The point is not taxonomy for its own sake, but to create an interpretable coordinate system for both annotation and reward outputs. Second, data construction. The authors synthesize around 20K high-quality prompts, generate candidate videos from multiple mainstream text-to-video models, and ask aesthetics experts to provide pairwise preferences under the 15-criterion rubric. This yields about 19K training preference pairs and a 2.5K-pair benchmark, AesVideo-Bench. The key detail is that preferences are structured along VA/VF/VP rather than being generic “better/worse” labels. Third, reward model training. AesRM is built on a VLM, but instead of using the standard encode-and-score setup with an auxiliary regression head, it casts reward modeling as a generative next-token prediction task. The motivation is to stay aligned with the VLM’s original objective and better exploit its pretrained reasoning ability. Training proceeds in three stages: atomic aesthetic capability learning on atomic aesthetics datasets, cold-start instruction tuning on the preference data, and GRPO-based optimization with verified rewards. Fourth, the interpretable CoT variant. AesRM-Base outputs pairwise judgments directly, while AesRM-CoT also produces criterion-level reasoning. The authors observe that low-quality CoT can amplify hallucinations, so they synthesize CoT with a self-consistency procedure: sample multiple teacher reasoning trajectories, rank or aggregate them with a consistency metric, and distill the higher-quality traces. During GRPO, they further add a process reward based on similarity between teacher and student CoTs, so optimization is not driven only by the final preference label.
summary_en.experiments: The main confirmed scales are roughly 20K prompts, 19K training preference pairs, and 2.5K benchmark pairs. The model family includes AesRM-Base and AesRM-CoT, evaluated against existing aesthetics models on multiple video-aesthetics benchmarks. The most important findings are qualitative and structural rather than a single headline metric. First, the hierarchical rubric plus expert preference data improves consistency and interpretability in aesthetic judgment. Second, CoT is not automatically helpful: low-quality CoT increases false judgments, while ensemble/self-consistency CoT improves both performance and stability. Third, process reward provides additional gains for CoT-style reward models, suggesting that optimizing only the final preference outcome is insufficient when reasoning quality matters. On the application side, AesRM is plugged into two post-training strategies, Flow-RWR and Pref-GRPO, and the resulting videos show better lighting, composition, and detail in qualitative comparisons. For a foundation-model reader, the most useful part is not the absolute benchmark gain, but how reward design and CoT quality control affect downstream training signals.
summary_en.reading_guide: A practical skim takes about 25 to 35 minutes. Start with the introduction and the problem setup: rubric, preference data, and reward model. Then read the 15-criterion hierarchy and the annotation protocol carefully, since that is where interpretability is actually grounded. After that, focus on the AesRM formulation, especially the decision to use next-token prediction instead of a regression head. The most transferable section is the CoT synthesis and process-reward design, because it closely resembles issues in text judges and reward models. In the experiments, prioritize ablations on atomic-aesthetics pretraining, single-path versus self-consistent CoT, and with/without process reward. If time is short, skip most qualitative galleries and keep only a few examples that clearly separate VA, VF, and VP.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座预训练论文，但 reward rubric 拆解得比常见偏好模型干净；只看标注框架和 RM 设计，别在视频结果页停太久。
recommendation.en: Not a foundation-pretraining paper, but the reward rubric is cleaner than most preference-model work; read the annotation framework and RM design, then move on.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Delta Score Matters! Spatial Adaptive Multi Guidance in Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in synthesizing complex static and temporal visuals, a breakthrough largely driven by Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG). However, despite its pivotal role in aligning generated content with textual prompts, standard CFG relies on a globally uniform scalar. This homogeneous amplification traps models in a well-documented "detail-artifact dilemma": low guidance scales fail to inject intricate semantics, while high scales inevitably cause structural de

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散图像和视频生成中全局统一 CFG scale 导致的语义不足、结构退化、过饱和和视频不一致问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是生成模型采样机制分析和方法改进：从 Tweedie Formula 与数据流形曲率角度解释 CFG 的副作用，并提出空间自适应 guidance。对 diffusion LM 或统一生成预训练有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文将 CFG 解释为沿数据流形切向的线性外推；由于真实数据流形有曲率，统一外推会产生正交偏移。方法围绕 delta score 构造空间自适应的多重 guidance，并给出每个空间位置 guidance 强度的理论上界，用来在细节增强和轨迹稳定之间做局部调节。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型、数据集、图像/视频生成 backbone 或具体指标。预期实验应比较标准 CFG 与空间自适应 guidance 在文本对齐、细节质量、结构伪影、颜色饱和和视频时间一致性上的差异。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)、Griffith University 与 Data61/CSIRO。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why a globally uniform CFG scale causes weak semantics at low guidance and artifacts, oversaturation, or temporal inconsistency at high guidance.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an analysis and sampling-method improvement for diffusion generation. It frames CFG failure through Tweedie's formula and manifold curvature, which is indirectly relevant for diffusion language modeling and unified generative pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It interprets CFG as tangential linear extrapolation on the data manifold. Because the manifold is curved, a uniform extrapolation introduces orthogonal deviation. The proposed method uses delta-score-driven spatial adaptive multi-guidance and derives a local upper bound for guidance strength.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide backbone models, datasets, or numeric metrics. The expected comparisons are against standard CFG on text alignment, detail fidelity, structural artifacts, color saturation, and video temporal consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), Griffith University, and Data61/CSIRO.

recommendation.zh: 不必通读；看 CFG 几何解释和 guidance 上界即可，可能迁移到 diffusion LM 的采样控制。
recommendation.en: No need to read end-to-end; inspect the CFG geometry and guidance-bound derivation, which may transfer to sampling control in diffusion LMs.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

paper.title: HuM-Eval: A Coarse-to-Fine Framework for Human-Centric Video Evaluation
paper.abstract: Video generation models have developed rapidly in recent years, where generating natural human motion plays a pivotal role. However, accurately evaluating the quality of generated human motion video remains a significant challenge. Existing evaluation metrics primarily focus on global scene statistics, often overlooking fine-grained human details and consequently failing to align with human subjective preference. To bridge this gap, we propose HuM-Eval, a novel human-centric evaluation framework

summary.core_problem: 视频生成模型中人体动作质量很关键，但现有视频指标偏向全局场景统计，不能细致评估人体结构、姿态和运动稳定性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成评测框架和 benchmark。它把人类主观偏好中的人体因素拆成全局质量、解剖正确性和三维运动稳定性，适合评估人物视频生成。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 HuM-Eval 粗到细评估框架：先用 VLM 做全局视频质量粗评，再用 2D pose 检查人体解剖正确性，并用 3D human motion 表征评估运动稳定性；同时引入 HuM-Bench 作为配套 benchmark。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 HuM-Eval 与人类偏好的平均相关性达到 58.2%，优于已有 baseline；未给出 benchmark 规模、模型列表或各子指标的详细提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中国人民大学高瓴人工智能学院。摘要中没有显示知名 LLM 预训练团队或代表性基础模型工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses evaluation of human-centric video generation, where global video statistics often miss anatomical plausibility and motion stability.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation framework and benchmark for generated human-motion videos. It decomposes subjective quality into global quality, anatomical correctness, and 3D motion stability.
summary_en.technical_approach: HuM-Eval follows a coarse-to-fine design: a VLM first assesses global video quality, then 2D pose checks anatomical correctness, and 3D human-motion estimation evaluates temporal stability. HuM-Bench is introduced as the associated benchmark.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports an average human-correlation score of 58.2%, outperforming existing baselines. It does not provide benchmark size, evaluated model lists, or detailed per-component gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China. No direct foundation-model pretraining team signal is visible from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 对基座训练只提供评测侧弱信号；看相关性实验即可，方法本身偏人物视频生成质检。
recommendation.en: For pretraining work this is weakly relevant; the human-correlation study is the useful part, while the method is mostly video-generation QA.

paper.title: A Systematic Post-Train Framework for Video Generation
paper.abstract: While large-scale video diffusion models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in generating high-resolution and semantically rich content, a significant gap remains between their pretraining performance and real-world deployment requirements due to critical issues such as prompt sensitivity, temporal inconsistency, and prohibitive inference costs. To bridge this gap, we propose a comprehensive post-training framework that systematically aligns pretrained models with user intentions through

summary.core_problem: 解决视频扩散模型从预训练能力到真实产品可用性之间的落差，重点是提示词敏感、时间不一致和推理成本高。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成模型的后训练框架整合。它把 LLM 后训练里的 SFT、RLHF、GRPO 式相对优化和 prompt enhancement 迁移到视频生成模型，对理解生成模型 post-train pipeline 有参考价值，但不是 LLM 基座预训练方法本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出四阶段流程：先用 SFT 将基础视频生成模型调成更稳定的指令跟随策略；再用面向视频扩散模型改造的 Group Relative Policy Optimization 做 RLHF，以提升感知质量和时间一致性；随后引入专门的语言模型做提示词增强；最后处理系统效率问题。方法更像工程化 post-train pipeline，而不是单一新目标函数。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量、具体 baseline 和提升幅度。可确认评估目标包括用户意图对齐、视频感知质量、时间一致性和推理效率，但需要正文确认实验设置是否干净、奖励模型是否可靠、GRPO 改造是否真正优于常规偏好优化。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括清华大学、北京大学、浙江大学等；未从给定信息中确认知名作者背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the gap between pretrained video diffusion models and deployable video generation systems, focusing on prompt sensitivity, temporal inconsistency, and high inference cost.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a post-training pipeline for multimodal generation. It transfers SFT, RLHF, GRPO-style relative optimization, and prompt enhancement into video diffusion, which is relevant to post-training design but not directly to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has four stages: SFT to stabilize instruction following, an RLHF stage using a video-diffusion variant of Group Relative Policy Optimization, prompt enhancement through a specialized language model, and system-level efficiency treatment. The novelty appears to be pipeline integration rather than a new pretraining objective.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, data scale, baselines, or numerical gains. The evaluation targets include alignment with user intent, perceptual quality, temporal coherence, and inference efficiency; the main thing to verify in the paper is whether the reward setup and GRPO adaptation are clean.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions include Tsinghua University, Peking University, and Zhejiang University. No well-established author background can be confirmed from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 作为视频生成 post-train pipeline 备查即可；重点看 RLHF/GRPO 奖励定义，别把系统拼装误读成建模突破。
recommendation.en: Useful as a video-generation post-training reference; read the reward and GRPO setup, but do not treat the pipeline assembly as a modeling breakthrough.

paper.title: Latent Inter-Frame Pruning: A Training-Free Method Bridging Traditional Video Compression and Modern Diffusion Transformers for Efficient Generation
paper.abstract: Video generation, while capable of generating realistic videos, is computationally expensive and slow, prohibiting real-time applications. In this paper, we observe that video latents encoded via an autoencoder under the Latent Diffusion Model (LDM) framework contain redundancy along the temporal axis. Analogous to how traditional video compression algorithms avoid transmitting redundant frame data, we propose the Latent Inter-frame Pruning framework to prune (skip the re-computation of) duplica

summary.core_problem: 视频扩散 Transformer 在视频编辑中会重复处理大量跨帧相似的 latent patch，推理开销高；但生成任务又不能像理解任务那样直接丢 token，因为每个 latent token 都对应解码后的空间区域，信息缺失会带来可见伪影。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，更偏推理效率。但它有一个有用观察：VAE latent 中仍保留明显的时间冗余，且这种冗余可以在 DiT 输入侧被利用，而不只是在 attention block 内做 token merge。对视频生成模型和统一多模态 LM 来说，这提示 tokenization 后的序列并不一定需要被等价处理；时空冗余、token 重要性和训练-推理分布差异需要一起设计。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 training-free 的 Latent Inter-Frame Pruning。它先在 VAE latent 空间按帧比较 patch：如果当前帧某个 patch 与前一帧同位置 patch 足够相似，就认为该区域信息重复，不再送入 DiT 重新计算，而是复用已有结果。这样做把传统视频编码中的帧间冗余思想移到 latent diffusion 推理阶段。关键难点是生成模型训练时看到的是完整 latent 序列，推理时突然删 token 会改变 self-attention 的输入分布，导致 attention value 和 full-sequence 推理不一致。论文为此加入 Attention Recovery，用数学近似恢复被剪枝 token 对 attention 计算的影响，降低 full-token 训练和 pruned-token 推理之间的偏差。最后再通过 Restoration 把 token 数恢复到解码器需要的完整 latent 布局。和常见 token pruning/merging 方法相比，它不是在某几个 Transformer block 内临时合并 token，而是在 tokenization 前沿时间维做端到端剪枝，并显式处理解码所需的 token 对齐问题。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在 Self-Forcing 视频编辑模型上验证，评测集来自 DAVIS 的 51 个 video-prompt pairs。论文报告在保持编辑质量的前提下实现 1.44× throughput 提升。实验重点不是重新训练模型，而是验证相同模型在剪枝推理下的画质、时序一致性和速度变化。最有信息量的部分是直接剪枝会产生伪影，而加入 Attention Recovery 后可以明显缓解这一问题，说明瓶颈不只是 token 数减少带来的信息损失，还有 attention 分布被改变带来的训练-推理错配。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 15 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对生成任务 token pruning 与理解任务 token pruning 的区分，以及 Methods 中 Inter-Frame Pruning、Attention Recovery、Restoration 三段流程。实验部分主要看速度-质量 trade-off 和直接剪枝的失败案例。对做视频/多模态预训练的人，值得关注的是 latent redundancy 的测量方式、剪枝阈值如何设定，以及 Attention Recovery 是否能推广到非 causal attention 或更长视频生成。

summary_en.core_problem: Video diffusion transformers repeatedly process many temporally redundant latent patches during video editing. Naively dropping tokens is unsafe for generation, because each latent token maps back to a spatial region after decoding and small missing details can create visible artifacts.
summary_en.importance: The paper is mainly an inference-efficiency contribution rather than a pretraining method. Its useful signal for foundation-model research is the observation that VAE latents still contain strong temporal redundancy, and that this redundancy can be exploited before tokenization, not only inside attention layers. For video generation and unified multimodal modeling, it suggests that token sequences after compression should not always be treated as uniformly informative; redundancy, token importance, and train-inference mismatch need to be handled together.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, Latent Inter-Frame Pruning, is training-free. It compares each latent patch with the spatially corresponding patch in the previous frame. If the patch is sufficiently similar, the method skips recomputing it in the DiT and reuses the previous generated result. This brings an inter-frame compression idea from video codecs into latent diffusion inference. The main technical issue is that the model was trained on complete latent sequences. Removing tokens at inference changes self-attention statistics and produces artifacts. The proposed Attention Recovery module approximates the attention computation of the unpruned sequence so that pruned inference stays closer to full-token inference. A final restoration step expands the sequence back to the full latent layout required by the decoder. Compared with token merging inside transformer blocks, this approach prunes at the latent input level and explicitly preserves the dense output structure needed for generation.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on the Self-Forcing video editing model using 51 video-prompt pairs from DAVIS. The reported throughput gain is 1.44× while maintaining editing quality. The most useful empirical finding is that direct pruning creates visual artifacts, while Attention Recovery substantially reduces them. This indicates that the failure mode is not only information loss from pruning, but also a distribution shift in the attention computation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15 minutes. Focus on the distinction between pruning for understanding and pruning for generation in the introduction, then read the three-stage pipeline: Inter-Frame Pruning, Attention Recovery, and Restoration. In the experiments, look for the speed-quality trade-off and the failure cases of direct pruning. For video or multimodal pretraining work, the most relevant questions are how temporal redundancy is measured, how pruning thresholds are chosen, and whether the recovery mechanism transfers to non-causal attention or longer video generation.

recommendation.zh: 将传统视频压缩的帧间冗余思想引入 DiT 推理加速，Attention Recovery 解决 train-inference gap 的思路值得做多模态生成的同学参考。
recommendation.en: Introduces inter-frame redundancy concepts from traditional video compression into DiT inference acceleration; the Attention Recovery mechanism for bridging the train-inference gap is worth referencing for multimodal generation researchers.

institutions: The University of Texas at Austin

paper.title: Exploring the Role of Synthetic Data Augmentation in Controllable Human-Centric Video Generation
paper.abstract: Controllable human video generation aims to produce realistic videos of humans with explicitly guided motions and appearances,serving as a foundation for digital humans, animation, and embodied AI.However, the scarcity of largescale, diverse, and privacy safe human video datasets poses a major bottleneck, especially for rare identities and complex actions.Synthetic data provides a scalable and controllable alternative,yet its actual contribution to generative modeling remains underexplored due t

summary.core_problem: 合成数据在可控“人类视频生成”训练中到底带来什么增益、与真实数据如何互补，缺少系统性量化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏“数据/训练配比分析”：对生成模型的数据混合与Sim2Real gap有参考，但不直接触及LLM/统一token建模。
summary.technical_approach: 构建一个扩散式可控人像视频生成框架作为统一试验台，系统改变合成/真实数据配比与选择策略，分析两者在身份稀缺与复杂动作场景下的互补性，并讨论更高效的数据筛选方法以缩小Sim2Real差距。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模、具体控制条件（姿态/外观）指标与提升幅度；仅声明“广泛实验”与“揭示互补角色”。

summary_en.core_problem: The actual training value of synthetic data for controllable human-centric video generation and its interaction with real data is under-quantified.
summary_en.importance: Mainly a data-mixture/Sim2Real analysis for diffusion video generation; indirectly relevant to pretraining via data composition lessons.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses a diffusion-based controllable human video generation framework as a unified testbed, varies synthetic/real mixing and selection strategies, and studies complementary effects (e.g., rare identities, complex actions) and efficiency-oriented selection to mitigate Sim2Real gap.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits model/data scale, control conditions, metrics, and concrete gains; it only claims extensive experiments and complementary findings.

recommendation.zh: 把它当“合成数据×真实数据配比”的经验报告看即可；只需抓结论与数据选择策略，方法本身对基座预训练迁移有限。
recommendation.en: Treat it as an empirical note on synthetic-vs-real mixing; focus on the takeaways and selection heuristics, not the model details.

paper.title: HumanScore: Benchmarking Human Motions in Generated Videos
paper.abstract: Recent advances in model architectures, compute, and data scale have driven rapid progress in video generation, producing increasingly realistic content. Yet, no prior method systematically measures how faithfully these systems render human bodies and motion dynamics. In this paper, we present HumanScore, a systematic framework to evaluate the quality of human motions in AI-generated videos. HumanScore defines six interpretable metrics spanning kinematic plausibility, temporal stability, and bio

summary.core_problem: 现有视频生成质量评估仅关注视觉真实感，缺乏对生成视频中人体动作动力学、生物力学合理性的系统性评测方法
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，首次提出专门针对生成视频中人类动作质量的评测框架，填补该领域评估空白
summary.technical_approach: 定义运动学合理性、时间稳定性、生物力学一致性三个维度共6项可解释指标，设计覆盖不同强度动作的提示集，对生成视频的动作质量做细粒度诊断
summary.experiments: 评测13个主流视频生成模型，发现感知真实感和动作生物力学保真度存在显著差距，识别出时间抖动、解剖学不合理姿态、运动漂移等常见失效模式，给出模型鲁棒排名
summary.authors_note: 斯坦福大学、北京大学团队，包含知名学者李飞飞

summary_en.core_problem: Existing video generation quality evaluation only focuses on visual realism, lacking a systematic evaluation method for human motion dynamics and biomechanical plausibility in generated videos
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution, the first dedicated evaluation framework for human motion quality in generated videos, fills the gap in this evaluation domain
summary_en.technical_approach: Define 6 interpretable metrics across three dimensions: kinematic plausibility, temporal stability, and biomechanical consistency, design a prompt set covering actions of different intensities to conduct fine-grained diagnosis of motion quality in generated videos
summary_en.experiments: Evaluate 13 mainstream video generation models, find a significant gap between perceptual plausibility and motion biomechanical fidelity, identify common failure modes including temporal jitter, anatomically implausible poses, and motion drift, and provide robust model rankings
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Stanford University and Peking University, includes well-known researcher Li Fei-Fei

recommendation.zh: 作为多模态生成领域的评测基准，仅需了解核心指标定义，无需通读全文
recommendation.en: As an evaluation benchmark for multimodal generation, only need to know the core metric definitions, no need to read the full text

paper.title: Seedance 2.0: Advancing Video Generation for World Complexity

summary.core_problem: 如何用统一架构实现原生音视频联合生成，并支持多模态输入参考与编辑，在世界复杂度更高的场景下提升生成质量与可控性。
summary.importance: 更偏“产品/技术报告式”的多模态生成模型发布；对基座研究的价值在于统一多模态生成架构与能力面板，但摘要缺少训练细节与可复现信息，研究启发受限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出统一且高效的大规模架构进行音视频联合生成，支持文本/图像/音频/视频四种输入，并提供丰富的参考与编辑能力；具体建模范式（扩散/自回归/flow等）、tokenization与训练目标未在摘要中说明。
summary.experiments: 给出可生成4-15秒、480p/720p原生分辨率音视频；声称在专家评测与用户测试中达到领先水平，但未提供公开基准、对比对象与量化指标。

summary_en.core_problem: How to build a unified architecture for native joint audio-video generation with multimodal conditioning and editing, improving quality and controllability under higher world complexity.
summary_en.importance: More like a product/technical-report style release for a multimodal generative model. Potential value lies in unified audio-video generation and capability coverage, but the abstract lacks training and reproducibility details, limiting research takeaways.
summary_en.technical_approach: A unified, efficient large-scale architecture for joint audio-video generation supporting text/image/audio/video inputs and rich reference/editing features; the underlying modeling paradigm (diffusion vs AR vs flow), tokenization, and objectives are not specified in the abstract.
summary_en.experiments: Supports 4–15s audio-video generation at native 480p/720p. Claims near-leading performance in expert and public tests, but provides no standardized benchmarks, baselines, or quantitative metrics.

recommendation.zh: 改变的prior是“音视频可在统一自回归框架里端到端生成并可编辑”，值得立刻对照自家路线图做架构对齐；但细节像产品发布，训练配方不透明需谨慎采信。
recommendation.en: It updates the prior that joint audio-video generation+editing can live in one unified autoregressive stack—worth mapping against your internal roadmap immediately; but it reads like a product drop, so treat training claims cautiously.

paper.title: Lyra 2.0: Explorable Generative 3D Worlds
paper.abstract: Recent advances in video generation enable a new paradigm for 3D scene creation: generating camera-controlled videos that simulate scene walkthroughs, then lifting them to 3D via feed-forward reconstruction techniques. This generative reconstruction approach combines the visual fidelity and creative capacity of video models with 3D outputs ready for real-time rendering and simulation. Scaling to large, complex environments requires 3D-consistent video generation over long camera trajectories wit

summary.core_problem: 长视频生成做 3D 场景漫游时，空间遗忘（revisit 时幻觉）和时间漂移（自回归误差累积）导致几何不一致
summary.importance: 针对 long-horizon 3D 生成的两个明确失效模式做系统分析和方法改进，NVIDIA 系工作，视频→3D 生成范式的延续
summary.technical_approach: 在 Lyra 基础上扩展：长相机轨迹下的 3D-consistent video generation，前馈重建做 lifting。细节需要看正文，abstract 未明说具体机制
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中给出具体数字和 baseline
summary.authors_note: NVIDIA 团队（Zan Gojcic, Nicholas Sharp, Ruilong Li 等），3D 生成与 neural rendering 领域核心力量

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon video-to-3D scene generation suffers from spatial forgetting (hallucinated revisits) and temporal drifting (autoregressive error accumulation)
summary_en.importance: Systematic treatment of two well-defined failure modes in long-horizon 3D generation; continuation of the video→3D lifting paradigm from NVIDIA
summary_en.technical_approach: Extends Lyra for 3D-consistent video generation over long camera trajectories with feed-forward reconstruction; abstract does not detail the mechanism
summary_en.experiments: No concrete numbers or baselines in abstract
summary_en.authors_note: NVIDIA team (Zan Gojcic, Nicholas Sharp, Ruilong Li), core contributors to 3D generation and neural rendering

recommendation.zh: 3D 生成方向工作，对 LLM pretrain 基本无关；做世界模型或 video generation 的可以扫下失效模式分析，其他人作 literature 备查
recommendation.en: 3D generation work with little bearing on LLM pretrain; if you work on world models or video gen, skim the failure-mode analysis, else use as literature reference

paper.title: OmniShow: Unifying Multimodal Conditions for Human-Object Interaction Video Generation

summary.core_problem: 如何在同一视频生成框架中统一融合文本/参考图/音频/姿态等多模态条件，生成高质量且可控的人-物交互视频。
summary.importance: 方法与系统创新：面向“多条件可控视频生成”这一更贴近真实生产的设定，提出统一条件注入与音画同步机制，并给出缓解数据稀缺的训练范式，对多模态生成的条件对齐与可控性有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出端到端HOI视频生成框架OmniShow：1) Unified Channel-wise Conditioning，用通道级方式高效注入图像与姿态条件以提升可控性/质量折中；2) Gated Local-Context Attention，通过门控的局部上下文注意力强化音频-视觉时序对齐；3) Decoupled-Then-Joint Training，先解耦学习不同条件/子能力再联合训练以利用多源数据并缓解稀缺。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模、具体基线与量化指标；仅宣称可同时支持多条件并达到“industry-grade performance”，以及通过训练策略应对数据稀缺（需以论文正文结果为准）。

summary_en.core_problem: Generating high-quality, controllable human–object interaction videos while unifying heterogeneous conditions (text, reference images, audio, pose, etc.) within a single generation framework.
summary_en.importance: Advances practical multi-condition controllable video generation by proposing unified conditioning and audio–visual synchronization mechanisms, alongside a training strategy aimed at mitigating data scarcity—relevant to condition alignment and controllability in multimodal generation systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents OmniShow, an end-to-end HOI video generator featuring (1) Unified Channel-wise Conditioning to inject image and pose controls efficiently, (2) Gated Local-Context Attention to strengthen temporal audio–visual alignment, and (3) Decoupled-Then-Joint Training that first learns condition-specific capabilities separately and then jointly trains to leverage heterogeneous data sources.
summary_en.experiments: Reports support for multiple simultaneous conditions and claims industry-grade performance, with training designed to handle limited paired data; the abstract does not include model/data scales, baselines, metrics, or quantitative results.

recommendation.zh: 作为多条件注入的工程参考即可：看统一condition接口和音画同步模块；其余更像系统堆料，难迁移到通用预训结论。
recommendation.en: Glance for engineering patterns: the unified conditioning interface and audio-visual sync module; the rest reads like system stacking with limited transferable pretraining insight.

paper.title: VGA-Bench: A Unified Benchmark and Multi-Model Framework for Video Aesthetics and Generation Quality Evaluation

summary.core_problem: 如何对视频生成模型进行同时覆盖“生成质量(技术保真/伪影)”与“审美质量(感知/艺术性)”的统一、可扩展评测。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献+评测范式补全：将视频生成评测从偏“技术质量”扩展到“审美/风格/艺术属性”，并用分层taxonomy把主观审美拆解为可操作的细粒度维度；对多模态生成模型的训练目标设计、对齐与自动评测器构建具有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出三层评测taxonomy（Aesthetic Quality / Aesthetic Tagging / Generation Quality）并细分子维度；构建包含1016条多样化prompt的评测集，调用12个视频生成模型生成>6万视频形成基准；配套“多模型评测框架”以支持自动化、可扩展的联合打分与维度诊断（从摘要看包含自动评估器/多模型集成思路，但细节需看正文）。
summary.experiments: 数据规模：1016 prompts、12个视频生成模型、>60,000视频；对比对象：多种视频生成模型之间的质量与审美维度差异；结果形态：提供跨模型、跨维度的系统性评测与诊断（是否SOTA/具体提升幅度摘要未给出）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate video generation models in a unified and scalable way that jointly captures technical generation quality (fidelity/artifacts) and higher-level aesthetic quality (perceptual and artistic attributes).
summary_en.importance: Extends video-generation evaluation beyond purely technical metrics by operationalizing aesthetics through a hierarchical taxonomy, providing a benchmark and framework that can inform training objectives, alignment, and automated evaluators for multimodal generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines a three-level evaluation taxonomy spanning Aesthetic Quality, Aesthetic Tagging, and Generation Quality with fine-grained sub-dimensions; constructs a prompt set and a multi-model evaluation pipeline that supports automated, extensible scoring and diagnostic breakdowns across dimensions and models.
summary_en.experiments: Builds a benchmark with 1,016 diverse prompts and evaluates outputs from 12 video generation models, totaling over 60,000 generated videos, enabling systematic cross-model comparisons across aesthetic and technical dimensions; the abstract does not report specific SOTA claims or numeric deltas.

recommendation.zh: 当作评测文献备查：只看taxonomy和标注协议/一致性；对预训研究的直接动作是把审美维度纳入离线评测而非训练目标。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an evaluation reference: read the taxonomy plus labeling protocol/consistency; the actionable takeaway is adding aesthetic axes to offline evals, not turning them into training objectives.

paper.title: Uni-ViGU: Towards Unified Video Generation and Understanding via A Diffusion-Based Video Generator
paper.abstract: Unified multimodal models integrating visual understanding and generation face a fundamental challenge: visual generation incurs substantially higher computational costs than understanding, particularly for video. This imbalance motivates us to invert the conventional paradigm: rather than extending understanding-centric MLLMs to support generation, we propose Uni-ViGU, a framework that unifies video generation and understanding by extending a video generator as the foundation. We introduce a un

summary.core_problem: 统一多模态模型中视频生成计算远高于理解，扩展理解型MLLM支持生成代价高。
summary.importance: 反向统一范式：从视频生成器扩展到理解，而非主流的理解扩生成路线，思路值得留意。
summary.technical_approach: 统一flow：视频用连续flow matching、文本用离散flow matching于单一过程；模态驱动MoE在Transformer block上加轻量层支持文本生成；双向训练（Knowledge Recall重建prompt + 理解任务）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体baseline和数据规模数字。

summary_en.core_problem: Unified multimodal models face imbalance: video generation is far more costly than understanding, making understanding-to-generation extension inefficient.
summary_en.importance: Inverts the conventional unification paradigm by starting from a video generator rather than an understanding MLLM.
summary_en.technical_approach: Unified flow combining continuous flow matching for video and discrete flow matching for text; modality-driven MoE; bidirectional training with Knowledge Recall prompt reconstruction.
summary_en.experiments: Specific scales and baselines not described in abstract.

recommendation.zh: 反向统一（生成器→理解）的思路有意思，值得记住这个方向存在；但摘要没给硬对比数字，要看实验节才能判断是不是只是paradigm paper。
recommendation.en: Inverting the unification direction (generator→understanding) is a noteworthy framing; need to inspect experiments to tell if it's substantive or paradigm-only.

paper.title: CT-1: Vision-Language-Camera Models Transfer Spatial Reasoning Knowledge to Camera-Controllable Video Generation

summary.core_problem: 在视频生成中实现可控且物理合理的相机运动：解决文本控制不精确与手工轨迹参数成本高的问题。
summary.importance: 系统/方法创新：提出“Vision-Language-Camera”中间模型将空间推理/相机轨迹估计显式化，再注入视频扩散模型实现可控生成；并配套数据构建（CT-200），对视频生成可控性与可用性具有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CT-1（Camera Transformer 1）：基于视觉-语言模块与Diffusion Transformer，学习从输入（文本/视觉线索）到相机轨迹分布的映射；引入频域Wavelet正则损失以学习复杂轨迹；将预测轨迹作为条件输入集成到视频扩散模型中实现空间感知的相机控制；同时设计数据清洗/构建管线并发布CT-200数据集。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据规模、与哪些视频生成/相机控制baseline对比、定量指标与提升幅度；仅声明能更好对齐用户意图并实现物理合理相机运动。需查全文确认：CT-200规模、轨迹误差指标、生成质量/一致性指标、以及对比（如文本到视频模型+控制方法）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to achieve controllable and physically plausible camera motion in video generation without relying on imprecise text-only control or costly hand-specified camera trajectories.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a vision–language–camera intermediate modeling stage that explicitly learns spatial reasoning and camera-trajectory estimation and then conditions a video diffusion model on the predicted trajectory; paired with a curated dataset (CT-200), this directly improves usability and controllability for camera-aware video synthesis.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes CT-1 (Camera Transformer): a model combining vision–language components with a diffusion transformer to map inputs (text and/or visual cues) to a distribution over camera trajectories; employs a frequency-domain wavelet regularization loss to learn complex motions; integrates the predicted trajectory as a conditioning signal for a video diffusion generator; and provides a data cleaning/construction pipeline releasing the CT-200 dataset.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states improved alignment to user intent and more physically reasonable camera motion, but does not specify model/data scale, trajectory-error metrics, generation-quality metrics, or the baselines used for comparison.

recommendation.zh: 把相机轨迹显式成中间表征再蒸到扩散模型，工程上很实用但对预训练启发有限；看CT-200数据定义和可控性对比图即可。
recommendation.en: Explicitly modeling camera motion as an intermediate representation then injecting it into diffusion is practically useful but not very pretraining-relevant; just read the CT-200 spec and controllability comparisons.

paper.title: PhysInOne: Visual Physics Learning and Reasoning in One Suite

summary.core_problem: 缓解物理世界视频/动态场景的“物理一致性”训练数据稀缺问题，并系统评估/提升基础模型在物理现象上的学习与推理能力。
summary.importance: 数据/Benchmark贡献：提供大规模、物理可控且标注完备的合成视频数据（2M视频、71类物理现象），可用于物理一致的视频生成与预测；同时揭示现有基础模型在复杂物理动力学上的能力缺口。
summary.technical_approach: 提出PhysInOne合成数据套件：覆盖力学/光学/流体/磁学等现象，包含多物体交互与复杂背景；提供3D几何、语义、运动、物理属性与文本描述等多粒度GT标注；用其对基础模型进行微调以提升物理合理性，并在多任务上进行统一评测。
summary.experiments: 数据规模：200万视频、153,810个动态3D场景、71种现象；应用评测覆盖物理感知视频生成、长短期未来帧预测、物理属性估计、运动迁移；摘要声称微调后物理可信度显著提升并暴露复杂动力学建模不足，但未给出具体模型参数量、基线与量化提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Addressing the scarcity of large-scale, physically consistent training data for dynamic real-world videos and providing a systematic way to evaluate and improve foundation models’ learning and reasoning over physical phenomena.
summary_en.importance: Contributes a large, controllable synthetic video suite with comprehensive annotations (enabling physically grounded video generation/prediction) and exposes capability gaps of current foundation models on complex dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents PhysInOne, a synthetic data and evaluation suite spanning mechanics, optics, fluids, magnetism, and multi-object interactions in complex scenes, with multi-level ground truth (3D geometry, semantics, motion, physical properties, and text); uses the suite for unified multi-task evaluation and for fine-tuning models to improve physical plausibility.
summary_en.experiments: Reports dataset scale of 2M videos, 153,810 dynamic 3D scenes, and 71 phenomena; evaluates tasks including physics-aware video generation, short/long-horizon future prediction, physical property estimation, and motion transfer, claiming notable gains from fine-tuning while noting remaining failures on complex dynamics (without detailed quantitative breakdown in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: glance：把“物理一致性”做成大套件数据很实用，但结论高度依赖合成分布；只看任务划分与leaderboard缺口，别深信绝对分数。
recommendation.en: Glance: the suite is handy, but take results as distribution-bound; skim task taxonomy + leaderboard gaps to see where current models break, don’t over-trust absolute numbers.

paper.title: VAG: Dual-Stream Video-Action Generation for Embodied Data Synthesis

summary.core_problem: 为具身学习合成可用于策略学习的数据：在语言/视觉条件下联合生成“视频+动作轨迹”，避免仅生成世界视频却缺少配对动作的问题。
summary.importance: 面向具身/机器人基础模型的数据合成范式：把生成模型从“仅视频世界模型”推进到“视频-动作对齐的联合生成”，对多模态生成与具身数据扩展具有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: VAG：基于flow-matching的双流框架，视频分支与动作分支同步去噪/生成；通过联合建模与自适应机制强化视频-动作对齐，替代“两阶段先视频后动作”的误差累积与低效。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供训练数据规模、模型规模、对比对象（WM/WA/两阶段管线）、以及在策略学习或生成质量上的定量提升幅度等关键信息。

summary_en.core_problem: Synthesizing embodied-learning data that pairs generated videos with aligned action trajectories under language/visual conditions, avoiding the mismatch that arises when generating only videos without corresponding actions.
summary_en.importance: Advances data synthesis for embodied/robotic foundation models by moving from video-only world modeling to joint video–action generation, directly supporting scalable policy learning with aligned multimodal supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces VAG, a flow-matching dual-stream generative framework where video and action streams are denoised/generated synchronously, with joint modeling and adaptive alignment mechanisms to reduce the inefficiency and error accumulation of two-stage pipelines (video then actions).
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify training/model scale, baselines, or quantitative improvements on generation quality or downstream policy learning.

recommendation.zh: glance：值得知道“视频+动作”联合生成这条数据合成路线，但训练信号/对齐约束可能很脆；只看动作-视频一致性指标与失败案例。
recommendation.en: Glance: good to know the video+action joint synthesis direction, but alignment supervision may be brittle; focus on their action-video consistency metrics and failure modes.
